jobs.description:
Job Title: Associate DevOps Engineer

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Nitro is an AI-native data platform that democratizes life sciences data for non-technical commercial teams, turning fragmented HCP/HCO, prescription, and industry data into decisions the field can act on. Our team is seeking an Associate DevOps Engineer to support our business consulting team’s AWS and Kubernetes analytics infrastructure as part of the broader NitroAI Team. You'll work alongside the team keeping this platform reliable and secure, with real ownership over the pieces you run day to day. This role needs solid technical fundamentals, but just as important is a customer-service mindset: you'll be supporting internal engineering teams directly, so how you communicate, troubleshoot with empathy, and show up when something's broken matters as much as the fix itself.

What You'll Do

    • Support day-to-day operation of the AWS and Kubernetes platform — monitoring reliability and performance, flagging issues before they become incidents for 50 person global consulting team
    • Build & Maintain GitOps deployments: sync policies, deployment ordering, configuration management
    • Support CI/CD pipelines: maintain GitLab pipelines and runners, help engineering teams troubleshoot failed builds and deployments
    • Act as first responder on platform incidents: triage, escalate, and help document post-mortems
    • Maintain platform observability: monitoring, alerting, and log visibility
    • Migrate 50 person business consulting team onto a new AI native stack
    • Support the building of our new AI native application NitroAI to learn Veeva methodology

Requirements

    • 1+ years hands-on experience with AWS and Kubernetes
    • Working knowledge of GitLab CI/CD, including runner management and Bash scripting for deployment tasks
    • Familiarity with GitOps practices (ArgoCD or similar)
    • Exposure to Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool
    • Strong communication skills and a customer-service mindset — you're supporting people, not just infrastructure
    • Comfortable being accountable to other engineers who are blocked and waiting on you

Nice to Have

    • EKS/Kubernetes RBAC and IRSA experience
    • Broader AWS fluency: Lambda, ALB, WAF, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, Route53, KMS, ECR
    • Apache Airflow experience via MWAA
    • Proficiency with Claude Code
    • Exposure to compliance/security-baseline work

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A technical/coding skills exercise
        3. A final panel interview with team members and senior leaders
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $65,000 - $90,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. jobs.excerpt: About The Redesign Group The Redesign Group is a global technology and cybersecurity Solution Provider leveraging design thinking, interdependent subject matter expertise, and emerging technology solutions to help organizations achieve meaningful transformation.
jobs.description:
About The Redesign Group

The Redesign Group is a global technology and cybersecurity Solution Provider leveraging design thinking, interdependent subject matter expertise, and emerging technology solutions to help organizations achieve meaningful transformation. Our globally diverse team members, partnerships with strategic technology manufacturers, and cybersecurity services position us to be a business partner that’s ready for what’s next.

We live by our core values of operating in the service of others, being problem solvers, and focusing on long term partnerships. You’ll excel at Redesign if you thrive in a rewarding environment that moves quickly, challenges you to grow and fosters collaboration. We seek candidates with a hands-on customer-first approach, robust interpersonal and communication skills, strong work ethic and excellent time management. While teamwork is expected, the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment is crucial.

Job Description

The Director, Brand & Communications will lead the strategy and execution of The Redesign Group’s brand, creative, content, corporate communications, social media, and digital experience. This role is responsible for strengthening Redesign’s brand, visibility, and reputation while ensuring the company tells a clear, differentiated, and compelling story across every channel and touchpoint. The Director will set strategy and standards across the function while remaining closely connected to the work, personally contributing to high-priority messaging, content, communications, and creative initiatives when needed.

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, this leader will oversee a multidisciplinary team spanning graphic design, content, and website design and development. The ideal candidate combines strong brand and creative instincts with exceptional storytelling and communications expertise, strategic thinking, operational discipline, and a willingness to lead from strategy through execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Redesign’s brand strategy and stewardship, ensuring a consistent and differentiated brand identity, voice, messaging, and experience across all internal and external touchpoints.
  • Own corporate communications and public relations, including company announcements, press releases, media relations, awards and recognition, executive thought leadership, and proactive opportunities to strengthen Redesign’s visibility, credibility, and reputation.
  • Shape Redesign’s company narrative and external messaging, partnering with executive leadership to communicate company growth, strategic initiatives, partnerships, customer successes, industry perspectives, and other key developments.
  • Lead content and editorial strategy and execution across sales collateral, articles, case studies, news stories, thought leadership, executive content, social media, and other marketing and corporate communications, personally writing, editing, reviewing or shaping high-priority content as needed.
  • Provide strategic leadership across creative and design, guiding creative direction, visual storytelling, graphic design, brand standards, and the development of high-impact marketing and sales assets.
  • Lead Redesign’s social media strategy and presence, overseeing editorial planning, channel strategy, content development, executive amplification, and programs that strengthen awareness, engagement, and thought leadership.
  • Oversee the company website and digital brand experience, including website strategy, design, development, content, optimization, and ongoing evolution.
  • Partner closely with GTM teams and executive leadership to translate business priorities, technical expertise, and market opportunities into compelling narratives, campaigns, content, and communications.
  • Define and track performance measures across brand, communications, content, social, and digital channels, using data and insights to evaluate effectiveness, demonstrate business impact, and continuously optimize strategy and execution.
  • Build and lead a high-performing function, developing team members while establishing scalable processes, governance, prioritization, and performance measures.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of progressive experience across brand marketing, corporate communications, public relations, content, creative, or related disciplines, including experience leading teams and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and evolve a B2B brand and communications strategy across owned, earned, social, and digital channels.
  • Experience leading corporate communications and PR initiatives, including press releases, media outreach, company announcements, executive thought leadership, awards, and reputation-building programs.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, messaging, and storytelling skills, with the ability to personally develop high-impact content and translate complex business and technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives.
  • Strong creative judgment with experience guiding visual and written work across brand, content, social media, sales enablement, and digital experiences.
  • Experience within B2B technology, IT services, cybersecurity, professional services, or another complex solutions environment strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution, build scalable processes, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with executives, Sales leaders, subject matter experts, and creative teams.

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package which may include:

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match (annual dollar cap applied)
  • Flexible time off plan
  • 15 paid holidays
  • Sick leave (amount varies by state requirements and is at least the minimum required by any state)
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Life insurance
  • Paid parental leave

Additional Compensation:This position is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation and/or bonus opportunities based on individual and company performance.

We’re an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We consider qualified candidates without regard to any legally protected status. This role is subject to applicable employment laws based on work location. In compliance with pay transparency laws, the compensation range for this role is included, with final pay based on experience, skills, and location. We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process—just let us know how we can help.

Marketing Manager
Level: Journeyman | Work Location: Remote (DMV Area)

ABOUT THE ROLE
Red Carrot is seeking a Marketing Manager to lead marketing and communications teams supporting our federal government clients. This role manages client relationships and provides leadership and coaching for direct reports, while developing and managing large-scale integrated marketing programs. The role oversees client relationships, creative development, consumer outreach, and stakeholder engagement, and requires strong project management and writing skills along with a high level of attention to detail.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Direct marketing objectives, programs, and policies for all client products and services
  • Translate the marketing vision into integrated business plans, tactics, projects, and deliverables
  • Execute market research, digital, creative, communications, and implementation planning
  • Develop budgets and resources to execute marketing plans
  • Review, edit, and implement strategic plans, creative briefs, client presentations, and other written communications
  • Deliver insights on emerging trends and digital/social strategies for engaging multicultural and general market audiences
  • Review creative concepts to ensure marketing and creative work is on-strategy and on-brand before client delivery
  • Establish success metrics and KPIs, and facilitate reporting against campaign goals and outcomes
  • Develop strong client relationships, ensure compliance with the Scope of Work, and oversee project timelines, risks, and monthly reporting
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in advertising, communications, journalism, public relations, or related field
  • 3 years of experience managing advertising or marketing communications
  • Verifiable agency experience, plus expertise in integrated communications, paid advertising, and brand development
  • Strong time and budget management skills, with the ability to collaborate with others and set direction for a team
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; proficient in Microsoft Office 365 and experienced with data-driven programs like Google Analytics
  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust Clearance, or hold an existing Public Trust or Security Clearance; PMP certification and knowledge of federal government contracting highly desirable

Benefits at Red Carrot:    

At Red Carrot, we empower you to be a leader. We attract and develop talent from all backgrounds because we believe there’s strength in diversity, offering different perspectives and skills. Together, we can solve our client’s biggest challenges. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package.     

  • Training and Development – Tuition reimbursement and professional trainings for eligible employees.
  • Healthcare – Top-tier medical, dental, vision, life insurance and long-term disability coverage.     
  • 401(k) Plan – 401(k)-retirement and Roth plan with company matching and no vesting period.     
  • Profit Sharing – Discretionary profit-sharing plan to all eligible employees after one year of employment.          
  • Paid Time Off – Provides flexible work hours, paid time off, and 11 federal holidays.   

About Us:

Red Carrot is an award-winning, woman-owned small business built for the complexity of federal government work. We partner with clients to advance their goals — powered by a team fueled by passion, backed by intelligence, and grounded in expertise.

From day one, we've applied industrial engineering principles and data analytics to solve complex problems with precision. Our approach is research-centric, data-informed, and audience-oriented — and it's how we deliver work that actually moves the needle.

We exist to strengthen the organizations and communities we serve through trusted, purposeful communication. That's not a tagline — it's the standard we hold ourselves to on every engagement.

Headquartered in Miami, Florida, with a strong and growing presence in Washington, D.C., our team works with clients across the country. Distance doesn't dilute our service. We build capacity where our clients need it, delivering Strategic Communications, Customer Experience, Management Consulting, and Human Capital Solutions that fit their mission — and their moment.

We're the partner organizations turn to when communication challenges are real, the stakes are high, and the work has to matter.

jobs.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Director, Global Sales Strategy is responsible for leading the organization's global sales strategy, partner ecosystem, and sales enablement functions. This role drives partner-influenced business growth, develops and executes strategic sales initiatives, and ensures sales teams are equipped with the knowledge, resources, and capabilities needed to achieve business objectives.

The ideal candidate brings a blend of leadership, sales strategy, enablement, channel sales, and partner management experience, along with strong executive communication skills and the ability to influence a highly matrixed organization. This individual will collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Learning & Development, and external partners to accelerate revenue growth and execute strategic business initiatives.

Additionally, this role will lead and develop a team of Program and Partner Managers who support regional and vertical-specific sales initiatives focused on driving pipeline growth across key areas of the business.

Role Description

Global Sales Strategy & Growth Initiatives

  • Develop and execute global sales strategies designed to accelerate growth and improve sales effectiveness.
  • Lead cross-functional sales programs and campaigns across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations teams.
  • Identify market opportunities, sales performance trends, and business risks using data-driven analysis.
  • Create and manage strategic initiatives that support revenue goals and business priorities.
  • Define success metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to measure program effectiveness.
  • Present insights, recommendations, and business performance updates to senior leadership.
  • Continuously optimize sales processes, engagement models, and strategic programs based on business results and stakeholder feedback.

Partner Alliance Strategy & Relationship Management

  • Own the overall partner alliance strategy and day-to-day management of strategic partner relationships.
  • Develop and execute partner business plans aligned with company growth objectives.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with partner leadership, sales organizations, marketing teams, and technical stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue.
  • Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, campaigns, and business development activities with strategic partners.
  • Establish partner success metrics and regularly track, analyze, and communicate performance.
  • Coordinate partner engagement across regions, functions, and business units to ensure consistency and alignment.
  • Lead partner business reviews and executive-level discussions.

Sales & Partner Enablement

  • Own the enablement strategy for internal sales teams and external partner organizations.
  • Develop scalable enablement programs that improve sales capabilities, product knowledge, and partner effectiveness.
  • Coordinate enablement content development with technical subject matter experts, product teams, partners, and external presenters.
  • Curate and manage enablement resources, training materials, learning paths, and communications.
  • Plan and facilitate training sessions, workshops, webinars, sales kickoffs, and ongoing learning initiatives.
  • Ensure enablement programs align with business priorities and drive measurable adoption and impact.
  • Track training effectiveness and continuously improve programs based on participant feedback and performance outcomes.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Partner Managers supporting specific regions and vertical markets.
  • Establish team goals, performance metrics, and professional development plans.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide strategic guidance, remove obstacles, and support team success.
  • Ensure alignment between regional partner activities and the overall global partner strategy.

Behaviors & Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, drive organizational transformation, and adapt strategies to changing market conditions.
  • Leadership: Can lead strategic team initiatives, inspire others to take leadership roles, and foster a culture of shared responsibility and continuous improvement.
  • Communication: Can lead and model exceptional communication at all levels of the organization, develop and implement communication strategies, and coach others to improve their communication skills.
  • Collaboration: Can lead complex team projects, inspire others to collaborate effectively, and foster a culture of mutual respect and shared purpose.
  • Problem-Solving: Can lead strategic problem-solving initiatives, inspire others to improve their problem-solving skills, and foster a culture of proactive problem-solving.
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Can lead strategic initiatives focused on improving the overall customer experience. Inspires and mentors others to adopt a customer-centric approach, fostering a culture of customer focus throughout the organization.
  • Results Orientation: Can inspire a culture of results-orientation across the organization, setting high standards and holding everyone accountable for achieving results.
  • Adaptability: Can drive strategic transformations, inspire others to embrace change, and foster a culture of continuous adaptation.
  • Strategic Implementation: Can lead the development and execution of comprehensive strategic plans, inspire and guide teams, and drive organizational change to achieve strategic objectives.
  • Continuous Improvement: Can lead others in identifying and implementing major improvements and proactively drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, Management, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales strategy, partner management, channel management, business development, sales enablement, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing programs, initiatives, and/or teams.
  • Experience managing strategic technology, vendor, reseller, distributor, or alliance partner relationships.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing sales growth strategies and cross-functional business programs.
  • Experience creating, managing, and measuring enablement programs for sales and/or partner organizations.
  • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to derive actionable insights from data.
  • Proven project and program management experience.
  • Experience managing stakeholders across multiple functions and organizational levels.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and public-speaking skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in channel sales, alliance management, or partner ecosystem development.
  • Experience working within global sales organizations.
  • Experience supporting SaaS, technology, cybersecurity, cloud, or enterprise software environments.
  • Prior experience managing direct reports.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms, reporting tools, and sales enablement technologies.

Other Requirements

  • Strategic thinker with a demonstrated ability to align partner strategies, sales initiatives, and enablement programs to broader business objectives.
  • Ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization.
  • Strong relationship-building skills with internal stakeholders, external partners, and executive audiences.
  • Ability to balance long-term strategic planning with day-to-day operational execution.
  • Comfortable leading executive-level presentations, business reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
  • Passion for driving sales effectiveness, partner success, pipeline growth, and revenue acceleration.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally across Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Operations, Learning & Development, and external partner organizations.

jobs.title: Creative Director - Brand Narrative
jobs.excerpt: In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront.
jobs.description:
In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together.

That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable.

We’re looking for a Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative, a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work.

Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting. What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling.

You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing. Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off.

You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.

What you’ll do

In your first year, your focus will be roughly 70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.

  • Originate and lead big creative ideas. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. Develop ideas that can take distinctive forms across film, social, out-of-home, digital, experiences, and partnerships.
  • Bring ambitious concepts to life with your creative peers and the full studio. Work side by side with the Brand Design and Writing leads and their teams from the earliest explorations through delivery. Develop ideas together, exchange thoughtful critique, and make creative choices that draw on each discipline’s expertise. Stay hands-on, contribute through your own craft, and partner closely with Motion and Production throughout. For film, remain closely involved through scripts, visual development, production, and the final edit.
  • Build audience and distribution thinking into the idea. Shape concepts around how people will discover, watch, and share the work. Work with marketing partners to consider channels and viewing contexts from the beginning, so the work belongs where people encounter it rather than simply being resized to fit.
  • Push beyond the first good answer, and learn quickly. Lead thoughtful concept development and critique. Use rough scripts, prototypes, and AI tools to test ideas quickly, learn, and move the strongest work forward. Know when to keep exploring and when to commit, then protect what makes an idea interesting through feedback and production.
  • Find opportunities before a brief arrives. Bring curiosity about Mercury’s products, customers, and the wider world. Develop proactive ideas and cultural opportunities that give the brand something meaningful to say or do.
  • Help decide where creative ambition matters most. Partner early with Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Product Design, Comms, and Insights. Help identify which moments deserve our largest creative investment, present recommendations to senior leadership, and use results from marketing and insights partners to inform what comes next.
  • Build and lead Brand Narrative. Define the team’s purpose, priorities, creative standards, and ways of working. Help hire and develop the team, shaping its structure and capabilities. Set clear expectations, and coach people to grow their judgment and conceptual strength.
  • Create a culture where the best idea wins. Make room for experimentation, honest feedback, and contributions across disciplines. Lead with generosity and conviction, share ownership of the work, and help people challenge one another without making creativity a competition for credit.
  • Build practices that strengthen the work. Establish a clear path from insight and an agreed brief to concept and execution, with useful critique and close collaboration throughout. Develop relationships with external creatives and agencies who can add a distinctive perspective or capability when needed.

What you’ll bring

  • A strong creative foundation in art direction, design, or copywriting. Your portfolio shows original concepts developed into ambitious, well-crafted work across multiple formats. You can explain what you contributed, how the idea evolved, and how collaboration made it better.
  • Deep film experience. You’ve developed film-led ideas from concept through production, with strong instincts for story, scripts, performance, pacing, and sound. You understand how these choices work together to make an audience feel something, not just make a film look good.
  • A track record of deep creative collaboration with design and writing peers. You’ve led ambitious multidisciplinary work from concept through production by building trusted partnerships. You bring a clear point of view, listen closely, work through creative disagreements constructively, and recognize when someone else’s approach makes the work stronger. You can show how your collaborators shaped the outcome, not just what you personally originated.
  • Strong taste, cultural awareness, and product curiosity. You can get close to a complex business or product, find the human truth within it, and turn that understanding into something clear, surprising, and memorable.
  • Experience developing creative people and shaping how a team works. You give specific, useful feedback, set a high bar with care, and create an environment where people can take creative risks. You’re excited to build a new function, including the everyday practices that give it a culture.
  • Clear communication and sound judgment. You can rally people around an ambitious concept, explain why it deserves investment, and navigate competing perspectives without losing the idea. You take ownership in ambiguous situations and balance creative ambition with the need to move work forward.

What success looks like

A year in, you’ll have led major launches and film-led campaigns from original concept through finished work, with Brand Design and Writing as creative partners from the beginning. The studio’s disciplines will have shaped the work together, with audience and distribution informing the creative approach.

Brand Narrative will have a clear identity, shared creative standards, and working practices that help people test and develop stronger ideas together. Alongside planned launches, you’ll have established a pipeline of proactive opportunities that gives Mercury more ways to express its product ambition with originality and cultural relevance.

Please include a portfolio featuring film-led work and broader campaign concepts. We’d love to understand your role in developing the ideas, the choices you made through production, and how you brought the work to life with others.

Qué es Deazy
Deazy es una plataforma/marketplace de UK que conecta empresas que necesitan desarrollo de software con agencias de desarrollo en todo el mundo. Ellos consiguen el cliente, definen el proyecto y luego lo asignan a una agencia como Somnio para ejecutarlo. Básicamente son un intermediario entre el cliente final y nosotros.

Cómo funciona el modelo
Deazy factura al cliente final a su propia tarifa (en este caso están hablando de EUR 47/h, aunque todavía hay que confirmar si ese es el rate al cliente o lo que pagan al proveedor). Nosotros le facturamos a Deazy a un rate más bajo, y la diferencia es su margen.
Por eso la tarifa introductoria que les estamos ofreciendo es USD 45/h - USD 40/h — pensada para que Deazy tenga margen cómodo y nos priorice y abrir la cuenta

Si la relación funciona, Deazy nos puede asignar proyectos de forma recurrente sin que nosotros tengamos que salir a conseguirlos. Es un canal de ventas indirecto, ellos traen el cliente, nosotros entregamos.
El volumen potencial es importante si nos posicionamos bien con ellos.

Deazy nos conoce principalmente como agencia Flutter. El trabajo ahora es mostrarles que también somos fuertes en React Native, React, , Python y AI

Highlights

Tienen un proyecto de React Native de aprox 40 horas por mes, para soporte.
Con ingles, perfil fuerte que abra la cuenta.

Job Title: Clinical Applications Specialist - Periop (Bilingual)

As the Clinical Application Specialist (CAS), you will deliver technical and clinical expertise within the Patient Care Solution portfolio by providing excellent education and training support to clinical end-users. At GE HealthCare, we’re building a healthier world by delivering innovative medical technologies and digital solutions that matter. As a Clinical Application Specialist (CAS), you’ll play a critical role in transforming clinical workflows and enhancing patient care by supporting the adoption and optimization of our peri-operative & digital solutions.

Exigence linguistique : Une maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, est obligatoire. Vous devez être à l’aise d’animer des formations cliniques et des discussions avec les clients dans les deux langues.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in the Peri-Operative care areas
  • Support clinical end user adoption to GEHC Patient Care products including : Anesthesia & Respiratory Care, Centricity High Acuity clinical information system & Peri-Operative Patient Monitoring solutions.

  • Coordinate, schedule, and execute clinical system training, monitor, and report on training outcomes. Training may be conducted onsite at customer facility and / or virtually.
  • Work in close collaboration with Product Marketing Team, identify customer satisfaction opportunities, issues, assist in escalations, problem determination and specialty training requests.
  • Develop meaningful relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs)
  • Participate in install base upgrade programs, proactive strategic customer touchpoints.
  • Drive sales process by conducting clinical product demonstrations and onsite evaluations.

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree or equivalent with 3+ years of Anesthesia technical/clinical industry experience
  • Must be a Registered Respiratory Therapist (CSRT, Provincial body) with Anesthesia Assistant as a Preferred qualifications.
  • Deep understanding of clinical education training and associated process implementation.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering complex information and modifying messaging based on audience.
  • Willingness to travel extensively 60+% within a region (including overnights and some weekends) within the US and Canada via multiple modes of transportation (car, air travel, & train, etc.).
  • Willingness to submit to a check of your driving record (given that you are applying for a position that requires you to operate a GE HealthCare owned/leased, privately owned/leased or rental vehicle for company business).
  • Comply to GEHC Quality Manual, Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy, Quality Goals, and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position.
  • It is a condition of hire that any new employee or contract worker that will provide products or services to a GE HealthCare customer facility are fully vaccinated and provide proof of vaccinations. All offers of employment are conditional upon the satisfaction of this requirement.

Desired Characteristics

  • The ideal candidate will live in Central Quebec * Greater Montreal Area
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.
  • Strong presentation skills (public speaking and lecture experience desired)
  • Willingness to adopts new technologies such as virtual facilitator skills.
  • A team player with a strong work ethic. Demonstrating willingness to do more to achieve shared outcomes.

Vos responsabilités

  • Être l’expert : Agir en tant qu’expert en soins périopératoires, y compris en anesthésie, soins respiratoires et surveillance des patients.
  • Favoriser l’adoption : Soutenir les utilisateurs cliniques dans l’adoption des technologies GE HealthCare telles que les solutions d’anesthésie et de soins respiratoires (ARC), Centricity High Acuity Anesthesia (CHAA) et les systèmes de surveillance périopératoire (PM).
  • Diriger la formation : Concevoir et offrir des formations percutantes — sur site ou virtuellement — adaptées aux besoins des clients et aux flux de travail cliniques.
  • Soutenir l’innovation : Faciliter le déploiement de nouvelles fonctionnalités et collaborer avec les clients pour élaborer des plans de formation stratégiques.
  • Collaborer en équipe : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes marketing, ventes et services pour assurer une mise en œuvre fluide et la satisfaction des clients.
  • Établir des relations : Développer des partenariats solides avec les leaders d’opinion clés (KOL).
  • Soutenir les ventes : Réaliser des démonstrations cliniques de produits et des évaluations sur site.
  • Assurer la qualité : Participer aux programmes de mise à niveau de l’installation et maintenir un contact proactif avec les clients pour garantir la performance optimale des systèmes.

Profil recherché & Qualifications requises

  • Diplôme d’études collégiales ou équivalent avec au moins 5 ans d’expérience clinique en anesthésie ou en soins respiratoires.
  • Certification de Thérapeute respiratoire autorisé (membre OPIQ, CSRT et permis provincial requis).
  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit — obligatoire.
  • Solide compréhension des méthodes de formation clinique et de mise en œuvre des processus.
  • Capacité démontrée à communiquer des informations complexes à divers publics.
  • Disponibilité à voyager fréquemment (60 % et plus), y compris les nuitées et certains week-ends.
  • Permis de conduire valide et dossier de conduite sans infraction.
  • Conformité au système de gestion de la qualité de GE HealthCare et aux exigences de vaccination.

Atouts souhaités

  • Certification d’assistant en anesthésie (un atout important).
  • Expérience en prise de parole en public, animation virtuelle et principes d’apprentissage des adultes.
  • Compétences solides en planification, documentation et présentation.
  • Esprit d’équipe, approche proactive et éthique de travail rigoureuse.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

About the role:

Join K Health as we partner with the nation's top-rated hospital systems to close care gaps by launching completely Virtual Comprehensive Care Clinics. We are seeking a full-time, board-certified Family Nurse Practitioners who will deliver fully remote text and video-based acute care, encompassing preventive care, sick visits, and chronic condition management. The ideal candidate must be licensed in FL, NJ, NY, MA and/or hold active NLC. You will be responsible for maintaining a strong rapport with your patients, representing K Health and our clinical partners, while providing world-class remote care. You are comfortable practicing the full spectrum of comprehensive care, including pediatrics and mental health. Work from the comfort of your home and deliver care to those who need it the most, backed by K Health's cutting-edge clinical-grade AI Platform. Our virtual clinics are fully supported 24/7 by a dedicated team of Care Concierge, Clinical Operations, and technical support staff, which greatly reduces your administrative burden.

What you'll be doing:

  • Provide video-based, comprehensive clinical care that encompasses Acute Care, including pediatrics and mental health
  • Work regular weekend day shifts (7a-7p Sat & Sun +1 Weekday)
  • Support physicians with Epic inbox management (labs, imaging, patient questions, etc.)
  • Educate patients on appropriate treatments and care plans for their health needs
  • Prescribe medication and refills as appropriate
  • Drive high-quality care with a focus on patient outcomes
  • Elevate remote care; provide compassionate and meaningful care
  • Think on your feet to devise creative solutions to problems that arise or escalate as appropriate
  • Collaborate with Care Team Members
  • Perform against challenging goals with a best-in-class team

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of clinical practice experience as a Family Nurse Practitioner in a Primary Care setting
  • Licensed in FL, NJ, NY, MA and/or hold active NLC
  • Must have min 1 year of experience using Epic EMR
  • Must be currently enrolled, or eligible for enrollment, as a Medicare provider
  • Primary care experience and behavioral health experience, ability to treat both acute and chronic care conditions
  • Should be tech-savvy, proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and have telemedicine experience
  • Clean background and medical malpractice history
  • Willing to work weekend hours, 36 hours per week (7a-7p Sat & Sun +1 Weekday)

Benefits & Perks:

  • Malpractice insurance coverage
  • Work from anywhere in the US
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401k benefit
  • Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance options
  • CME Allowance
Compensation:
$170,000—$210,000 USD

Who We Are:

Behind every leading health system is K Health’s AI-powered virtual care engine.

Esteemed health systems like Mayo Clinic, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Hackensack Meridian Health, and Hartford Healthcare partner with K Health to build and run modern primary virtual care clinics on their behalf.

Our deeply integrated model modernizes the primary care loop by using AI to put humans first. For our patients, we offer clinical AI (i.e., PatientGPT) and unparalleled access to close care gaps around the clock. For our Providers, we deliver provider-serving agentic solutions (i.e., Perfect Note) to eliminate administrative overload and burnout. jobs.description:
CTEC is a leading technology firm that provides modernization, digital transformation, and application development services to the U.S. Federal Government. Headquartered in McLean, VA, CTEC has over 300 team members working on mission-critical systems and projects for agencies such as the Department of Homeland Security, Internal Revenue Service, and the Office of Personnel Management. The work we do effects millions of U.S. citizens daily as they interact with the systems we build. Our best-in-class commercial solutions, modified for our customers’ bespoke mission requirements, are enabling this future every day.

The Company has experienced rapid growth over the past 3 years and recently received a strategic investment from Main Street Capital Corporation (NYSE: MAIN). In addition to our recent growth in Federal Civilian agencies, we are seeking to expand our capabilities in cloud development and footprint in national-security focused agencies within the Department of Defense and U.S. Intelligence Community.

CTEC is seeking a Senior Instructional Systems Designer to join our team. In this role, you will support the analysis, design, development, delivery and deployment of relevant, high-quality learning assets and experiences. These assets and experiences will be delivered via classroom, virtual, and hybrid modalities.

Responsibilities

Analysis and Design: Lead the analysis, design, and development of learning assets

  • Complete analysis on existing/provided content to recognize gaps, create learning objectives, and make recommendations to create a framework for development
  • Create analysis and design documents incorporating varying levels of interactivity, and learner engagement, leveraging adult learning theory using the ADDIE model.
  • Create storyboards for on-line and virtual instructor-led learning assets
  • Create instructional materials, including courses, curriculum, student guides, and training manuals
  • Leverage AI tools such as CoPilot and ChatGPT to improve design and development proficiency
  • Design content to enhance learning outcomes, ensuring alignment with learner needs.
  • Create and deliver training that adheres to client quality standards, technical criteria, and complies with Section 508 accessibility standards

Experiential Learning Focus: Incorporate experiential learning principles to create immersive and impactful training assets

  • Design, develop and deliver learning experiences including interactive stories, games, simulations, and other assets using client approved tools.
  • Apply creative approaches and innovative thinking to enhance the effectiveness and engagement of learning experiences

Collaborate and Communicate: Engage with instructional designers and subject matter experts as required to assess training needs, develop concepts, and recommend training strategies.

  • Collaborate with a Project Manager to maintain project schedules, monitor progress against milestones, identify risks to timelines, and ensure instructional design deliverables meet established deadlines
  • Set and manage team expectations across the instructional design lifecycle, proactively addressing risks, resolving conflicts, and professionally challenging client and team decisions when necessary to ensure high‑quality, on‑time delivery

Authoring Tools

  • Leverage authoring tools (such as Lectora, Adobe Captivate, or Articulate Storyline) to develop interactive and engaging learning experiences

Design Visual and Audio Elements

  • Create visual, audio, and interactive learning storyboards to enhance engagement
  • Familiarity with tools such as Vyond, Camtasia, or Adobe After Effects
  • Leverage text to speech tools in the development of learning assets

Qualifications:

Logistics:

  • East coast core hours of 9am to 3pm
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection

Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Instructional Design or other related field from an accredited college or university
  • Minimum 8 years of experience working as a senior instructional systems designer
  • Experience designing and developing courses with Lectora or similar authoring tools

Design and Quality: Ensure instructional content is accurate, consistent, and aligned with quality standards, while adhering to Section 508 accessibility requirements.

Work Environment:

  • Ability to work closely with subject matter experts and cross-functional teams including strong facilitation and analysis skills
  • Exhibit strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Exhibit ability to lead a team through a learning asset development lifecycle
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Experience working on multiple projects simultaneously
  • Demonstrate strong information technology skills specifically working in the Microsoft Teams and SharePoint environments

Clearance Requirement: Preferred Active WAU public trust clearance. Candidates must be U.S. citizens and able to obtain and maintain the required clearance.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role

Motive is seeking a Director of Commercial Sales & Account Management to lead a growing offshore team focused on expansion and retention within our CMRL customer base. This senior leader will own Net ARR growth through a combination of upsell/cross-sell strategy and strategic renewals management.

As a second-line leader, you'll oversee a team of 100+ offshore Account Managers and sellers who manage complex customer relationships across multiple industries and product lines. This is a customer-facing, results-oriented role that blends sales leadership with lifecycle strategy. You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Customer Support, and Onboarding to deliver a seamless customer experience from first sale through renewal.

We're looking for a sales leader who thrives in high-growth environments, understands the nuances of SMB/Commercial relationship management, and has a track record of building consultative, value-driven teams.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, PostgreSQL
jobs.excerpt: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care.
jobs.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Software Engineer IV to join our Datastore team. The Datastore sits at the heart of Beacon's platform. It defines our foundational data model and serves as the centralized repository and API for brain data collected from clinical studies, supporting the analytical tools, services, and applications used by our scientists, clinicians, and partners.

This role emphasizes the design and scaling of backend systems for data infrastructure: PostgreSQL data models, Kafka-driven event pipelines, and the GraphQL API that makes scientific and clinical data usable - distinct from frontend development or end-user product surfaces. At this level you will lead the design of complex systems within the Datastore rather than individual components, own the pipelines that deliver dataset snapshots into our warehouse, and collaborate across platform, application and scientific teams to implement APIs that unlock new workflows in Beacon's expanding portfolio of clinical studies and digital health products.

You should have experience writing complex SQL queries by hand, and should be prepared to reason about schema design, indexes, and query behavior as a matter of course.

Two properties of our system that shape our work may influence your application. Our GraphQL API is generated from the PostgreSQL schema using PostGraphile, so a schema decision is an API decision. Secondly, row-level security is in force on effectively every table, because clinical data from different studies and partners shares one schema, with some rows shared for access by multiple internal teams. RLS predicates get injected into your queries, which makes reasoning about query plans genuinely harder here than it is in most places. If that sounds interesting rather than tedious, you'll enjoy this team.

We are hiring two engineers into this role, with two different centers of gravity. One will focus on the breadth of the Datastore: the event pipelines, the GraphQL API, core data models, and third-party integrations. The other will focus on depth in PostgreSQL (data modeling, performance tuning, operations) and supporting all engineers in developing schemas and the access controls that protect clinical data. The core requirements are the same. Tell us which one you are most drawn to in your application.

This role is 100% remote from anywhere in the U.S. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs in Boston, New York City, and Paris.

What success looks like

  • You lead design and architecture for complex projects and systems within the Datastore, weighing implementation trade-offs with engineering principles and backing your decisions with data rather than preference
  • You partner with product managers, scientific and clinical stakeholders, and other development and support teams to translate their requirements into new integrations, services, and solutions for scaling Beacon's data platform - contributing to broader product and technical decisions, not simply implementing them
  • You debug and profile ambiguous problems that cross system boundaries, including codebases beyond the Datastore's purview, and you leave what you touch better than you found it — structure, test coverage, tooling
  • Peers look to your work as an example: you implement features with attention to detail, demonstrating product awareness and high standards for data integrity, design soundness, and maintainability across the lifespan of the system
  • You draft RFCs to lead complex feature discovery and technical design phases, soliciting and incorporating input, and helping your team align on a set of decisions to guide development
  • You plan your own work and contribute to planning the team's, making reasoned trade-offs between speed, generalizability, and technical debt, and accounting for the needs of multiple stakeholder teams
  • You teach and mentor other engineers regularly, give feedback that people act on, and are sought out for it. You may act as tech lead on a project or as the coordination point for engineering practice within the team
  • You leverage feedback from internal stakeholders and external partners to improve operational robustness and ease of use of the Datastore and its services via new documentation, tools, and dashboards

What you will bring

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, including at least 3 years focused on data platforms and backend infrastructure for data-centric applications: transactional systems, event pipelines, and the APIs that serve them
  • Highly proficient in at least one technical area relevant to this work: data modeling, distributed systems, API design, or database engineering, with the depth that others on a team come to you for
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, with production experience working with PostgreSQL as an application database; you write and tune queries fluently and are comfortable reasoning about schema design, indexes, and query plans
  • Hands-on experience with data streaming and event processing, using Kafka (our event bus) or an equivalent such as RabbitMQ, Pulsar, or a cloud-based equivalent like Amazon Kinesis
  • Proficiency in Julia or Python; Julia is a core Datastore language, and experience with Julia is a strong plus, but not required — we welcome candidates eager to learn it!
  • Experience deploying and operating services in containerized environments, with familiarity in Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and/or Helm
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and improving how a team works - practices, tooling, test coverage, or documentation that outlasted your involvement
  • A collaborative mindset: you enjoy working across disciplines and believe people achieve more together than alone
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous and remote-friendly environments
  • A self-directed approach, with a track record of thriving in hybrid or fully remote teams
  • Experience with, or interest in, using LLM-assisted or agentic coding tools in a production setting, with good judgment about what guardrails are needed

For the Datastore Systems role:

  • You can lead design across the breadth of the platform.
  • GraphQL and TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js) - GraphQL is the Datastore's primary interface, and this profile owns significant parts of it
  • Designing event-driven pipelines end to end: producers, consumers, replay, idempotency, and what happens when a consumer falls behind
  • Leading the design of complex systems rather than individual components, across the API, the pipelines, and the services that depend on them

For the PostgreSQL & Data Modeling role:

  • You can be the person the rest of the team comes to about the database.
  • Deep PostgreSQL: you reason fluently about the query planner, index selection, and EXPLAIN (ANALYZE), and why a query that should be fast isn't
  • Data modeling: you design the schema itself: entities, relationships, and the constraints that make invalid states impossible. Including how to model time, since clinical results get re-scored and corrected and we need to answer "what did this look like when the report was signed?"
  • Schema evolution under load: zero-downtime migrations, dual-write transitions, lock avoidance, backfill and verification. Our schema has hundreds of migrations behind it and will have hundreds more
  • Operating PostgreSQL in production, not only designing for it: upgrades, replication, backup and restore, connection pooling, bloat and vacuum behaviour, extensions
  • Making others good at it: you teach, review, and document, because a schema only stays coherent if the team understands it

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If you bring strong fundamentals, care about data infrastructure for health, and are excited to learn, we’d love to hear from you!

Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

Opportunity

ThermalWorks LLC is seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Manager to serve as the technical quality authority and liaison across our customer field sites, European contract manufacturer sites and internal quality control function. This is a cross-functional, high-visibility role that sits at the intersection of manufacturing, field service, and quality leadership.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience with mission-critical mechanical systems — particularly hydronic cooling, chiller platforms, and data center infrastructure — combined with the discipline and communication skills to document findings clearly and present them to leadership. This role is hands-on and will require mechanical knowledge of HVAC systems as well as quality related processes such as 8D problem solving and Six Sigma methodologies. This position is preferably based in Barcelona, but can also be based in Madrid or Bilbao. This role has a travel requirement of 20-40% depending on where based.

Key Responsibilities

Include but are not limited to:

Factory Quality

  • Support new and existing production at ThermalWorks manufacturing operations in Europe to identify quality concerns for first article inspections or before production units ship
  • Review assembly, wiring, piping, and commissioning documentation against engineering specifications and approved submittals
  • Coordinate findings with factory leadership and flag hold conditions requiring resolution prior to release
  • Document inspection outcomes and provide written reports to the Director of Quality

Customer Site Quality

  • Perform on-site QA/QC inspections at customer data center locations to verify ThermalWorks equipment installation, commissioning, and service work meets required standards
  • Work with EU Director of Operations when customer issues arise
  • Drive 8D problem solving for technical customer issues and coordinate investigation and corrective actions with TW Engineering and Operations personnel
  • Create customer facing reports such as Root Cause Analysis, Plan of Corrective Actions and Technical Bulletins
  • Generate structured inspection reports for each site visit, documenting findings, nonconformances, corrective actions required, and status of resolution

Quality Control Meetings & Reporting

  • Participate in internal QC meetings as the field and factory intelligence source, presenting findings and trends to quality and service leadership
  • Maintain a running log of open quality items across factory and field, tracking status through closure
  • Collaborate with the tech support group to surface recurring field issues that may indicate systemic quality or design concerns
  • Support the development and refinement of inspection checklists, MOPs, SOPs, and QA/QC documentation standards

Director of Quality

Primary reporting relationship. Drives QC meeting participation, documentation standards, and quality findings escalation.

Field Operations

Coordinates site scheduling, field logistics, and alignment with field service teams during on-site inspections.

Tech Support

Interfaces on technical issue resolution with customers, recurring fault patterns, and field support coverage.

Factory Leadership

Engages during factory visits for inspection coordination, build quality review, and pre-shipment hold authority.

Education and Experience

Required

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in HVAC/mechanical systems or industrial equipment manufacturing
  • 4+ years of experience in a Quality position (engineer, supervisor, manager)
  • Demonstrated QA/QC experience on construction, commissioning, or service projects in data center or critical infrastructure environments
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, submittals, MOPs, SOPs, and EAPs
  • Strong written documentation skills — inspection reports, nonconformance logs, and findings summaries must be clear and actionable
  • Willingness and ability to travel to factory and field sites on a regular basis
  • Proficiency with BAS/BMS platforms for system verification during site inspections
  • Fluency in Spanish

Preferred

  • Experience with commercial or mission-critical HVAC/mechanical systems including chillers, hydronic loops, cooling towers, and associated controls
  • Experience with Turbocor centrifugal chiller platforms
  • Familiarity with dry cooler or adiabatic cooling systems
  • Prior experience presenting quality findings to management-level audiences
  • Background in instructor-level training or technical mentorship
  • Experience reviewing RFIs and equipment submittals
  • Fluency in Catalan

This position is structured for a senior technical professional who wants more than a wrench and a work order. You will be the quality intelligence function for ThermalWorks — the person who sees our product built, sees it in the field, and has a seat at the table where quality decisions get made. Your findings carry weight. Your reports go to leadership. Your site visits carry the authority of the Quality Control function.

ThermalWorks is a fast-growing manufacturer of adaptive dry cooling systems for hyperscale data center applications, operating within a vertically integrated infrastructure platform. This is a ground-floor opportunity to build a quality function that scales with the business.

Endeavour is rethinking the infrastructure model for the benefit of all. Instead of relying on big, centralized systems that often leave communities locked into outdated networks, we are building an integrated technology stack using modular components that can be repeated and scaled. Operating as a purpose trust, we create a continual cycle of innovation by investing in breakthrough technologies to build faster, cleaner infrastructure for data, energy, materials, and water.

We tackle the industry’s most complex challenges by deploying scalable, modular solutions across the AI ecosystem—including carbon-neutral energy and revolutionary data center cooling. To work at Endeavour is to collaborate with proven experts, cut through the unnecessary to get things done, and know you are making a lasting impact on people and the planet.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

The Repayment Scheduling engineering team is growing rapidly, and we're looking for a Senior Software Engineer specializing in Backend development. We're a Backend team located entirely in Europe within the same time zone, but culturally rooted in Silicon Valley. We build and own the system that enables our users to automate their payments, at a scale of up to $40B each year. We directly own the configuration and orchestration of those payments. We directly improve the financial lives of over 20 million people, giving them peace of mind that their payments will be made on time.

Our work is agile and fast-paced, shipping new code to production every two-week sprint, and rigorously measuring the impact it has on our users' lives and company financials. This role rewards curiosity, ownership, and a builder's mindset. You'll know exactly what your objectives are, you'll have what you need to hit them, and you'll choose your own path to get there. You'll learn quickly from experienced teammates and grow your craft on problems that matter at scale.

If you want to build something new and operate it at scale – come join us!

What You'll Do

  • You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What We Look For

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Pay Grade- N

Equity Grade- 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

POL base pay range per year: 308,000 zł - 428,000 zł

Additional benefits include:

  • Flexible Spending Wallets for tech, food and lifestyle
  • Away Days - wellness days to take off work and recharge
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Parental benefits
  • Employee Resource & Community Groups

This role is eligible for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law and company policy

Location - Remote Poland

The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Poland.

**This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.**

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
  • Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
