jobs.excerpt: About AlphaSense: The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making.
jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

The Team:

AlphaSense’s Design team is a strategic driver of product differentiation, shaping how the world’s leading companies make high-stakes decisions with confidence. We believe great UX is not just about usability, it’s about deeply understanding our customers’ workflows and building experiences that feel tailored, intelligent, and indispensable to how they work.
As AlphaSense evolves into an AI-native platform, Design plays a critical role in defining how AI shows up in real workflows, from search to synthesis to decision-making. We partner closely with Product and Engineering to turn complex data and advanced AI capabilities into cohesive, intuitive, and high-quality experiences.
Our team is a global group of craftspeople, systems thinkers, and innovators who care deeply about quality, velocity, and impact. We operate with a strong sense of ownership, a bias toward action, and a commitment to raising the bar for what great product design looks like in an AI-first world.

About the Role:
We are seeking a Principal Design Engineer to play a key role in shaping the future of AlphaSense’s product experience. This is a senior individual contributor role, where you’ll lead through craft, systems thinking, and technical excellence, building AI-powered experiences that feel tailored, intelligent, and essential to our customers’ workflows.
You will operate at the intersection of design, engineering, and product strategy, translating complex, data-rich problems into high-quality, production-ready experiences. You won’t just prototype ideas; you’ll define how they are built, scaled, and experienced in the product.
As a senior member of the Design team, you’ll act as a multiplier—mentoring others, guiding technical and design decisions, and strengthening the connection between user needs, business goals, and engineering realities.

Why this role matters
At AlphaSense, design is a core driver of how we win. As we build an AI-native platform, the quality of our user experience will define how effectively customers can navigate complexity, build conviction, and make decisions.
In this role, you will help define that standard—through the systems you build, the experiences you ship, and the team you help elevate.

What You’ll Do

  • Create high-fidelity, coded prototypes and interaction models that bring complex, AI-powered workflows to life and clearly communicate product direction.
  • Own high-impact initiatives from concept through production, shipping experiences that reflect strong design thinking, technical rigor, and a deep understanding of customer workflows.
  • Lead technical design discussions, make architectural decisions, and guide cross-team implementation efforts.
  • Advance AlphaSense’s design system as a core piece of product infrastructure—defining scalable patterns, enabling consistency, and accelerating teams building across AI-native experiences.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to research and evaluate user requirements, translate them into effective designs, and ensure that the final product meets both user and business needs.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams during development, advocating for design quality and user experience by championing design fidelity and attention to detail throughout the development lifecycle.

Design Leadership & Team Impact

  • Act as a senior leader within the Design team, mentoring designers and engineers, raising the bar for craft, and contributing to a strong, collaborative design culture.
  • Serve as connective tissue across design, product, and engineering—helping teams navigate tradeoffs between technical constraints, business goals, and user experience to deliver high-quality outcomes.

Who You Are

  • 12+ years of experience in product design, design/UX/front-end engineering, design systems, or a related discipline.
  • A bachelor’s degree or higher. A degree in design, computer science, information sciences, psychology, or human-computer interaction is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with modern front-end technologies (e.g., HTML/CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React) and evolving design systems.
  • Experience building AI and agentic experiences, and you are already leveraging AI to speed up and augment your end-to-end design and development process.
  • Expertise with modern AI technologies and ability to apply them to design problems (e.g., MCP, Claude Code, Codex, Skills).
  • Experience shipping production-ready experiences and influencing technical and design choices across teams.
  • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, end-to-end customer workflows, and the ability to turn new users into habitual users.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience in project leadership, mentorship, and providing constructive feedback to foster professional growth.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

Odyssey Reinsurance Company (OdysseyRe) is the global reinsurance arm of Odyssey Group, one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance and specialty insurance. OdysseyRe offers a broad range of property, casualty, and specialty reinsurance products, providing capital and risk management solutions for clients to efficiently manage economic risk through a network of branch and representative offices across North America, Latin America, EMEA (Europe, Middle East & Africa), AsiaPacific and London.

OdysseyRe is an equal opportunity employer with excellent benefits and a strong commitment to providing training and opportunities for our staff. We provide employees an innovative, enriching environment and take great pride in their career growth.

OdysseyRe is rated A+ (Superior) by AM Best and AA- (Very Strong) by Standard and Poor’s. Odyssey Group is a subsidiary of Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited, which is traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol FFH.

About the company

Odyssey Reinsurance Company (OdysseyRe) is the global reinsurance arm of Odyssey Group, one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance and specialty insurance. OdysseyRe offers a broad range of property, casualty, and specialty reinsurance products, providing capital and risk management solutions for clients to efficiently manage economic risk, through a network of branch and representative offices across North America, Latin America, EMEA (Europe, Middle East & Africa), AsiaPacific and London.

OdysseyRe is rated A+ (Superior) by AM Best and AA- (Very Strong) by Standard and Poor’s. Odyssey Group is a subsidiary of Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited, which is traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol FFH.

Position description

The Credit Analyst is responsible for reviewing P&C reinsurer credit risk, managing reinsurer and reinsurance recoverable database, and quarterly reporting of reinsurance accounting information. This role ensures the accurate flow of reinsurance accounting information between globally located business units and the parent company.

Responsibilities and duties

  • Evaluate credit risks of over 1,500 P&C reinsurers through research and modeling of credit risk measures.
  • Set up and maintain Power BI database and reports.
  • Manage a reinsurer profile database of over 1,500 companies.
  • Liaise with over twenty-five globally located business units to collect reinsurance recoverable balance and counterparty information on a quarterly basis.
  • Create and distribute quarterly reports on reinsurance recoverable balances: database of reinsurer profile and consolidated balances and quarter-over-quarter variance analysis reports.
  • Track insurance company corporate actions: mergers and acquisitions, name changes, and operating status changes.
  • Track financial strength rating changes by major rating agencies.
  • Answer queries from globally located business units.

Qualifications

  • Experience in financial or credit analysis, typically gained through 4+ years of relevant work experience.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Access, and Power BI.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with global stakeholders.
  • Experience in the P&C insurance industry and/or reinsurance accounting is preferred.
  • Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience will be considered.

We are an E-Verify employer - all hired positions require successfully passing an E-Verify Check.

jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

This role is part of the Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) function within Mozilla's Security team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise, and GRC functions across the organization, aligned with the mission to build a safe and secure internet. This role is responsible for maintaining and advancing Mozilla's Information Security Management System (ISMS) and supporting our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 compliance programs — from policy and control design through audit readiness and certification.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience across the full breadth of a compliance program, is comfortable building process where none yet exists, and works well with a wide range of cross-functional stakeholders.

What you'll do:
  • Maintain and mature the ISMS, including the Statement of Applicability (SoA), risk treatment plans, and the Management Review Meeting (MRM) process and cadence.
  • Support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 audit execution—helping determine scope, preparing evidence and narrative artifacts, participating in auditor interviews and walkthroughs, and resolving auditor findings.
  • Contribute to the SOC 2 System Description and other audit-specific narrative documentation, ensuring they accurately reflect the organization's actual control environment.
  • Track gaps and remediation efforts arising from readiness assessments and audits.
  • Lead the policy program—driving policy creation, revision, and cross-functional review cycles to keep the security policy set current, enforceable, and audit-ready.
  • Support compliance scaling as additional products or business units pursue readiness assessments and certification.
  • Support the internal audit function, partnering with internal or third-party resources as needed to meet ISO 27001's internal audit requirements.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, IT, Legal, Privacy, People teams, and product leadership to gather evidence, drive control ownership, and translate compliance requirements into practical, adoptable practices.
  • Advise the GRC manager and broader Security leadership on audit risk, certification readiness, and compliance program strategy.
What you'll bring:
  • 5 years of experience in information security, GRC, or compliance-focused roles.
  • Deep familiarity with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, gained through meaningful involvement in audits from readiness through certification.
  • Comfort operating across the full breadth of an ISMS—SoA maintenance, Management Review Meetings, and System Description authorship.
  • Demonstrated experience writing and revising security policies, including running cross-functional review cycles to gain organization-wide buy-in and adoption.
  • Experience tracking gaps and remediation plans and connecting that work to an organization's broader compliance and risk program.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills—comfortable working with engineers, product managers, legal, and executive stakeholders, and able to translate compliance requirements into practical, actionable workflows.
  • Ability to ramp up quickly and operate with a high degree of independence.
  • Comfort building processes where none yet exist.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to represent Mozilla credibly and confidently in front of external auditors.
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer) are a plus.
Commitment to our values:
  • Welcoming differences
  • Being relationship-minded
  • Practicing responsible participation
  • Having grit
What you'll get:
  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees—we share in our success as one team.
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute).
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together.
  • Country-specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday.
  • One-time home office stipend.
  • Annual professional development budget.
  • Quarterly well-being stipend.
  • Considerable paid parental leave.
  • Employee referral bonus program.
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc.—varies by country).

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. jobs.excerpt: SR.  ACCOUNT MANAGER, INDUSTRY NAKemira is a global leader in sustainable chemistry for water-intensive industries.
jobs.description:
SR. ACCOUNT MANAGER, INDUSTRY NA

Kemira is a global leader in sustainable chemistry for water-intensive industries. For more than 100 years, our chemistry has advanced human progress and quality of life. We call it chemistry with a purpose, better every day. At Kemira, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work culture that empowers our employees to thrive and make a difference. Learn more about Kemira at kemira.com/careers.

We are now looking for an Sr.Account Manager, Industry NA to join our Water Solutions business unit. This role is ideal for a commercially driven sales professional with a proven record of growing industrial chemical sales, managing high-value customer portfolios, and building long-term customer relationships that support sustainable business growth.

Water Solutions offers a wide range of innovative solutions to optimize all stages of the water treatment process while safely achieving water quality targets and meeting constantly tightening regulations. The business serves both municipal and industrial customers globally, with strong growth ambitions in the North American industrial market.

This position can be remote, but proximity to a major airport is a plus.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Driving profitable growth across assigned industrial accounts, including identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities.
  • Managing and expanding a significant sales portfolio, with preferred experience supporting approximately $25 million or more in annual sales revenue.
  • Building strong direct customer relationships while also managing and developing indirect sales channels, including distributors and resellers.
  • Demonstrating a strong hunting mindset to pursue new opportunities, while also farming and protecting existing business through long-term customer partnerships.
  • Providing technical and commercial support to customers by understanding their needs and positioning Kemira’s industrial water treatment and chemical solutions effectively.
  • Collaborating with internal teams, including R&D, product management, supply chain, and customer service, to ensure customer satisfaction and business continuity.
  • Preparing and delivering compelling presentations, proposals, and business reviews to customers and internal stakeholders.

What you’ll bring to the team:

  • Proven success growing sales in industrial chemicals, water treatment, or a closely related technical B2B environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop new business and expand existing accounts through both direct sales and indirect channel strategies.
  • Experience managing complex, high-value customer relationships and delivering measurable revenue growth.
  • Strong commercial discipline, negotiation skills, and ability to convert customer needs into value-based solutions.
  • Technical curiosity and credibility with the ability to partner with customers on industrial process, water treatment, or chemical application challenges.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize opportunities, and collaborate effectively across functions and geographies.
  • A growth-oriented mindset aligned with Kemira Principles: Focus on Growth, Deliver Value, and Collaborate to Succeed.
  • A technical background in coagulants, flocculants, defoamers and dispersants would be a plus.

What you can expect from us:

  • Challenging, interesting, and varied work in a global company with strong growth ambitions in industrial water treatment.
  • A collaborative culture based on Kemira Principles: Focus on Growth, Collaborate to Succeed, and Deliver Value.
  • The opportunity to make a direct impact by helping customers improve water-intensive operations through sustainable chemistry.
  • An attractive salary, benefits package, and discretionary bonus scheme.
  • The starting base salary range for this role is between $120,000 to $140,000 per year. Salary ranges may vary depending on location and local market conditions. The actual starting salary will be determined by various factors, including but not limited to relevant work experience, skills and competencies, qualifications, and wider business and organizational needs.

Ready to create better every day? Join Kemira!

Please apply with a CV at kemira.com/careers.

To ensure a smooth recruitment process, we kindly ask candidates to submit their applications via our recruitment system at kemira.com/careers. Applications sent by email cannot be considered.

We are leading the way to sustained fair pay in the workplace. As a Fair Pay Certified company, we are taking action to enable ongoing equal pay for equal work. This certification demonstrates our commitment to using trusted and transparent methodologies to analyze pay equity. We are proud to share this achievement as part of our dedication to a fair and equitable workplace for everyone.

Kemira is a global leader in sustainable chemistry for water-intensive industries. We operate globally and serve a wide range of customers, including municipal and industrial water treatment companies and the fiber industry. Our solutions and services help secure clean water for millions of people every day and support our customers in advancing circularity and responsible resource use throughout their value chains. In 2025, Kemira reported annual revenue of EUR 2.8 billion with a global team of 4,911 colleagues. Kemira is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki.

jobs.excerpt: Location Designation: Hybrid - 3 days per quarter Business UnitTechnology, Data, AI and Ventures (TDAV)Business Unit OverviewWithin the Tech, Data, AI, Ventures (TDAV) organization, our work is guided by a shared vision: deploying the power of technology, data, AI and ventures to accelerate sustainable competitive advantage for New York Life's businesses.
jobs.description:
Location Designation: Hybrid - 3 days per quarter

Business Unit

Technology, Data, AI and Ventures (TDAV)

Business Unit Overview

Within the Tech, Data, AI, Ventures (TDAV) organization, our work is guided by a shared vision: deploying the power of technology, data, AI and ventures to accelerate sustainable competitive advantage for New York Life's businesses. We build solutions that power how we serve policy owners, agents, advisors and employees while delivering measurable business outcomes.

Across technology, data, AI, cyber, product, digital experience, architecture and infrastructure, TDAV combines the scale and investment of an industry leader, access to leading-edge technologies and the opportunity to help shape how a world-class financial services company competes in the AI era — all backed by the stability and purpose of a mutual company built to last.

Role Overview

The Cyber Security Operations team is seeking a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst to help protect New York Life's enterprise technology environment by monitoring, detecting, investigating, and responding to cyber threats across hybrid and cloud environments. This role combines hands-on incident response, cloud security operations, and threat detection to identify and mitigate evolving cyber risks while strengthening the organization's overall security posture.

As a member of the Security Operations Center, you will leverage SIEM, EDR/XDR, cloud-native security technologies, and threat intelligence to investigate security events, conduct threat hunting, and coordinate incident response activities. You will collaborate with security engineering, cloud platform, infrastructure, and application teams to improve detection capabilities, automate response processes, and support a resilient, secure technology environment.

What You'll Do

  • Monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts and incidents across cloud and on-premises environments using SIEM, EDR/XDR, and cloud-native security platforms, ensuring timely detection, containment, and resolution of cyber threats.

  • Perform threat hunting, malware analysis, and incident investigations involving phishing, ransomware, identity compromise, unauthorized access, and other advanced attack techniques while documenting findings and recommending remediation actions.

  • Analyze security telemetry and logs from cloud platforms, including AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and cloud security services, to identify indicators of compromise, emerging threats, and opportunities to strengthen security controls.

  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks, standard operating procedures, and automation workflows while participating in tabletop exercises, security assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational readiness.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional technology and cybersecurity teams to improve cloud security posture, reduce operational risk, leverage AI-enabled security capabilities, and provide actionable reporting to technical and business stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

Required Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) with 3–4 years of experience in Security Operations, Incident Response, Cyber Defense, or a related cybersecurity discipline.

  • Hands-on experience securing cloud environments using Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including familiarity with cloud-native security services such as AWS GuardDuty, AWS Security Hub, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, or Google Security Command Center.

  • Experience working with SIEM platforms such as Elastic, Splunk, or Google Chronicle, along with EDR/XDR technologies including CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, or Palo Alto Cortex XDR.

  • Strong understanding of incident response methodologies, threat detection, log analysis, cloud identity security, MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, Zero Trust principles, and identity and access management (IAM).

  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, VPNs, firewalls, IDS/IPS, proxy technologies, and the ability to investigate cloud-based attacks, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.

  • Experience with scripting or automation using Python, PowerShell, or Bash, strong analytical and communication skills, and the ability to leverage AI-enabled tools to improve investigation quality and operational efficiency.

Preferred Skills

  • Industry certifications such as GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), AWS Certified Security – Specialty, CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, or comparable cybersecurity certifications.

  • Experience supporting a 24x7 Security Operations Center (SOC), implementing SOAR automation, and developing security orchestration workflows.

  • Familiarity with container security, Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation), and DevSecOps practices.

  • Understanding of AI agents, AI frameworks, AI security risks, and emerging cyber threats targeting AI-enabled applications and platforms.

Success Measures

  • Timely detection, investigation, and response to cybersecurity incidents.

  • Continuous reduction in Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR).

  • Accurate and comprehensive incident documentation, reporting, and root cause analysis.

  • Ongoing improvement of cloud security posture and detection capabilities.

  • Effective collaboration across cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, and application teams to reduce enterprise cyber risk.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $100,000-$143,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Trafilea is a Consumer Tech Platform for Transformative Brand Growth. We’re building the AI Growth Engine that powers the next generation of consumer brands.

Why Trafilea

We’re a tech-led eCommerce group scaling our own globally loved DTC brands, while helping ambitious talent grow just as fast.

🚀 We build and scale our own brands.

Job Responsibilities

At Trafilea, CRO isn’t about running more tests. It’s about finding the right problems to solve and turning customer behavior into measurable growth.

We’re looking for a CRO Manager to own our experimentation process end-to-end—from identifying conversion leaks and building data-grounded hypotheses to prioritizing tests, analyzing results, and turning learnings into business decisions.

You’ll become a key CRO reference across Growth, Acquisition, Product, Creative, and Data, challenging assumptions and ensuring we focus experimentation where it can create the greatest impact.

  • Own the end-to-end CRO process: problem identification → hypothesis → prioritization → execution → analysis.

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The primary purpose and function of the Senior Workday Compensation Analyst is to lead the configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Workday Compensation and Advanced Compensation to support Greystar's global workforce of 30,000+ team members spanning 19 countries. This individual will bring a consulting mindset and exceptional technical depth to the role, serving as a senior functional expert with proven experience delivering full life cycle implementations of both the Compensation and Advanced Compensation modules. This individual will lead initiatives on behalf of the compensation team, regularly communicate with and provide updates to stakeholders across the organization, and ensure compensation programs, salary structures, bonus plans, and merit cycles are accurately configured and aligned with organizational strategy across all applicable Workday modules including HCM, Advanced Compensation, and alignment with Payroll. This role requires demonstrated success operating within a large, diverse, decentralized, and international organization.

JOB DESCRIPTION

• Lead full life cycle implementation of the Workday Compensation and Advanced Compensation modules, including requirements gathering, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, applying a consulting mindset to advise stakeholders on best practices.

• Configure and maintain Workday Compensation and Advanced Compensation including salary plans, grade profiles, merit and bonus plan setup, stock plans, and compensation eligibility rules across a complex, multi-country environment.

• Lead initiatives on behalf of the compensation team, driving projects from scoping through completion and serving as a subject matter expert and mentor within the team.

• Communicate with and provide regular updates to global stakeholders (across Europe, APAC, LATAM and India) across HR, Payroll, Finance, and business leadership on project status, configuration decisions, and compensation cycle progress.

• Configure and maintain collective bargaining compensation setup and related pay structures across multiple countries, ensuring alignment with union agreements and country-specific requirements.

• Administer annual and off-cycle compensation review cycles, including worksheet configuration, approval workflow setup, and cycle launch and close activities.

• Partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, and Total Rewards teams to translate compensation program design into accurate Workday configurations that support operational consistency and data integrity.

• Maintain compensation data integrity by conducting regular audits of salary grades, compensation bands, worker compensation profiles, and plan assignments across the global organization.

Support the design, testing, and deployment of new compensation programs and enhancements within Workday, including requirements gathering, configuration, and user acceptance testing.

• Assist in the analysis and reporting of compensation data, building Workday reports and dashboards to support Total Rewards decision-making, pay equity reviews, and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Manage job profile and compensation grade maintenance, ensuring alignment between Workday configuration and organizational job architecture as roles evolve.

Market Pricing & Benchmarking

About Perceptive Space

Perceptive Space is an AI and aerospace company building space environment intelligence for commercial, civil, and defence operators.

We are building AI-powered space weather forecasting and decision intelligence systems for satellite operators, launch providers, defence and national security customers, and other space infrastructure teams. Our goal is to help customers respond to space environment conditions that affect satellite operations, mission design, launch planning, orbital performance, and mission resilience.

About the Role

  • This is an early-stage startup role. Priorities will change, we move quickly, and urgency matters. We are looking for someone who is energized by high ownership, high expectations, and the pace required to be part of an ambitious company.
  • This role sits at the intersection of research, engineering, and product. One day, you may be reading papers and helping develop foundational AI models for the space environment. The next day, you may be optimizing a production ML pipeline to ensure customers receive accurate, reliable, and operationally useful forecasts.
  • The position is fully remote (in Canada only).

What You’ll Do

  • Build, improve, and ship AI models for space environment forecasting and operational decision support.
  • Improve existing models, develop new ones where needed, and move promising experiments into production.
  • Apply modern deep learning techniques to sequential, temporal, scientific, and sensor datasets.
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools, automation, and modern development workflows to move faster, debug faster, test better, and accelerate experimentation.
  • Turn new research ideas into working systems quickly.
  • Improve ML pipelines so models are easier to train, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and maintain.
  • Define practical evaluation strategies, validation workflows, and performance metrics for operational AI systems.
  • Communicate decisions, results, tradeoffs, risks, and next steps clearly and often.

What We’re Looking For

  • A startup mindset with high ownership and high-velocity, hands-on execution..
  • High leverage with AI-assisted coding tools: you know how to use LLMs and modern development tools to ship faster, debug faster, write better tests, and accelerate experimentation without compromising code quality.
  • Minimum 2+ years of industry experience with modern deep learning architectures for sequential, temporal, or multimodal data, including attention-based models, transformers, representation learning, and model pretraining or fine-tuning workflows.
  • Experience with ML infrastructure tools such as cloud platforms, Airflow, Docker, and related production systems.
  • Advanced degree in engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain technical decisions, experimental results, tradeoffs, and risks.
  • Ability to operate with ownership, urgency, and independence required in a startup environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in early-stage startups.
  • Experience with C, Rust, or other performance-oriented languages.
  • Experience working on aerospace and defence applications.

Why Join Us

  • You will have meaningful ownership in an early-stage company building critical infrastructure for the space economy.
  • You will help build a category-defining product for the operators and missions that depend on space, from commercial aerospace to defence.
  • Your work will directly shape how satellites, launch vehicles, and other space infrastructure are designed, operated, and protected, with real impact for life on Earth and humanity’s progress in space.
  • We are a fully remote team solving technically deep problems with urgent, real-world relevance
  • Ample opportunity for growth

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed to help both sides assess fit for the role, the team, and the way we work.

  • Initial Interview
    A conversation with someone from our team to discuss your work experience, working style, interest in the role, and to share more about Perceptive Space.
  • Technical Panel
    A discussion with a few members of our team to understand the breadth and depth of your ML, engineering, and problem-solving experience, especially in production and deployment settings.
  • Founder Interview
    A conversation with our Founder about the company, role expectations, and what success looks like in this position.
  • Paid Working Session
    Later-stage candidates may be invited to spend a day with us completing a working session on a realistic problem related to the role. You will be compensated for your time. This session is designed to help both sides assess mutual fit.
  • Offer Call
    A final conversation to discuss compensation, benefits, stock options, start date, and next steps.
  • Compensation Base salary will be determined based on seniority, primary work location, and relevant work experience. This role is also eligible for dental, vision and healthcare benefits and stock options.

jobs.description:
Software Engineering Internship Program

Location: Remote (US)*

Duration: 4 months (start in late February 2027)

Hours: 40 hrs/week paid experience

Application Deadline: All interested applicants must apply by November 20, 2026.

The Wikimedia Foundation is the non-profit organization that operates Wikipedia – one of the most popular websites in the world, accessed by over 1.8 billion unique devices every month. It is the only non-profit in the top 50 websites, supported by a community of millions of individual donors around the world.

We are looking for graduates, non-graduates, or those seeking a career change who are interested in developing software engineering skills through an immersive “learn on the job” internship program. As an intern, you will be embedded into an engineering team within our Product and Technology departments and assigned a primary project with clear deliverables. Alongside your manager and dedicated mentor, you will learn the inner workings of our open source code that helps to create “a world in which everyone can freely share in the sum of all knowledge”. You will work with software that serves over half a billion page views per day through Wikipedia (and other Wikimedia projects). The outcome of your work will impact how all people everywhere discover, share, and contribute to free knowledge.

Additionally, you will have the opportunity to learn about various departments at the Foundation and connect with the wider volunteer movement and community.

Applicants who identify from a group that is underrepresented in the global conversation of technology advancement are encouraged to apply. We’re also welcoming applicants from communities where access to free knowledge and Wikimedia projects are just emerging.

PROGRAM DETAILS

Successful candidates must be able to commit to a four month, 40hr/week internship which will fall between late February to late June 2027. We will provide laptops and necessary software installed for the duration of the program. This role is 100% remote, and in some cases there may be potential opportunities to participate in in-person events to meet other fellow interns and teams.

POTENTIAL TEAM OPPORTUNITIES

Mobile Apps Engineering TeamThe Mobile Apps team's primary objective lies in constructing native Android and iOS applications for the Wikimedia Foundation.

EditingThe Editing team is part of the Contributors group. They work on tools for editing across MediaWiki, principally VisualEditor, DiscussionTools, and Edit check. The team is currently working on Suggestion Mode, a feature for the VisualEditor that proactively suggests actions that people can consider taking to improve Wikipedia articles.

Data Platform EngineeringThe Mission of the Data Platform Engineering team is to empower Wiki Communities and the Wikimedia Foundation to gain insights, conduct research, and build compelling user experiences, through access to privacy-aware data and data platform services. The Data Platform is a collection of systems and services providing end-to-end capabilities for our data producers and consumers to collect, discover, and use data.

Release EngineeringThe Release Engineering team enables developers to confidently build, test, and deploy code changes across Wikimedia projects, including Wikipedia, by creating the tools, infrastructure, and automation that keep software delivery fast and reliable.

Connection team

The Connection team is part of the Contributors group. They aim to improve how contributors connect and understand their impact. The team was formed in 2021 to focus on the needs of campaign and event organizers and participants and hopefully improve the experience of Wikimedia campaigns.

Tools Infrastructure (with Observability)

The mission of the Tools Infrastructure team is to provide a free, reliable, secure and scalable Cloud hosting platform to support Wikimedia contributors and developers to run tools, bots, data pipelines, and services that support Wikipedia and its sister projects.

The Observability team’s mission is to provide insight into the health, performance and behaviour of production code and systems for teams within the Wikimedia Foundation and for volunteers at large.

As we form our internship cohort, we are looking for candidates who possess:

  • Basic experience with at least one back end or front end programming language (e.g PHP, Javascript, Python) OR a mobile app language (Kotlin, Swift), OR a demonstrated interest in cybersecurity and/or privacy.
  • Basic experience with databases.
  • Basic experience with at least one scripting language.
  • For some roles:
    • Basic querying and data manipulation with SQL or other query languages
    • Linux/command-line knowledge
    • Understanding of networking, operating systems, or distributed systems concepts (latency, throughput, error rates).
  • Ability to work independently and be resourceful in solving problems.
  • Ability to stay accountable to deliverable requirements deadlines.
  • Effective and inclusive communication skills with diverse cultural and language communities.
  • Willingness and hunger to learn, a positive attitude, empathy, and a sense of curiosity.
  • The ability to flourish in a highly transparent and collaborative environment.
  • A desire to make meaningful contributions to knowledge equity, free culture, and open access to global education.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based in 40+ countries*. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$34.32 to $42.13 per hour with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.

*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following US States for these internship roles: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.

All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.

  • Fully remote, async-first. Briefs, footage and feedback live in shared drives, Frame.io and ClickUp, so work keeps moving across time zones.
  • Daily overlap. A short daily check-in during your overlap window with Pacific Time, plus written updates on what shipped and what's blocked.
  • Turnaround expectations. Short-form edits typically delivered within 24 hours of brief; revisions within one business day; long-form on an agreed schedule.

jobs.description:
¡Hola! Somos Cashea y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocios BNPL. Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy día tenemos más de 11 millones de usuarios activos, tanto para consumidores como para comercios, y nos convertimos en una marca de confianza en Venezuela.

Resumen del rol

Buscamos un Lead Analytics Engineer para ser el referente técnico del equipo de Analytics Engineering. Tu misión principal será diseñar y mantener la Single Source of Truth (SSoT) del negocio, estructurando modelos de datos escalables, gestionando el catálogo de datos y construyendo la capa semántica que habilitará el autoservicio de los Business Analysts (BAs). Trabajarás en la intersección entre tecnología y negocio, definiendo estándares de desarrollo y optimizando el contexto de nuestros datos para herramientas de IA.

Responsablidades

  • Modelado y SSoT: Diseñar, construir y mantener modelos de datos limpios, testeados y transformados dentro del Data Warehouse (usando dbt/Dataform) como la única fuente de verdad para el negocio.

  • Capa Semántica y Autoservicio: Crear la capa semántica y mantener actualizado el Catálogo de Datos para garantizar que los BAs puedan construir dashboards y análisis operativos sin fricción ni ambigüedad.

  • Contexto para IA: Enriquecer esquemas, metadatos y documentación en el repositorio para alimentar modelos de código/IA (como Claude Code o Copilots) y maximizar el autoservicio técnico del equipo.

  • Calidad y Calidad de Datos: Definir e implementar frameworks de pruebas (dbt tests), monitoreo de alertas y observabilidad para asegurar la consistencia del dato en toda la organización.

  • Liderazgo Técnico: Establecer buenas prácticas de desarrollo (DataOps, revisión de PRs, control de versiones) y mentorear a otros Analytics Engineers del equipo.

  • Colaboración Cruzada: Coordinar con Data Platform e Ingeniería la integración de pipelines y definición de contratos de datos (Data Contracts).

Requisitos

  • Experiencia 6+ años trabajando en entornos de datos, con al menos 3 años especializados en Analytics Engineering.

  • Experiencia 2+ liderando equipos especializados en Analytics engineering .

  • Stack Core: Dominio avanzado de SQL y experiencia sólida con dbt (o Dataform) en entornos cloud (GCP BigQuery, Snowflake o Redshift).

  • Modelado de Datos: Experiencia práctica en metodologías de modelado analítico (Kimball, Star Schema, Data Vault).

  • Ingeniería de Software: Control de versiones con Git, flujos de CI/CD para datos (DataOps) y conocimientos intermedios de Python.

  • Gobernanza: Experiencia implementando y manteniendo Catálogos de Datos (Datahub, Atlan, dbt Docs, etc.) y capas semánticas.

  • Habilidades Blandas: Capacidad comprobada para traducir requerimientos de negocio complejos en modelos técnicos escalables y guiar a otros ingenieros.

Porque te encantará trabajar en Cashea

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si necesitas una pista de por qué somos una buena opción, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

  • No trabajamos en piloto automático. Todo lo que hacemos es intencional. Nos encanta elaborar ideas plenamente conscientes del impacto que pueden tener en nuestros usuarios.

  • Tu creatividad y curiosidad son el activo más Importante.

  • Tu voz importa. Escuchamos y damos espacio a las ideas y al feedback. Todos pertenecen y lo que es importante para ti, también lo es para nosotros.

  • Valoramos la transparencia. La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.

  • Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real.

Si quieres trabajar con nosotros, llena la aplicación. ¡Nos encantaría conocerte!

jobs.description:
Werden Sie selbstständiger Überführungsfahrermit DriiveMe Partner

Erhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.

👉Registrieren Sie sich hier, um auf die Aufträge zuzugreifen:

DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.

Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe, um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar und viele weitere.

In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.

Worin besteht ein DriiveMe-Auftrag?

Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

  1. Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

  2. Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

  3. Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

  4. Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

  5. Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

  6. Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

  • Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

  • Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

  • Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

  • Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

  • Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

Wie viel verdiene ich?

Ihr Umsatz hängt davon ab, wie viele Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

Jeder Auftrag hat eine eigene Vergütung, die sich nach der Strecke, der Anzahl der Kilometer und der Komplexität des Transports richtet.

Bevor Sie einen Auftrag buchen, kennen Sie alle wichtigen Informationen: Abholort, Zielort, Vergütung und Bedingungen. Sie entscheiden frei, welche Aufträge Sie annehmen möchten.

Gesuchtes Profil

Um DriiveMe Partner beizutreten, sollten Sie idealerweise:

  • über eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis verfügen;

  • selbstständig sein oder bereit sein, selbstständig tätig zu werden;

  • zuverlässig, pünktlich und sorgfältig sein;

  • die Verfahren zur Abholung und Übergabe der Fahrzeuge einhalten;

  • verfügbar sein, um gelegentliche Aufträge in Ihrer Region oder in anderen Teilen Deutschlands durchzuführen.

Jetzt registrieren

Die Registrierung der Fahrer erfolgt zentral über die offizielle DriiveMe-Seite.

Our client is a mission-driven health technology company on a high-growth trajectory, building an integrated platform that helps care teams deliver safer, more consistent support to individuals with complex needs. Their work sits at the intersection of software, operations, and human care — and the problems they are solving have real consequences for real people.

They serve a growing network of specialized care providers across the United States, helping organizations replace fragmented, manual workflows with streamlined, technology-guided processes that reduce risk, improve compliance, and give care teams more confidence in their day-to-day work.

This is a remote-first, early-stage company with a lean, high-performing engineering team. They move fast, hold themselves to high standards, and are deeply committed to the mission that drives their work. If you are looking for a role where your contributions have direct, measurable impact — and where the work actually matters — this is worth your attention.

💜 This company was built around a cause that is both personal and urgent. That authenticity shows in how they operate, who they hire, and what they build.

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join their team as a high-ownership, product-minded contributor. In this role, you will take end-to-end responsibility for key features and platform components within their full-stack ecosystem: Ruby on Rails (backend), React (web), and Flutter (mobile).

They are looking for a pragmatic engineer who doesn't just implement tickets — but actively shapes the product experience by understanding user needs and engineering tradeoffs. You will own your work from architectural design through production deployment, ensuring the reliability and performance of systems that directly impact individual care.

If you thrive in high-growth, mission-driven environments and are energized by complex engineering challenges where reliability and usability truly matter, this role is for you.

What Success Looks Like

What You'll Do
  • Build and maintain features across the full stack (Ruby on Rails, React, Flutter), taking end-to-end ownership from initial design through production deployment
  • Act as a product-minded partner, translating complex user needs — often in early or ambiguous stages — into intuitive, technically sound solutions
  • Operate with high autonomy, driving architectural decisions and navigating ambiguity to solve impactful engineering challenges
  • Elevate the engineering culture by setting high standards, mentoring teammates, and simplifying processes to help the team move faster as they scale
  • Proactively balance feature velocity with long-term system health by identifying and addressing technical debt before it becomes a bottleneck
  • Prioritize pragmatic simplicity, ensuring the team builds only what is necessary to validate assumptions and deliver value, while resisting complexity that hinders agility
  • Ensure the reliability and performance of critical systems by taking ownership of production issues and implementing sustainable fixes
What We're Looking For

Required
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a proven track record of owning features from conception to production deployment
  • Deep proficiency in Ruby on Rails — you understand the framework's nuances and know how to build, maintain, and scale robust backend systems
  • Product-first mindset — you treat code as a tool to solve user problems; you are comfortable questioning requirements, identifying gaps in user stories, and advocating for the best technical solution
  • Technical rigor — deep understanding of relational database design, query optimization, and architectural trade-offs; you prioritize maintainability and security (e.g., HIPAA/SOC 2 compliance) in every decision
  • Strong communication skills — in a remote-first environment, your ability to document decisions and communicate asynchronously is as critical as your coding skills

Nice to Have

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Mission-driven work with real, measurable impact on vulnerable populations
The Interview Process

Our client respects your time and moves quickly. The process is designed to be efficient, transparent, and conversational — not a gauntlet. As your recruiting partner, Purple Squirrel Enterprises will prepare you fully for every stage.

Working With Purple Squirrel Enterprises

We are exclusively engaged by this client — meaning we are not one of many agencies submitting resumes. We are their dedicated recruiting partner, embedded in their process, and we know this role inside and out.

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist - Identity and Matching Models
jobs.excerpt: About SpokeoSpokeo is a people intelligence platform that helps over 18 million monthly visitors reconnect with friends, reunite with families, and build trust in new relationships.
jobs.description:
About Spokeo

Spokeo is a people intelligence platform that helps over 18 million monthly visitors reconnect with friends, reunite with families, and build trust in new relationships. Thousands of companies also trust Spokeo's 60 billion public records to improve customer research, help verify information, and prevent fraud.

Founded in 2006, Spokeo has built a dedicated, remote-first team with an average tenure of 6.9 years. Comparably has recognized it as a Best Company for Compensation, Employee Happiness, Perks and Benefits, Support for Women, Work-Life Balance, and CEO Leadership.

About This Opportunity

Every Spokeo search result depends on one decision: do these records describe the same person, and how sure are we? You will build the models that make that call, on messy data from many vendors and public sources, where there is no answer key to check against.

You will own a modeling problem from the first question to the production release, and you will see your work change what customers see. The Data Science team is small, so you work directly with the Director of Data Science and the product owners. If you like designing the test as much as building the model, and you want to mentor teammates as the team grows, this is the place to do it.

What You'll Do:

Rough share of your time, subject to change.

  • 35%: Build and improve the models that match records and score how confident we are in each result. You will choose the approach, train it, test it honestly on held-out data, and ship it.

  • 20%: Design the labels and the measurement. Decide what to hand-check, build the evaluation sets, and estimate how often we are right when a full answer key does not exist. This includes using AI models to help label at scale, and checking them against human judgment.

  • 15%: Take models to production on AWS, with ML engineering and DevOps. That covers the retrain schedule, the model registry, and a record of where every model and its data came from.

  • 10%: Review each data build before it ships. Find what changed, catch regressions, and explain it in plain language to product and sales partners.

  • 10%: Work with the Product Owner to turn findings into stories with clear targets, and defend the priority of the next research spike.

  • 10%: Document your methods, review teammates' code, and take part in the DS/ML working group.

Tools. What you will work with: Python, SQL, Spark, AWS SageMaker, Databricks, and MLflow.

Challenges. Noisy and incomplete records, no large hand-labeled set to lean on, and opt-out and retention rules that every model must respect.

People. The Director of Data Science, product owners, ML engineers, DevOps, and the DS/ML working group.

Who You Are:

What you have done matters more than the tools you have touched. Equivalent experience counts.

  • Required: 6+ years of applied data science, though what you have shipped matters more than the count.

  • Required: A Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field is expected, and a master’s is preferred, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Taken a model from idea to production in a cloud setting (AWS SageMaker, Databricks, MLflow, or similar), monitored it, and measured how it performed after launch.

  • Worked with very large datasets (100 million rows or more) using Spark or a similar tool, with Python and SQL.

  • Judged whether a model is good when no clean answer key exists, for example by sampling and hand-checking results, and said how confident you are in the number.

  • Told a real improvement from noise, and explained the result, its limits, and the tradeoffs in plain language to engineers and product owners alike.

  • Kept a model healthy as its data changed: knowing when labels and models have gone out of date and need refreshing, and writing the process down so a teammate can pick it up.

  • Handled personal data responsibly, following opt-out, retention, and lineage rules without being reminded.

  • Experience matching or de-duplicating records, using AI to help label data, graph methods, or turning a raw model score into a confidence a product team can act on, is a plus.

Working at Spokeo

Our mission is to advance transparency, and to achieve that goal, we rally around six core values: listening with empathy, understanding the why, clarifying with data, innovating to learn, collaborating to achieve, and insisting on quality.

As a remote-first company, we can hire team members in the following US states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, KY, MD, MI, MO, NJ, NV, NC, PA, SC, SD, TX, VA, WA, or WY.

In addition to a highly competitive base salary, our generous benefits include:

  • annual bonus program

  • stock options

  • 401K matching

  • 100% medical/dental/vision coverage

  • unlimited PTO

  • mental health resources

  • paid home office equipment

  • fitness reimbursements

  • support paying for courses

  • and more

We extend written offers to candidates who successfully complete their selection process. Offers will depend on several factors, including, but not limited to, marketplace competition, job leveling, experience, and skills.

Privacy Notice for Candidates:

Spokeo is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status. Spokeo fosters a business culture where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best products, and be relevant in a rapidly changing world.

Recruiters or staffing agencies: Spokeo is not obligated to compensate any external recruiter or search firm who presents a candidate or their resume or profile to a Spokeo employee without 1) a current, fully executed agreement on file, and 2) being assigned to the open position (as a search) via our applicant tracking solution.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Our Hiring Process

Spokeo may use artificial intelligence-enabled tools to support portions of the recruiting process. These tools may help our recruiting team organize, review, and summarize application materials, candidate experience, and interview information. They may also identify potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials for further human review.

AI-enabled tools assist our recruiting team but do not replace human judgment. Employment decisions are made by people based on a candidate's qualifications and the role's requirements.

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About the Role

We are seeking an AI-fluent Customer Reference Program Manager to build and run Bonterra’s AI-first customer reference program within Commercial AI. You will own live reference requests, Champion HQ, and Peerbound, helping sellers advance active opportunities, especially New Logo / New Sale deals, through relevant customer conversations, contextualized one-pagers, and case studies.

You will shape how Bonterra combines customer insight, commercial judgment, and AI to deliver the right proof at the right moment in a sales cycle. This means designing repeatable processes and using AI agents and automation to triage requests, surface relevant matches, draft proof packages, and reduce manual work, with human oversight of customer relationships, consent, and approvals. You will also help shape the program’s 2027 operating model, evaluating where Champion HQ, Peerbound, and internally built capabilities deliver the greatest seller impact and return.

Reporting into Commercial AI, this is a hands-on individual contributor role with program ownership and no direct reports. You own the reference layer; broader advocacy remains with Customer Advocacy. Success means timely fulfillment, relevant matches, seller adoption, and measurable contribution to deal outcomes, while protecting customer relationships.


What You’ll Do


  • Own live deal support. Manage reference requests from intake and qualification through matching, customer outreach, scheduling, briefing, and follow-up. Maintain coverage through the transition, clarify the buyer’s question and deal deadline, and close the loop with sellers on what helped the opportunity progress.
  • Build a repeatable operating process. Define request types, priorities, required information, service-level agreements, escalation paths, and ownership. Establish a baseline for demand and fulfillment effort, document the workflow, and remove recurring bottlenecks before automating it.
  • Make matching relevant to social good. Match on nonprofit mission and NTEE code/category, segment, products in use, competitor displaced, AI and technology stack (including Built With data), buyer persona, and geography. Identify coverage gaps with Sales and Customer Success, and qualify reference customers against real deal needs.
  • Run Champion HQ. Maintain the roster, profiles, matching rules, request workflow, and Salesforce-connected ROI reporting; resolve automation and data gaps with the appropriate system owners. Validate the agreed reporting population: Opportunity Type = New Logo and Opportunity Subtype = New Sale.
  • Turn Peerbound insights into deal-ready proof. Mine available customer voice sources to surface relevant evidence and potential references. Maintain source traceability, approvals, and freshness, and deliver approved proof where sellers can find and use it.
  • Own the AI-first reference workflow. Design, test, and run AI-assisted triage, matching shortlists, first-draft assets, and proof assembly, partnering with Commercial AI to turn repeatable processes into reliable workflows. Define source requirements, review checkpoints, exception handling, and quality checks, then measure time saved, rework, and seller impact to continuously improve performance.
  • Protect customer trust. Personally manage customer asks and coordinate with relationship owners on consent, availability, and participation limits. Track usage and fatigue, respect restrictions on quotes and logos, and keep customer commitments and legal approvals under human control.
  • Connect operations to commercial outcomes. Track fill rate, time-to-fulfill, seller utilization and adoption, reference utilization and fatigue, and influenced pipeline and ARR. Partner with RevOps to assess win-rate and sales-cycle differences on referenced deals as volume permits, distinguishing observed influence from proven lift.
  • Recommend the right stack and 2027 operating model. Evaluate Champion HQ and Peerbound using actual usage, seller impact, fulfillment effort, cost, and ROI. Recommend whether to retain, reshape, replace, or bring capabilities in-house, accounting for contract timing, integration and maintenance effort, migration risk, and the level of support each segment needs.
  • Build adoption with your partners. Work with Sales, Customer Advocacy, Customer Success, Product Marketing, RevOps, Legal, and Commercial AI to maintain clear handoffs and a shared view of reference readiness. Enable sellers on the request path and reusable proof, and use their feedback to improve coverage and fulfillment.

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of relevant B2B SaaS experience in customer references, advocacy operations, sales enablement, or commercial programs, including direct ownership of reference requests supporting active sales opportunities.
  • Hands-on experience operating a reference platform such as Champion HQ or ReferenceEdge and a customer-proof platform such as Peerbound or a close equivalent, including profiles, workflows, permissions, and seller delivery.
  • Fluent in Salesforce opportunity fields, report filters, and data validation, with the ability to connect reference activity to opportunities and recognize gaps in reporting.
  • A proven process builder who has turned an inconsistent request workflow into clear intake rules, matching criteria, service levels, documentation, and reporting.
  • AI-first and fluent in applying generative AI, knowledge bases, and workflow automation to day-to-day program operations. You can demonstrate workflows you have designed or improved, explain how you validate outputs, and measure quality, time saved, and business impact.
  • Strong customer judgment and relationship skills, including making thoughtful requests, managing expectations, and balancing sales urgency with customer readiness and consent.
  • Clear, concise writing skills and the ability to turn customer evidence into useful seller briefs and one-pagers without overstating results.
  • Able to own priorities independently, work through incomplete data and evolving processes, and bring cross-functional partners with you as the program changes.


Bonus Points For

  • Direct administration of Champion HQ and hands-on use of Peerbound are strongly preferred.
  • Experience in nonprofit or social-good markets, including mission-based segmentation and NTEE taxonomies.
  • Experience with Gong or other call intelligence tools, content repositories, and review-site content as sources of customer proof.
  • Experience building reference ROI reporting or evaluating software vendors against an in-house operating model.
  • Experience connecting AI workflows to CRM, call intelligence, or content systems through no-code tools or integration requirements.

The role also leads and develops Solution Architects embedded within Business Capability Enablement teams, driving consistent architectural practices and quality across ERP, Supply Chain, Digital, Data, and HCM domains.
