jobs.excerpt: Dal 2005 Kiratech accompagna aziende di diverse dimensioni nell'adozione e nell'evoluzione di tecnologie Cloud Native, AI, Platform Engineering e Security.
jobs.description:
Dal 2005 Kiratech accompagna aziende di diverse dimensioni nell'adozione e nell'evoluzione di tecnologie Cloud Native, AI, Platform Engineering e Security. Come membro della Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) e partner dei principali Cloud Provider e vendor tecnologici dell'ecosistema Cloud Native, offriamo consulenza, formazione e servizi professionali con un approccio orientato a progettazione, automazione, osservabilità e miglioramento continuo delle piattaforme dei clienti.

Il nostro obiettivo è ascoltare le richieste dei clienti per guidarli verso una maggiore efficienza e produttività, facendo dell'IT un acceleratore del business. Lavoriamo su progetti concreti e innovativi in ambiti che spaziano dal Platform Engineering alla sicurezza, fino all'automazione e all'adozione di modelli AI.

Kiratech fa per te se cerchi:

  • un'azienda in cui l'attenzione alla persona è fondamentale
  • la possibilità di lavorare fianco a fianco con esperti del settore e di sviluppare competenze pratiche e concrete
  • un team coeso e collaborativo
  • un modo di lavorare per obiettivi

Descrizione del profilo
Kiratech è alla ricerca di una/un Cloud Native Architect da inserire nel team Professional Services, con il ruolo di design authority sui progetti presso i clienti.

La persona definirà l'architettura delle soluzioni Cloud Native dei clienti, dalla fase di analisi e presales fino alla realizzazione: raccoglierà i requisiti, disegnerà l'architettura target e la roadmap per arrivarci, prenderà e documenterà le decisioni tecniche e guiderà i workstream di progetto, lavorando a stretto contatto con il project management e con i team del cliente.

Una/un Cloud Native Architect in Kiratech è la design authority dei progetti che segue: comprende gli obiettivi di business del cliente, li traduce in requisiti non funzionali e in un'architettura sostenibile, prende e documenta decisioni con i relativi compromessi e accompagna i team fino alla realizzazione. La figura contribuirà inoltre alla definizione di nuove soluzioni a supporto del reparto Presales, proponendo interventi e scelte tecnologiche innovative.

Attività principali

Le attività principali includono l'analisi dei requisiti funzionali e non funzionali del cliente, la definizione dell'architettura target e della roadmap di adozione o migrazione, la redazione di decision record e documentazione architetturale (ad esempio C4), il dimensionamento e la stima dei costi, la definizione di baseline di sicurezza e compliance, la guida tecnica dei workstream e la revisione del loro operato, la definizione di responsabilità con i team del cliente e il supporto al Presales nella costruzione di proposte e offerte.

Chi cerchiamo

Cerchiamo una professionista o un professionista con una conoscenza profonda e trasversale delle tecnologie Cloud Native, capace di prendere decisioni architetturali sotto vincoli reali, motivarle e comunicarle in modo convincente a stakeholder sia tecnici sia business.

Percorso di crescita

Il percorso prevede un ruolo attivo nella design authority del team Professional Services, formazione continua su temi tecnici, di business e di leadership e un piano di carriera definito e supportato da certificazioni. La crescita potrà portare alla responsabilità architetturale di clienti e programmi strategici, alla definizione dell'offerta Kiratech e a ruoli di Principal o Lead Architect.

Requirements

Il profilo ideale possiede:

    • Architettura Cloud Native: esperienza nella progettazione end-to-end di piattaforme Cloud Native per clienti enterprise (requisiti non funzionali, decision record, diagrammi C4, dimensionamento, alta affidabilità e disaster recovery)
    • Kubernetes e piattaforme: esperienza consolidata (oltre 3 anni) su Kubernetes e distribuzioni enterprise, multi-cluster e multi-sito, preferibilmente con certificazione CKA
    • Cloud e ambienti ibridi: almeno 2 anni di esperienza con uno o più tra AWS, Azure, Google Cloud e IBM Cloud e con architetture ibride tra cloud privati on-premise e piattaforme commerciali
    • Automazione e delivery: esperienza approfondita con Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, Crossplane), CI/CD e GitOps
    • Sicurezza e compliance: capacità di progettare piattaforme sicure by design e conformi ai principali framework (ad esempio CIS, ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR)
    • leadership tecnica: almeno 18 mesi come Technical Lead, Technical Project Lead o architetto in un contesto di consulenza o in un reparto di progettazione, con guida di più workstream e confronto con il project management
    • Relazione con il cliente e presales: capacità di presentare architetture, costi (TCO) e roadmap a interlocutori tecnici e business (CIO, CISO, CFO) e di contribuire alla definizione di offerte
    • Service e Project Management: conoscenza degli standard di riferimento o certificazioni associate (ad esempio PRINCE2, ITIL, FitSM, AgilePM)

Costituiscono titolo preferenziale certificazioni o esperienza dimostrabile in uno o più dei seguenti ambiti:

    • Certificazioni architetturali Cloud (AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect) e Kubernetes (CKA, CKS)
    • Platform Engineering e internal developer platform (ad esempio Backstage, Krateo, Crossplane)
    • Architetture multi-sito, disaster recovery e business continuity
    • Service mesh (ad esempio Istio, Kuma o Linkerd) e networking avanzato
    • Osservabilità su larga scala (stack Grafana LGTM, Elastic) e FinOps
    • Data platform (ad esempio Kafka, Flink) e MLOps
    • Approcci DevSecOps e software supply chain security
    • Framework di architettura enterprise (ad esempio TOGAF)

Tecnologie e strumenti rilevanti

Saranno considerate positivamente conoscenze o esperienza su tecnologie e strumenti come Kubernetes, OpenShift, Rancher, Cluster API, Terraform, Ansible, Crossplane, Krateo, Backstage, Argo CD, Flux, GitLab, Istio, Cilium, HashiCorp Vault, Kyverno, Grafana, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, Prometheus, Elastic Stack, Kafka, OpenCost e principali servizi Kubernetes gestiti (EKS, AKS, GKE).

Lingue

  • Italiano madrelingua
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese dal punto di vista professionale

Benefits

Cosa offriamo

  • Formazione continua: 1 giorno al mese dedicato alla formazione, tramite piattaforme dedicate, su temi tecnici rilevanti per il ruolo (Cloud Native, AI, Security, osservabilità, automazione) e su competenze manageriali, gestionali e comunicative
  • Piano di carriera definito e supportato da certificazioni, con budget dedicato
  • Confronto tecnico costante con esperti Kiratech e meeting ricorrenti per condividere competenze ed esperienze
  • Lavoro remoto
  • Working from anywhere: 4 settimane/anno di lavoro da remoto
  • Recharging Friday (1 venerdì a trimestre retribuito)
  • Ticket Restaurant elettronici
  • Welfare aziendale
  • Accesso a iniziative interne di R&D

RAL: 38.000 €- 50.000 € da valutare in base all'effettiva esperienza e competenze maturate

Job Description


The Patient Care experience is an essential part of our mission to build the pharmacy of the future. Our Care Operations team goes above and beyond for our partners and patients by combining the personalized care of a neighborhood pharmacy with the speed and innovation of a technology-enabled healthcare organization.


The Care Supervisor, Pharmacist leads a team of Remote Pharmacists responsible for delivering high-quality pharmacy services, including remote prescription verification, patient consultations, and other clinical pharmacy operations. This role will also collaborate cross-functionally with Pharmacy Operations, Product, Workforce Management, and other partners to improve workflows and support changes to the patient care experience. The ideal candidate is a hands-on people leader who is comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, uses data to make decisions, and can balance operational performance with patient safety and regulatory compliance. The Care Supervisor will also maintain proficiency in frontline pharmacy workflows, including remote prescription verification, patient consultations, and clinical operations, and step into frontline work as needed to support service levels and operational coverage.

Key Responsibilities


  • Lead & Develop Your Team: Lead, supervise, and mentor a team of Remote Pharmacists responsible for remote prescription verification, patient consultations, and other clinical pharmacy operations. Build a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team while supporting the ongoing growth and development of your direct reports.
  • Own Operational Performance: Oversee day-to-day team performance across service levels, productivity, quality, and patient experience. Establish clear performance expectations, monitor results, and take action to address performance gaps and operational needs.

Step into frontline work and participate in operational coverage rotations as needed to support service levels and patient demand.

  • Proficiency in project management tools within G-suite, JIRA, and data analysis tools such as Looker to independently build and interpret reports to drive decision making . Proficiency with pharmacy operations systems and tools, including Dialpad, Alto OS, Aspect, and Veriato.

jobs.description:
About Wolters Kluwer ELM Solutions

Wolters Kluwer ELM Solutions is a leading provider of enterprise legal management solutions that help corporate legal departments manage their legal operations, matters, outside counsel, legal spend, and performance.

Our solutions, including Passport, TyMetrix 360°, and LegalVIEW BillAnalyzer, support some of the world's largest and most complex corporate legal departments. We combine enterprise technology, deep legal domain expertise, data, analytics, and AI to help customers improve operational efficiency, control legal spend, make better decisions, and demonstrate the value of the legal function.

Our customers include leading organizations across financial services, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, technology, and other industries.


Position Summary

The Account Manager is responsible for protecting and growing the commercial relationship across an assigned portfolio of WK ELM customers. The Account Manager owns renewal and expansion strategy, opportunity execution, pricing, contracting, revenue forecasting, and the commercial account plan.

The Account Manager serves as a strategic commercial advisor to General Counsel, Legal Operations, Finance, Procurement, and Technology stakeholders. The role develops a strong understanding of the customer's business priorities, buying process, competitive environment, and growth potential, then translates customer needs and demonstrated value into clear renewal and expansion strategies.

This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring executive presence, sound commercial judgment, disciplined account leadership, and the ability to navigate complex enterprise relationships. The Account Manager is expected to anticipate risk and opportunity, mobilize cross-functional resources, and influence outcomes without direct authority.

Customer Success leads the customer success plan, adoption, customer health, value realization, and risk recovery. Account Management leads renewal execution, expansion, pricing, contracting, and the commercial forecast. The two roles partner on account planning, executive alignment, retention, and sustainable growth.

The Account Manager partners closely with Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Support, Product, Professional Services, Solution Consulting, Finance, and Legal to present one coordinated WK ELM strategy to the customer and deliver against commercial commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Account Strategy & Ownership

  • Develop and execute commercial account plans for assigned customers
  • Establish clear renewal, retention, and expansion objectives for each account
  • Understand the customer's business priorities, commercial environment, buying process, and competitive landscape
  • Maintain stakeholder maps that identify executive sponsors, champions, decision makers, economic buyers, Procurement, Legal, Finance, and Technology stakeholders
  • Identify risks to revenue retention or growth and lead the appropriate commercial response
  • Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, contact, and activity information in the CRM

Renewal & Retention Management

  • Own the renewal timeline, commercial strategy, forecast, negotiation, contract execution, and close
  • Begin renewal planning in accordance with the established renewal cadence and maintain a clear mutual action plan through signature
  • Use customer health, adoption, value realization, and risk insights from Customer Success to shape the renewal strategy
  • Develop pricing, term, packaging, and multiyear strategies that support customer value and WK ELM objectives
  • Lead engagement with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and other commercial stakeholders.
  • Coordinate internal approvals for pricing, concessions, contract terms, and deal structure.
  • Identify and address competitive threats, commercial objections, and barriers to renewal.
  • Share accountability with Customer Success for retention while remaining directly accountable for commercial renewal execution and forecast accuracy.

Growth & Expansion

  • Own expansion pipeline, opportunity strategy, commercial execution, and close within assigned accounts
  • Qualify customer needs and expansion signals identified through Customer Success, account engagement, product usage, or market insight
  • Position WK ELM capabilities across Passport, TyMetrix 360°, LegalVIEW BillAnalyzer, Legal Collaborator, AI, and related offerings
  • Lead discovery and partner with Solution Consulting, Product, Professional Services, and Customer Success to develop compelling business cases and value propositions
  • Expand relationships across Legal, Legal Operations, the executive team, Finance, Procurement, and Technology
  • Maintain accurate expansion pipeline, close plans, next steps, and revenue forecasts
  • Drive cross-sell, upsell, platform adoption, additional users, modules, data, AI capabilities, and services where aligned to customer priorities

Executive & Commercial Relationship Management

  • Build credible relationships with General Counsel, Legal Operations leaders, executive sponsors, economic buyers, Procurement, and other senior stakeholders
  • Lead strategic commercial discussions and establish alignment on the long-term WK ELM relationship
  • Partner with Customer Success on Quarterly Business Reviews and Executive Business Reviews, leading commercial strategy, renewal, and growth discussions
  • Develop executive sponsorship and mobilize WK ELM leadership when executive engagement will advance retention or growth
  • Understand customer organizational dynamics, decision criteria, budget cycles, and approval processes
  • Represent the commercial voice of the customer internally, including buying barriers, competitive context, and investment priorities

Forecasting & Operational Discipline

  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely renewal and expansion forecasts
  • Apply the required sales methodology, qualification standards, opportunity stages, and inspection cadence
  • Create and maintain close plans and mutual action plans with clear owners, milestones, decision criteria, and dates
  • Communicate material changes to timing, value, probability, risk, or customer commitment promptly
  • Manage account pipeline coverage and progression with the same discipline applied to new logo opportunities
  • Deliver clear account updates, risk assessments, and recommended actions in forecast and executive reviews

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Customer Success to align the commercial account plan with the customer success plan and value realization priorities
  • Use Customer Success insights on adoption, health, stakeholder engagement, and outcomes to inform renewal and expansion decisions
  • Partner with Technical Account Management, Support, and Professional Services on service or delivery matters that create commercial risk or opportunity
  • Partner with Product and Marketing on customer needs, competitive intelligence, references, and growth opportunities
  • Partner with Solution Consulting to translate customer priorities into differentiated solution and value narratives
  • Coordinate with Finance, Legal, and leadership to secure approvals and execute agreements
  • Establish clear ownership across internal teams and maintain one coordinated message to the customer
  • Influence outcomes across teams without direct authority

Required Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Account Management, Sales, Customer Success, Enterprise Software, or a related customer-facing discipline
  • 5+ years managing strategic, complex, or enterprise customer relationships
  • Demonstrated experience owning renewals, expansion opportunities, pricing, and commercial negotiations
  • Proven ability to retain and grow complex enterprise customer relationships
  • Experience developing and executing strategic account plans
  • Experience managing complex procurement, legal, and contracting cycles
  • Experience building business cases and value propositions for enterprise software investments
  • Experience forecasting recurring revenue and managing renewal and expansion pipeline
  • Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with senior executives, economic buyers, and functional leaders
  • Experience identifying and addressing competitive threats and account risk
  • Strong negotiation, executive communication, presentation, and relationship-management skills
  • Strong operational discipline and experience using CRM systems and structured sales methodologies
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in a SaaS or enterprise software environment
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and internal teams without direct authority

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in Legal Operations, Legal Technology, Enterprise Legal Management, eBilling, Matter Management, CLM, ERP, Procurement, or Financial Systems
  • Experience supporting Fortune 1000 or similarly complex global enterprise customers
  • Familiarity with corporate legal department operations, including legal spend management, outside counsel management, matter management, and legal operations
  • Experience selling or expanding enterprise SaaS platforms, data, analytics, AI, or professional services
  • Experience managing competitive displacement, account defense, or complex renewal situations
  • Experience working in highly regulated industries or complex global stakeholder environments
  • Experience partnering with Customer Success teams on adoption, value realization, customer health, and retention
  • Experience working within a highly matrixed global organization

What Success Looks Like

Successful Account Managers at WK ELM operate as senior strategic commercial leaders. They are commercially accountable, customer-focused, data-informed, disciplined, and highly collaborative. They understand the customer's business and decision process, own the commercial plan, maintain an accurate view of revenue and risk, and lead renewal and expansion opportunities from strategy through signature.

They engage throughout the customer lifecycle, use value and health insights from Customer Success to inform commercial decisions, and coordinate internal resources without blurring ownership. They create a consistent customer experience while ensuring that every renewal, expansion opportunity, commercial risk, and forecast commitment has a clear strategy and next action.

Success is measured through renewal execution, contribution to Gross Revenue Retention and Net Revenue Retention, expansion ARR, forecast accuracy, pipeline creation and progression, multiyear renewals, competitive retention, and sustainable account growth.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$89,600.00 - $157,000.00 USDThis role is eligible for Commission.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

The Program Manager, Product supports the Product organization by driving the planning, coordination, and execution of cross-functional product initiatives. This role partners closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, and other teams to ensure product programs progress efficiently from planning through launch. The Program Manager brings structure and visibility to complex initiatives, manages timelines and dependencies, identifies risks and blockers, and facilitates effective communication across teams. This role is an individual contributor position that requires strong collaboration, organization, problem-solving, and the ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.

The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in a fast-paced product environment, managing multiple priorities, and bringing clarity to ambiguous or complex problems.


To be qualified for the role, you have:


Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Product Management, Operations, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3–5 years of experience in program management, project management, product operations, product management, or a related field.
  • Experience working in a technology, software, or other product-driven environment.
  • Experience working in a regulated industry such as healthcare or financial services. Healthcare background is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Ability to influence and coordinate stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Proficiency with common project management, collaboration, and productivity tools.

Preferred

  • Experience working directly with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum product development methodologies.
  • Experience supporting software or digital product launches.
  • Experience with product roadmap planning and prioritization processes.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.

Core Competencies

  • Execution: Consistently drives assigned initiatives forward and delivers against commitments.
  • Organization: Creates structure, maintains accurate documentation, and effectively manages competing priorities.
  • Collaboration: Builds productive relationships across Product and partner functions.
  • Communication: Clearly communicates status, risks, decisions, and next steps.
  • Problem Solving: Identifies issues and develops practical solutions.
  • Influence: Gains alignment and drives accountability without formal authority.
  • Adaptability: Effectively navigates changing priorities and ambiguity.
  • Product Orientation: Understands the connection between customer needs, product priorities, technology, and business outcomes.

What you will be doing:


Program Management

  • Manage the day-to-day execution of assigned product programs and initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain program plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
  • Coordinate activities across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, and other stakeholder teams.
  • Track progress against commitments and proactively identify potential delays or issues.
  • Maintain clear documentation and visibility into program status.
  • Ensure action items, decisions, and follow-ups are clearly documented and completed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product Managers and functional leads to coordinate execution of product initiatives.
  • Facilitate working sessions, planning meetings, status meetings, and project reviews.
  • Build alignment across teams with shared goals and interdependent deliverables.
  • Follow up on commitments and help teams resolve execution issues.
  • Serve as a central point of coordination for assigned programs.

Product Development & Launch

  • Support product initiatives across discovery, planning, development, testing, launch, and post-launch activities.
  • Coordinate launch readiness activities across relevant Product and business teams.
  • Track key launch dependencies and ensure outstanding items are identified and addressed.
  • Support development of launch plans, timelines, communications, and readiness checklists.
  • Help coordinate post-launch activities and follow-up actions.

Risk & Dependency Management

  • Identify risks, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints that may affect program delivery.
  • Work with stakeholders to develop mitigation plans and resolve blockers.
  • Escalate significant issues when additional support or decision-making is required.
  • Maintain program-level risk and dependency tracking.
  • Provide timely visibility into changes that may impact scope, schedule, or deliverables.

Product Planning & Operations

  • Support quarterly and annual product planning activities.
  • Help maintain visibility into roadmap initiatives, milestones, dependencies, and priorities.
  • Support Product leadership and Product Managers with planning materials, reporting, and operational processes.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, status reports, and other program-management artifacts.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product planning and execution processes.
  • Contribute to the development and adoption of consistent Product operating practices.

Communication & Reporting

  • Provide clear and concise program updates to Product and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Prepare status reports, presentations, dashboards, and other program communications.
  • Communicate changes to timelines, scope, risks, and dependencies in a timely manner.
  • Ensure stakeholders understand decisions, responsibilities, and next steps.

Agfa Radiology Solutions sells digital radiography rooms, mobile systems and detector retrofits to hospitals across Southeast Asia through distributor partners. ASEAN is our largest untapped market: a market of roughly EUR 65 million a year where we hold about 3 percent share, with the best historic win rate of any region when we compete. The plan is to more than double the business by 2031, through partners rather than around them.

We are looking for one person to run the whole region as our channel leader. You own the distributor network across Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, the Philippines, Cambodia and Myanmar, you decide which partners we grow, fix or replace, and you build partners that can win without you in the room. This is a channel role, not a direct sales role. If you are at your best building distributors that compete for business on their own, rather than closing every deal yourself, this is the job.

Partner Leadership and Growth

  • • Manage and develop our distributor partnerships across the seven ASEAN markets, including our partners in Vietnam, Indonesia, Cambodia and Thailand and the direct hospital group empanelment in Malaysia.
  • • Build and execute annual joint business plans with each strategic partner, aligned to the regional growth targets for rooms, mobiles and retrofit.
  • • Drive accountability for revenue, order intake, pipeline and market development, with a monthly performance rhythm and a quarterly business review per partner.
  • • Segment the network into strategic, growth and transactional partners, score every partner against the Agfa Ideal Distributor Profile, and act on the result: grow the proven partners, upgrade or replace the weak ones, and sign new partners where a market has none.
  • • Shift the operating model from Agfa doing the work to the partner doing the work: the partner takes the product, runs the deal, installs and owns local service, and earns a margin that makes it worth leading with Agfa.

Business Development

  • • Generate and develop new sales opportunities across public hospitals, ministry programs and private hospital groups.
  • • Work shoulder to shoulder with partners to win strategic and ministry level deals, including large mobile and room tenders.
  • • Build a strong, clean pipeline in our CRM and improve conversion rates and forecast accuracy across the region.
  • • Expand Agfa's footprint into the markets where we are absent or opportunistic today, through a partner and not through headcount.

Co-Selling and Deal Execution

  • • Support partners in tenders, negotiations and solution positioning; get specifications shaped before tenders publish, and make sure partners get pricing, references and technical answers from Agfa within 48 hours.
  • • Lead key opportunities when required, and apply value based selling on image quality, workflow and artificial intelligence against low cost competitors.
  • • Own deal economics: know the competitor price, the partner margin and the Agfa margin on every material deal, and escalate early where a deal needs pricing flexibility.

Partner Enablement

  • • Train and coach distributor sales and applications teams on Agfa's solutions, so partners can demonstrate and sell the clinical value themselves.
  • • Strengthen product knowledge, tender capability and service readiness at each partner, with certification and onboarding programs.
  • • Collaborate with marketing on regional campaigns, installed base and retrofit programs, and partner co marketing.

What we are looking for

  • • Proven experience in channel sales and distributor management across several countries in Southeast Asia, with a track record of growing revenue through partners rather than direct sales.
  • • An enablement mindset: you build tools, training and playbooks so partners win on their own, and you measure partner capability, not only your own activity.
  • • A real operating rhythm: business reviews, joint planning and pipeline reviews with a defined cadence, inputs and outputs.
  • • The ability to diagnose a territory, segment partners, and find the revenue and the gaps before acting.
  • • Experience driving partners to compete: lifting a passive distributor into one that generates pipeline, runs campaigns and defends deals.
  • • Experience managing underperformance: confronting a weak or complacent partner and changing the outcome, with replacement as the last lever and not the only one.
  • • Medical technology, healthcare or capital equipment background preferred; understanding of public procurement and tender driven buying with long capital cycles.
  • • Commercial acumen, strong influencing and negotiation skills, and fluent English; a regional language is an advantage.
  • • A self starter with an entrepreneurial, results driven mindset, comfortable running a region with a small team and a large partner network.

What we offer

  • • A competitive base salary with a performance bonus under the Agfa sales incentive plan.
  • • Ownership of a whole region in a growth market.
  • • A Singapore base with flexibility for the right candidate, and international exposure inside a global indirect organization.
  • • Career progression within Agfa Radiology Solutions.

The Program Manager owns portfolio orchestration and integrated portfolio insight. Routine project planning and execution may be led by Project Managers or other qualified delivery leads, depending on the complexity, risk, and support needs of the initiative.

Essential Responsibilities


Strategic Alignment and Portfolio Leadership

Translate enterprise direction into an integrated, outcome-focused portfolio.

  • Translate enterprise and domain strategies into coherent portfolio roadmaps, priorities, intended outcomes, and measurable success criteria.
  • Maintain an integrated view of portfolio health, including strategic alignment, scope, schedule, financial performance, capacity, risks, dependencies, decisions, and expected benefits.
  • Evaluate new and existing initiatives based on strategic value, urgency, complexity, risk, sequencing, resource requirements, and organizational readiness.
  • Identify systemic risks, bottlenecks, opportunities, and trade-offs that extend beyond individual project boundaries.
  • Recommend where work should be accelerated, deferred, reshaped, or escalated based on enterprise priorities and available capacity.

Governance and Executive Decision Support

Create the structure and insight leaders need to make timely, informed decisions.

  • Establish and facilitate effective portfolio and program governance, including clear decision rights, escalation paths, accountability, and operating rhythms.
  • Partner with executive sponsors and domain leaders to frame desired outcomes, validate priorities, resolve trade-offs, and address constraints.
  • Translate complex portfolio information into concise executive insights, options, recommendations, and decision requests.
  • Ensure decisions, risks, commitments, and changes are documented, communicated, and reflected in portfolio and initiative plans.
  • Escalate material risks, dependencies, resource conflicts, or strategic misalignment early enough to enable leadership action.

Cross-Functional Orchestration and Delivery Enablement

Coordinate diverse contributors while preserving clear delivery accountability.

  • Coordinate work across business, technology, operations, clinical, regulatory, finance, data, vendor, and other delivery partners.
  • Integrate cross-project and cross-domain dependencies, milestones, capacity requirements, and decisions.
  • Determine and clarify appropriate delivery ownership in partnership with PMO and business leadership.
  • Guide Project Managers and delivery leads without unnecessarily taking over routine project execution.
  • Ensure projects and initiatives provide reliable information needed for portfolio governance and executive decision-making.
  • Intervene when portfolio-level conditions require corrective action, additional support, reprioritization, or escalation.

Benefits Realization and Business Outcomes

Maintain focus on adoption, measurable outcomes, and sustained value.

  • Define and maintain portfolio and program outcomes, benefits, measures, assumptions, and value targets.
  • Monitor whether programs and initiatives remain positioned to achieve their intended business outcomes.
  • Partner with accountable business leaders to address barriers to adoption, operational readiness, and benefits realization.
  • Ensure leadership reporting communicates business impact and expected value, not merely delivery activity.
  • Support post-implementation evaluation and adjustment where intended outcomes are not being realized.

Stakeholder Leadership and Communication

Build alignment and trust across senior leaders, partners, and delivery teams.

  • Build trusted, credible relationships with senior leaders, executive sponsors, and cross-functional partners.
  • Create integrated communication strategies for executives, governance bodies, delivery teams, and affected stakeholders.
  • Communicate risks, choices, recommendations, and business implications with clarity and appropriate context.
  • Influence and negotiate across organizational boundaries where direct authority may not exist.
  • Navigate sensitive organizational dynamics with diplomacy, transparency, active listening, and sound judgment.

Leadership, Coaching, and Capability Development

Strengthen delivery leadership and consistent PMO practices.

  • Coach and mentor Project Managers and other delivery leads in disciplined execution, stakeholder leadership, problem-solving, and professional growth.
  • Reinforce consistent PMO standards, tools, governance practices, and communication expectations.
  • Identify delivery-capability gaps and recommend coaching, staffing, or resource responses.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, accountability, continuous improvement, and professional standards.
  • Help build project and program management capability beyond the immediate portfolio.

Change Leadership

Enable adoption and sustained transformation across the portfolio.

  • Lead and enable cross-functional change by keeping stakeholders aligned to strategic intent, intended outcomes, and adoption expectations.
  • Anticipate resistance, readiness concerns, change saturation, and competing organizational demands.
  • Coordinate sequencing across initiatives to reduce avoidable disruption and change fatigue.
  • Promote adoption of effective practices and help scale successful approaches across the organization.
  • Maintain focus on sustained transformation rather than one-time implementation.

Risk, Financial, Vendor, and Operational Oversight

Protect portfolio viability through disciplined oversight and early action.

  • Assess portfolio and program risks and establish mitigation, contingency, and escalation strategies.
  • Monitor financial health, investment assumptions, resource demand, and capacity constraints.
  • Partner with procurement, finance, legal, compliance, technology, and operational leaders as required.
  • Manage vendor performance against applicable contracts, statements of work, commitments, and expected outcomes.
  • Take or recommend corrective action when portfolio health, delivery viability, or expected value is at risk.
  • Perform other duties as assigned or requested.

EDUCATION
Minimum

  • High School Diploma / GED

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, healthcare administration, operations, project management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Advanced degree in business, technology management, healthcare administration, or a related discipline.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum

  • **Due to Department of Defense (DOD) contract requirements, the incumbent who fills this position must be a US citizen, and must also pass a background check**
  • 7 -10 years of work experience in project management or
  • 7-10 years of work experience delivering business solutions using information technology

Preferred

  • Seven or more years of progressively responsible experience in program management, portfolio management, strategic execution, transformation, or complex cross-functional delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multiple interdependent initiatives across organizational or functional boundaries.
  • Demonstrated experience working with senior leaders and executive sponsors to support prioritization, decisions, risk management, and outcome delivery.
  • Experience leading through influence in a matrixed environment.· Experience developing executive-level communications, recommendations, roadmaps, and integrated program or portfolio reporting.
  • Experience identifying and managing cross-project dependencies, resource constraints, and strategic risks.
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, regulated operations, technology-enabled transformation, or another complex regulated environment.
  • Experience with benefits realization, portfolio governance, organizational change, and executive decision facilitation.
  • Experience coaching or developing Project Managers and delivery leaders.
  • Experience using portfolio-management and collaboration platforms to support transparent reporting and decision-making.

LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS

Required

  • None

Preferred

  • PMP, PgMP, PfMP, or comparable program, portfolio, change-management, or agile certification.

What Success Looks Like

  • Thinks at the enterprise level while remaining grounded in delivery realities.
  • Brings leaders insights, implications, options, and recommendations, not simply status updates.
  • Creates clarity where strategy, ownership, scope, or success measures are ambiguous.
  • Distinguishes between the need to orchestrate, coach, escalate, or directly intervene.
  • Builds trust through transparency, preparation, sound judgment, and follow-through.
  • Maintains focus on outcomes, adoption, and realized value.
  • Balances strategic leadership with sufficient delivery fluency to recognize when execution is at risk.
  • Leads effectively through ambiguity, competing priorities, and matrixed accountability.

  • Leverage Insights & Analytics: Use field data, customer insights, and performance trends to identify opportunities, inform priorities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Lead Strategic Initiatives: Own complex, cross-functional projects from strategy through implementation, managing priorities, dependencies, timelines, risks, and stakeholder accountability.

jobs.description:
Here at Hometap, we’re collaborative, passionate, and always ready to roll up our sleeves to create solutions that help people get more out of homeownership — and out of life. Our first product, a home equity investment, gives homeowners the opportunity to quickly access the equity they’ve built in their home to pay for what’s most important to them, from handling debt to finally making much-needed renovations, without taking on debt.

We work hard, and have some fun along the way, too. You don’t have to take our word for it: The Boston Globe and Forbes have recognized us as a great place to work, and we’ve been honored for our commitment to innovation in the fintech space by Inc., HousingWire, and more!

In case you need any more convincing, we also provide competitive compensation, healthcare coverage, generous PTO, a meaningful equity package, and a strong culture with plenty of opportunities for team-building and camaraderie.

Interested in joining us on our mission to make homeownership less stressful and more accessible? We’d love to talk.

Who You Are

We're growing our team and looking for ambitious sales professionals who care about getting it right for the homeowner. In this role, you'll be a homeowner's main point of contact from first call to close: connecting with inbound leads, educating them on Hometap's home equity investment, answering their questions, and guiding them through the application process. You'll own a full pipeline and keep every application moving.

You're a strong fit if you've carried a quota and have a track record of closing, and you pair that drive with empathy in every conversation. You stay organized across a high volume of daily calls, adapt easily when priorities shift, and hold a high bar for ethics and compliance. You're motivated by clear targets and uncapped earning potential, and you're eager to become an expert in a product that's still new to most of the homeowners you'll talk to.

What You'll Do

  • Engage with inbound leads to provide compliant information while connecting with empathy to understand each homeowner's circumstances
  • Serve as a single point of contact throughout the investment process – providing status updates, responding to questions, requesting documentation – while maintaining a high volume of daily calls
  • Coordinate with internal teams (processors, underwriters, etc.) to ensure efficient processes for homeowners
  • Manage your pipeline using Salesforce and Hometap's proprietary Hub, keeping applications up to date and communicating next steps to homeowners and internal stakeholders
  • Become an expert in Hometap's home equity investment (HEI) product and unique sales approach, actively participating in training and ongoing coaching
  • Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly sales goals
  • Stay current on the competitive landscape and collaborate with colleagues across originations, marketing, and legal to resolve questions and improve the homeowner experience

What You Bring

  • 2+ years in a quota-carrying sales role with demonstrated closing experience
  • Experience managing a full sales cycle end-to-end, from initial outreach through contract/agreement execution
  • Track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail
  • Technical aptitude to master internal tools; Salesforce experience is a plus
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt quickly to changing priorities
  • Strong ethical judgment and commitment to regulatory compliance
  • Willingness to become NMLS licensed (Hometap will sponsor); active NMLS licensing is a plus
  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach

Anticipated Start Date: September or October 2026

This is a remote position, and candidates must be based in the continental United States. We have both west and east coast teams, with location-based working hours.

Our team is what makes us great. The on-target compensation for this role is $100,000, with uncapped earning potential for high performers. You’ll also receive meaningful equity, so you can share in our growth and success. We offer generous medical, dental, and vision coverage, a work-from-home stipend, parental leave, and plenty of paid time off to recharge.

Hometap is on a mission to make homeownership less stressful and more accessible. Our home equity investment product provides homeowners with a fast, simple, and straightforward way to access the equity in their home without taking out a loan or having to sell. By investing alongside homeowners, Hometap offers debt-free cash in exchange for a share of their home’s future value — all without any monthly payments over the life of the investment. Through a combination of financial innovation and best-in-class customer service, Hometap enables people to get more from homeownership so they can get more from life.
Hometap believes that our differences are what bring us together, and one of our biggest priorities is creating a diverse workplace that welcomes and values each team member’s unique perspective, background, and ideas. All roles here are filled based solely on candidates’ qualifications and our business needs.

Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of any plans to align with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are hiring a Principal Platform Engineer to help build and scale our Azure-native cloud platform as we migrate services from an on-premises data center to the cloud.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Principal Platform Engineer to help build and scale our Azure-native cloud platform as we migrate services from an on-premises data center to the cloud. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong mentoring component -- you will design and build alongside the team while raising the technical bar for engineers earlier in their careers. You will work across infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, and security tooling, with exposure to both legacy automation modernization and net-new platform capability.

This is an individual contributor role. You will not have direct reports, but you will be expected to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers on the team, including reviewing designs, pairing on complex problems, and setting technical direction by example.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build Azure infrastructure using a cloud native approach, leveraging managed services wherever they meet reliability and cost requirements.
  • Lead technical execution of the migration of services from an on-premises data center to Azure, including dependency mapping, migration sequencing, and cutover risk management.
  • Operate and extend our AKS-based platform, including GitOps deployment patterns, namespace isolation, and policy enforcement.
  • Own and evolve reusable Terraform modules that other engineering teams consume, with clear interface contracts between platform-owned and application-owned infrastructure.
  • Build and maintain observability coverage (metrics, logs, alerting) so that platform and application health are measurable and actionable, not just instrumented.
  • Apply policy-as-code to enforce security, compliance, and operational standards across the platform, and reduce reliance on manual review gates.
  • Design and review Identity and Access Management patterns, including workload identity, least-privilege access models, and secrets management -- with a clear bias away from static credentials.
  • Participate in business continuity and disaster recovery planning for platform services, including failover design, RTO/RPO definition, and recovery testing.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline design and standards used across engineering teams building on the platform.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of the standard workflow, and evaluate where AI-driven platform capabilities (automated remediation, intelligent alerting, natural-language operational tooling) can be responsibly introduced into the platform itself.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code/design review, pairing, and informal technical coaching. Help less experienced engineers build sound judgment around idempotency, error handling, and migration candidacy when evaluating legacy automation.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering roles, with demonstrated Principal-level scope (technical leadership without formal management).
  • Deep hands-on experience with Azure, building cloud native architectures using managed services rather than defaulting to IaaS.
  • Production experience running and operating Kubernetes at scale, ideally AKS specifically.
  • Strong GitOps experience (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent) -- all infrastructure and cluster changes should trace to a git commit as a matter of practice, not preference.
  • Experience leading or significantly contributing to a data center-to-cloud migration, including business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
  • Working fluency in policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent) for security and compliance enforcement.
  • Strong Identity and Access Management background: workload identity federation, least-privilege IAM design, secrets management patterns that avoid static credentials.
  • Experience building and maintaining an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent).
  • Solid Terraform experience, including designing reusable modules consumed by other teams, not just single-project usage.
  • Practical, current experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor other engineers -- through review, pairing, or informal technical leadership -- without formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or operating hub-and-spoke network architectures in Azure.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline design for multi-team, multi-repo environments (e.g., GitHub Actions-based runner infrastructure).
  • Exposure to evaluating or building genuinely AI-driven operational tooling (as distinct from rules-based automation mislabeled as AI).
  • Experience presenting technical tradeoffs to both engineering and business stakeholders.

Web Designer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a skilled Web Designer to create polished, user-centered web experiences that balance visual quality with usability. You’ll translate briefs and product goals into wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes, ensuring designs are responsive, consistent, and ready for development.

Working closely with developers and stakeholders, you’ll own your designs from initial concept through implementation review. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented designer who takes pride in their work, communicates proactively, and can manage projects independently in a remote, asynchronous environment.

What You’ll Own

Visual Design & Prototyping

  • Translate project briefs and product goals into clear, user-centered web designs.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes to communicate design concepts before development begins.
  • Balance visual appeal, usability, and business objectives across web experiences.

Responsive Web Design

  • Design and refine layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
  • Apply responsive design principles to deliver consistent experiences across devices.
  • Consider how layouts and interactions translate into HTML and CSS.

Design System Maintenance

  • Contribute to and improve the existing design system.
  • Maintain consistency across components, typography, colors, spacing, and layouts.
  • Use component libraries and reusable design elements to support efficient workflows.

Developer Collaboration & Handoff

  • Work closely with front-end developers to ensure accurate design implementation.
  • Provide clear specifications, assets, and guidance for layouts and interactions.
  • Answer implementation questions and resolve design-related issues during development.

Feedback & Iteration

  • Incorporate stakeholder and user feedback into design revisions.
  • Refine designs efficiently while keeping the original project goals in focus.
  • Ask clarifying questions and communicate potential blockers early.

Design Quality Assurance

  • Review implemented pages against approved designs.
  • Identify visual inconsistencies, layout issues, and usability concerns.
  • Recommend fixes to maintain a high standard of design quality.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Professional experience in web design, supported by a portfolio demonstrating strong visual judgment, layout skills, and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in a modern design tool such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Experience with component libraries, reusable components, and auto-layout workflows.
  • Solid understanding of responsive design principles and how designs translate into HTML and CSS.
  • Familiarity with UX fundamentals, including information architecture, user flows, accessibility, and usability.
  • Strong written and spoken English for clear communication with distributed teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to refine work based on feedback.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take pride in producing polished, thoughtful design work and maintain high standards without constant supervision.
  • You communicate proactively, clarify requirements early, and keep collaborators informed.
  • You respond constructively to feedback and focus on delivering the best outcome for users and the business.
  • You work effectively in an asynchronous environment and manage your workload reliably.
  • You collaborate well with developers and understand the importance of accurate design handoffs.
  • You take ownership of your designs from concept through final implementation review.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality, user-centered web designs that align with project goals.
  • Responsive layouts that deliver consistent experiences across devices.
  • A well-maintained design system with reusable, consistent components.
  • Clear handoffs that help developers implement designs accurately.
  • Timely, thoughtful revisions based on feedback.
  • Implemented pages that closely match approved designs and meet quality expectations.

Typical Day

You’ll begin by reviewing feedback and comments on active design files and prioritizing your work. Depending on project needs, you may refine a landing page, develop a reusable design component, or revise a product interface.

You may also meet with a developer to discuss a design handoff or clarify an interaction. Later in the day, you’ll review completed work for quality, update project notes, and document progress so teammates across time zones can continue smoothly.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance. Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

We're hiring a Registered Nurse to own after-hours patient monitoring, triage, and clinical escalation for Cadence's chronic care population. This is a high-stakes, independent clinical role operating when primary care offices are closed - covering the hours when patients with hypertension, heart failure, and diabetes need a skilled clinician to respond, not a voicemail. You will work directly with patients and the Cadence care team to ensure continuity of care and clinical safety across every after-hours interaction.

  • Follow up with patients presenting abnormal readings to gather clinical history, assess acuity, and triage to the correct level of care.
  • Document patient case notes in the Cadence platform and log follow-up tasks in ZenDesk to ensure the full care team has a complete clinical record for every after-hours interaction.
  • Respond to inbound patient questions and clinical escalations by phone and text message, maintaining the continuity and trust that define the Cadence care relationship.
  • Conduct outreach to patients with lapses in vital sign adherence and support rescheduling for patients who have missed follow-up touchpoints.
  • Uphold clinical care standards in every patient interaction, reflecting Cadence's commitment to the experience goals of health system partners and the well-being of each patient served.

jobs.excerpt: About InfoMC, Inc.  InfoMC is a fast-paced, healthcare technology company delivering integrated care management and population health solutions to health plans and provider organizations.
jobs.description:
About InfoMC, Inc.

InfoMC is a fast-paced, healthcare technology company delivering integrated care management and population health solutions to health plans and provider organizations. Our person-centered, “whole-person care” and provider approach addresses the behavioral, physical, and social drivers that impact a member’s health and enhances the interaction between plan, enrollee, and provider. Our solutions are designed to help our customers improve quality, reduce costs, and optimize health outcomes for their population.

At InfoMC, we are extraordinarily proud of the company we're building, not to mention our continuous efforts to create a Best Place to Work culture. Our people are InfoMC's biggest competitive advantage and we'll continue to invest in our team and people-first culture.

Position Summary

The Healthcare Claims Business Analyst / Subject Matter Expert (BA/SME) serves as InfoMC’s primary domain authority for healthcare claims operations during new client onboarding engagements on the Incedo claims platform. This individual bridges the gap between client operational workflows and the technical capabilities of the Incedo solution, ensuring that each implementation is aligned with payer-side business requirements, regulatory obligations, and industry standards for electronic data interchange (EDI).

The BA/SME works directly with health plan and managed care organization clients to define requirements, configure workflows, validate transaction sets, and guide teams through end-to-end claims lifecycle processes—from member eligibility through remittance and adjudication. The ideal candidate brings deep payer-side experience with HIPAA-mandated EDI transactions, CMS reporting requirements, and the operational realities of claims processing within Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial health plan environments.

What the Healthcare Claims BA/SME Does:

Claims Domain Expertise & Client Advisory

  • Serve as the internal and client-facing subject matter expert on healthcare claims operations, EDI transaction standards, and payer-side adjudication logic throughout the Incedo onboarding lifecycle
  • Translate client payer workflows and claims processing requirements into detailed business and functional specifications for the Incedo implementation team
  • Advise clients on best practices for configuring claims intake, adjudication rules, coordination of benefits (COB), appeals and grievance workflows, and remittance processing within Incedo
  • Identify gaps between client legacy processes and Incedo capabilities; document and escalate to product/engineering as applicable
  • Support clients in designing claims data migration strategies, including crosswalks from legacy systems and validation of historical claims data integrity

EDI Transaction Set Knowledge & Validation

The BA/SME must possess hands-on functional knowledge of the following HIPAA-mandated ASC X12 transaction sets and their application in a payer environment:

  • 834 – Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance: member eligibility file intake from CMS, employer groups, or TPAs; validation of enrollment spans, plan codes, and subscriber/dependent relationships
  • 270 / 271 – Eligibility Inquiry and Response: real-time and batch eligibility verification, configuration of response logic and benefit information, and integration with member enrollment systems
  • 837P / 837I – Professional and Institutional Claims: inbound claims intake, loop and segment validation, NPI/taxonomy routing, and coordination with Incedo adjudication engine
  • 835 – Healthcare Claim Payment/Advice (ERA): remittance generation, CAS segment coding, ERA reconciliation against adjudicated claims, and ERA/EFT pairing
  • 276 / 277 – Claim Status Request and Response: outbound claims status inquiry workflows, 277CA acknowledgment processing, and payer-to-provider communication configuration
  • 278 – Health Care Services Review (Prior Authorization): inbound and outbound PA request/response workflows, integration with Incedo utilization management module, and CMS-0057-F electronic PA compliance
  • 275 – Patient Information (Additional Information to Support a Health Care Claim): receipt and routing of clinical attachments and supporting documentation submitted by providers in conjunction with claims, including coordination with Incedo adjudication workflows requiring medical records or authorization documentation
  • 999 / TA1 – Functional Acknowledgment and Interchange Acknowledgment: EDI gateway configuration, acknowledgment tracking, and error-handling workflows

Onboarding & Implementation Execution

  • Lead business analysis workstreams during new client onboarding, including requirements discovery sessions, workflow mapping, and gap analysis documentation
  • Develop and maintain detailed business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, data mapping templates, and EDI companion guides customized to each client’s trading partner environment
  • Coordinate with the client’s EDI team and clearinghouse partners to complete end-to-end transaction testing for all applicable X12 transaction sets
  • Facilitate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) for claims processing scenarios, ensuring adjudication outcomes align with client benefit plan configuration and state/federal requirements
  • Document client-specific configurations, workflow decisions, and known edge cases in InfoMC’s implementation knowledge base
  • Partner with Engagement Managers and Technical Leads to ensure claims-related milestones are on track, risks are escalated promptly, and client expectations are managed

Regulatory & Compliance Alignment

  • Maintain current knowledge of CMS regulations, HIPAA transaction and code set standards (45 CFR Part 162), and state Medicaid agency requirements as they affect claims operations
  • Advise clients on compliance with CMS-0057-F (electronic prior authorization), No Surprises Act (NSA) claims adjudication timelines, and applicable state prompt pay laws
  • Support clients in Medicare Advantage (Part C), Medicaid managed care, and CHIP programs in configuring Incedo to meet CMS encounter data submission requirements
  • Monitor and communicate updates to X12 transaction standards, ICD/CPT/HCPCS code set releases, and CMS NCCI edits that may affect client configurations

Knowledge Sharing & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and maintain internal training materials, job aids, and onboarding playbooks related to claims operations and EDI workflows on the Incedo platform
  • Mentor junior implementation staff on payer claims concepts, EDI troubleshooting, and client-facing discovery techniques
  • Collaborate with InfoMC’s Product and Engineering teams to communicate client-driven enhancement requests and emerging market requirements
  • Contribute to the ongoing refinement of InfoMC’s Implementation Playbook with claims-specific best practices and lessons learned

What the Healthcare Claims BA/SME Demonstrates:

  • Deep command of the end-to-end claims lifecycle from the payer’s perspective: member eligibility, claims intake, adjudication, COB, appeals, and remittance
  • Functional mastery of HIPAA ASC X12 transaction sets (834, 837P/I/D, 835, 270/271, 276/277, 278, 999/TA1) with the ability to read, interpret, and troubleshoot raw EDI files
  • Ability to conduct structured discovery sessions with health plan operations teams, extract requirements, and translate them into actionable technical specifications
  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear BRDs, data dictionaries, and process flow diagrams
  • Comfort operating in a client-facing role across multiple concurrent engagements, managing competing priorities with minimal supervision
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to coordinate across internal teams (Implementation, Product, Engineering, QA) and external stakeholders (client IT, clearinghouses, trading partners)
  • Analytical rigor and attention to detail when validating EDI transaction data, reviewing adjudication outcomes, and auditing benefit plan configurations
  • Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL sufficient to support data validation and claims reporting tasks

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a healthcare payer environment (health plan, managed care organization, TPA, or Medicare Advantage plan) in a claims operations or claims business analyst capacity
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with HIPAA X12 EDI transactions including 834, 837P/I/D, 835, 270/271, 275, 276/277, and 278
  • Experience with claims adjudication systems, clearinghouse relationships, and payer-side EDI trading partner onboarding
  • Familiarity with ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS Level II, revenue codes, and NCCI edits in the context of claims processing
  • Experience supporting software implementations or system migrations in a healthcare payer context
  • Ability to travel to client sites as needed (estimated up to 20%)
  • This role is not eligible for sponsorship

Preferred

  • Experience with Medicare Advantage (Part C) or Medicaid managed care claims operations, including CMS encounter data submission
  • Knowledge of CMS-0057-F electronic prior authorization requirements and their claims workflow implications
  • Familiarity with No Surprises Act (NSA) independent dispute resolution and good faith estimate requirements
  • Experience with utilization management or care management platforms that interface with claims adjudication
  • CPHQ, RHIT, RHIA, or equivalent healthcare informatics certification
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  • SQL proficiency for claims data validation and ad hoc reporting
  • Prior experience in a healthcare IT vendor or SaaS implementation environment

Physical Demands / Working Conditions

Light work: this position involves sitting, standing, and/or walking. This is a remote work environment requiring the ability to use a computer and communicate clearly by telephone and video conference. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.


Job Purpose

The Senior Design and Template Specialist is a multidisciplinary designer who works at the intersection of visual design, design systems, and technical implementation. This role helps bridge the Design & Brand team's established template-based workflows with emerging CMS-driven publishing models, translating creative direction into flexible, reusable systems that can scale across print and digital environments.

The Senior Design and TemplateSpecialist will contribute to polished design solutions while building the templates, components, patterns, and structured systems that enable those solutions to be implemented consistently across platforms. This role requires equal comfort with visual design tools and technical workflows and an ability to understand both the creative intent behind a design and the systems required to reproduce it at scale.

Working across Figma, InDesign, PowerPoint, and CMS platforms, the Senior Design and Template Specialist will partner with designers, template designers, digital and cross-functional teams to translate visual concepts into accessible, reusable, and production-ready experiences. As Great Minds' tools, platforms, and publishing workflows evolve, this role will help Design & Brand explore new approaches and establish practices for carrying strong design thinking from static templates into dynamic, component-based environments.


Responsibilities

  • Translate creative direction and established visual designs into scalable templates, reusable components, styles, patterns, libraries, and documentation that promote consistency across print and digital products and platforms.

  • Apply strong typography, layout, hierarchy, color, and information-design principles when developing both static and dynamic design solutions.

  • Partner with Design Leads and Design and Template Specialist colleagues to preserve creative intent as designs move from prototypes into structured production systems.

  • Create, revise, and maintain sophisticated templates and production systems in Figma, InDesign, PowerPoint, and other relevant platforms.

  • Support consistency between print and digital expressions of the same content while recognizing the different requirements of each medium.

  • Serve as a bridge between print design and template workflows and CMS-based publishing.

  • Translate Figma and other design prototypes into specifications, components, and patterns that can be implemented within CMS environments.

  • Work within the capabilities and constraints of CMS platforms to develop design solutions that are flexible, scalable, and maintainable.

  • Collaborate with Digital, Product Management, Content & Editorial, and other cross-functional partners to align design requirements with platform capabilities.

  • Participate in testing and refinement of CMS components to ensure implemented designs meet visual, functional, and accessibility expectations.

  • Build clear documentation, specifications, and usage guidance for designers, production teams, vendors, and cross-functional partners.

  • Apply accessibility requirements including color contrast, typography, reading order, semantic structure, and alternative-text considerations as appropriate to each platform.

  • Share technical knowledge and emerging best practices with the broader Design & Brand team.

  • Provide guidance to designers as workflows shift from page- and template-based thinking toward component- and system-based design.

  • Contribute to a collaborative Design & Brand culture that values experimentation, learning, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience spanning graphic design, digital design, production design, design systems, publishing design, or a related discipline, with demonstrated experience working across both design and technical implementation.

  • Portfolio or work samples demonstrating advanced visual design skills and the ability to translate design systems into functional, reusable templates, components, or digital experiences. Candidates should be prepared to discuss both their design decisions and technical implementation process.

  • Extensive proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, PowerPoint, and related design tools and experience with CMS-based digital workflows; working knowledge of HTML/CSS is a plus.

  • Experience working in an evolving digital environment, including learning to create and manage design components within a CMS-based workflow.

  • Strong collaboration, communication, organization, and time-management skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both creative and technical partners.

  • Intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn new software, platforms, and approaches.

  • Strong understanding of design systems, including reusable components, styles, variables, patterns, libraries, and documentation.

  • Experience with educational publishing, complex content, or large-scale content production is preferred.

  • Experience with scripting, structured content, or AI-assisted production tools is a plus.

Required Education

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related education and/or professional experience.

Full-time

Remote, less than 10% travel
