During rollout you’ll be the operational anchor, making sure each implementation meets technical, operational, and service-level agreement (SLA) standards. You’ll also keep Sales, Client Success, Field Operations, and Product aligned throughout, so every new portfolio sees value fast.

The ideal candidate is an onboarding expert who has run complex, multi-stakeholder rollouts for enterprise clients and knows how to turn new customers into confident users. Strong technical implementation skills are a must, and experience in multifamily real estate is a plus.

This is an individual contributor role with room to grow as the Onboarding function expands. You’ll improve client retention, shorten time-to-value, and speed up the handoff to Client Success, all while refining the process as you go. Along the way, you’ll help build the operational standards and processes that let Onboarding scale.

What You'll Do:


    Onboarding & Implementation

  • Own onboarding for newly contracted properties, regional rollouts, and portfolio acquisitions, from the sales handoff through the first 90 days after launch.

  • Build implementation plans, milestone schedules, and kickoff meetings with regional VPs, Asset Managers, and onsite Community Managers.

  • Coordinate technical setup, data migration, and integrations with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, ResMan, and AppFolio.

  • Make sure community profiles and property access credentials are set up accurately before go-live.

  • Lead virtual and onsite training for Regional Managers, Property Managers, Leasing Consultants, and Maintenance teams.

    • Client Experience

  • Serve as the primary contact and escalation point during the 90-day onboarding window, and diagnose and resolve implementation issues quickly.

  • Build trust with VPs of Property Operations, Asset Managers, and Regional VPs by tying the platform to the metrics they care about: NOI, occupancy, and resident retention.

  • Run implementation reviews and post-launch health checks to drive adoption and catch churn risk early.

  • Track SLA compliance, setup turnaround, CSAT, and early adoption, and act on warning signs before they turn into escalations.

    • Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Run formal sales-to-onboarding handoffs to confirm scope, custom contract terms, and client expectations.

  • Get Field Operations, Logistics, and Support aligned on property readiness ahead of each go-live.

  • Bring client feedback, feature requests, and bug escalations to Product and Engineering.

  • Keep Salesforce and project tools accurate so leadership has clear portfolio reporting.

    • Process Improvement & Enablement

  • Find recurring friction points and turn the fixes into SOPs, playbooks, and launch checklists that help onboarding scale.

  • Create client-facing onboarding materials and training guides built around multifamily workflows.

  • Lead workflow automation projects in Salesforce, project management tools, and ticketing systems, partnering with Revenue Operations.

  • Act as the team’s subject matter expert on onboarding, sharing best practices with Client Success team members.

What Success Looks Like:

    In your first year, success means:

  • New properties go live on schedule, meet SLAs, and start with strong satisfaction and health scores.

  • The playbooks, SOPs, and automations you build are adopted across Client Services.

  • You resolve complex, multi-property launch issues on your own and keep internal teams on track through tight timelines.

  • Teammates count on you as a go-to resource for onboarding.

What You'll Need:


    Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years in client onboarding or implementation at a B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services company.

  • A track record of leading enterprise or multi-location rollouts from handoff to adoption, including building the playbooks and SOPs behind them.

  • Experience coordinating software integrations or data migrations with clients and technical teams.

Over the next 12-24 months you will streamline the program architecture, shift incentives from activity toward growth, adoption and customer outcomes, establish one trusted partner data and attribution model, and scale the ISV and marketplace motion for the AI era. The VAR and ISV programs carry the most revenue and strategic weight and will receive the majority of your investment; OEM, Services and Alliance are held to the same standards of governance, economics and accuracy, with proportionate effort. You will be the single leader accountable for how the programs are structured, measured and operationalized, and how they incent and compensate partners across all five engagements.

You will work closely with our channel, isv, oem and alliance partner management organizations to drive towards measured targets with minimums established by each of the program frameworks. In addition to the frameworks, you will own the compliance, the economics, the data and the infrastructure, and the tools those relationships run on. You will present general proposals for program structure and economics to executive leadership.

You will work closely with the partner recruiting, education and enablement teams to ensure that the established program frameworks provide definitional direction to the development of educational content for use in the enablement motion as well as for partners who are struggling to meet minimum standards or even not live up to their fullest potential. You will stand up tools and reporting mechanisms which support the various functional motions within the organization, including account managers, that will help all parties track and measure partner success and failure.

You will also be responsible for overseeing onboarding and offboarding of partners and your team will lead compliance efforts when partners underperform.

Strong cross-functional leadership is an essential element of success in this role.

  • Responsibilities Across All Five Programs (VAR, ISV, OEM, Services and Alliance).
  • Each program is in a different stage of maturity. You will design, govern and evolve each program as needed, including standards, eligibility, tiers, benefits, requirements, and operating standards.
  • Own the program roadmap and annual refresh cycle, incorporating partner feedback, competitive benchmarking, financial modeling, executive approval and launch.
  • Maintain consistent internally and externally facing documentation across all programs, including governance documents, program guides, policies, and FAQs.

WHO WE ARE

GreenSlate is the fastest-growing provider of technology and business solutions for media productions. We provide the most advanced technology for production accounting and entertainment payroll. Our innovative cloud-based platform is evolving the entertainment industry’s back-office by replacing inefficient paper-based processes with digital solutions. The studios, film franchises, independent producers, and content creators we serve benefit from greater efficiencies, better access to data, and cost savings, and they minimize their impact on the environment. $65K to $72K

We are seeking an accomplished, visionary leader to join our team, focusing on the critical area of Identity and Access Management. In this Lead role, you will be responsible for defining the technical roadmap, establishing our center of excellence, and overseeing the design, implementation, and mentorship of our Active Directory strategy. You will leverage your expertise to drive best practices in directory services, authentication, and authorization, empowering our teams to proactively secure our environment, optimize user access, and deliver a seamless, secure user experience. Coupa operates an open and autonomous work culture, where employees are challenged and critical thinking is encouraged. We operate an inverted organization structure, meaning we support our employees, not manage them. This is core to our culture and we do everything we can to foster an entrepreneurial spirit within our team as we strive for personal and organizational excellence.

What You'll Do:

  • Architect and maintain an 'Identity-as-Code' ecosystem, utilizing CI/CD pipelines to automate directory changes, security policy updates, and infrastructure provisioning for our global Active Directory deployment.

  • Spearhead the onboarding and integration of applications and services with modern identity platforms such as Okta for authentication and authorization.

  • Own and publish standards/best practice documentation for identity architecture, administration, and security, serving as the domain's authority.

  • Competency in PowerShell, Python, or equivalent scripting languages for automation.

  • Solid understanding of networking systems and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP).

Test Expert (Tricentis Tosca), Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA), Remote

BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a Test Expert to design, develop, troubleshoot, and maintain Tricentis automated tests and integrate them into DevSecOps CI/CD pipelines supporting mission-critical Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) application development and pilots.

Our client is a technology integrator that supports government customers with IT modernization, performance engineering, and cybersecurity. Its engineering teams collaborate on complex technical programs in a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and professional development.

What will you do

The Test Expert is a hands-on technical specialist responsible for designing, developing, troubleshooting, and maintaining automated tests across the Tricentis Quality Engineering platform, including Tosca, qTest, NeoLoad, LiveCompare, and Elastic Execution Grid (EEG), and integrating those capabilities directly into DevSecOps CI/CD pipelines supporting mission-critical DCSA application development and pilots. This role is exclusively Tricentis-focused; knowledge of other DevSecOps tools is helpful for integration, but delivery outcomes rely on Tricentis end-to-end.

Embedded with developers, schedulers, and DevSecOps engineers, the Test Expert ensures automated testing is tightly integrated early in the lifecycle (“shift left”), with audit-ready traceability and release gate coverage.

The Test Expert works under the direction of the Senior Test Lead and is embedded with developers, schedulers, and DevSecOps engineers to ensure automated testing is tightly integrated early in the development lifecycle (“shift left”).

The position may be performed remotely, with periodic on-site participation in meetings in Quantico, VA or Annapolis, MD as required.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Tricentis Tosca Automation

  • Build modular, reusable, scalable tests in Tosca across UI, API, Mobile (Mobile Engine 3.0), Vision AI, and packaged apps (e.g., SAP).
  • Apply Model Based Test Automation, Test Case Design, and Test Data Management (TDM) to minimize maintenance and maximize stability.
  • Design end to end business process flows and risk-based suites aligned to pilot workflows.

CI/CD Orchestration & Elastic Execution

  • Configure and operate Elastic Execution Grid (EEG) for parallel, scalable execution (use DEX where legacy constraints are required).
  • Embed test triggers in Jenkins or Azure DevOps and orchestrate with qTest Launch for consistent scheduling and consolidated results.
  • Troubleshoot environment, pipeline, and artifact issues to keep the grid healthy and predictable.
  • Run automated test suites regularly, analyze results, and perform hands-on debugging of failures.
  • Identify root causes across data, environment, configuration, or application defects.
  • Log defects in qTest or JIRA and maintain full traceability between requirements, test assets, and execution results.

Performance, Quality Management, Traceability & Defects

  • Maintain end-to-end traceability in qTest Manager/Insights from requirements through execution and defects; publish audit-ready reports and dashboards.
  • Log defects (e.g., in qTest or Jira) with actionable analysis and root-cause insights.
  • Design and execute NeoLoad tests for APIs, microservices, and user journeys; integrate performance checks into CI/CD release gates.
  • Use LiveCompare (for SAP/ERP or similar) to focus testing on change-impacted, high-risk areas.

Collaboration With Technical Teams

  • Convert user stories into executable Tricentis scenarios; partner with developers to make features automation-ready in Tosca and wired to qTest/EEG early in sprints.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, and pipeline readiness activities to stabilize pilot delivery.

Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously improve Tosca architecture, TDM strategies, and EEG utilization; adopt Vision AI and risk-based optimization where appropriate.
  • Recommend coverage, stability, and execution-efficiency improvements, and support regression readiness assessments.
  • Improve automation architectures, reusable components, naming standards, and maintainability practices.
  • Adopt emerging Tricentis capabilities (API testing, Vision AI, risk-based optimization) when mission-appropriate.
  • Recommend improvements to pilot test coverage, stability, and execution efficiency.
  • Support regression readiness assessments with hands-on validation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s in computer science, IT, Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience considered.
  • 3–8+ years in software testing and test automation.
  • Practical familiarity with qTest Manager/Insights and NeoLoad; experience integrating Tricentis into CI/CD/DevSecOps environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca (AS1/AS2, AE1/AE2, or equivalent).
  • Experience with UI, API, and data validation; strong collaboration across developers, testers, schedulers, and DevSecOps engineers.
  • Active Secret clearance and U.S. citizenship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Breadth across Tricentis modules: Elastic Execution Grid (or DEX), qTest Launch, NeoLoad, LiveCompare, Vision AI, Mobile Engine 3.0.
  • Tricentis Tosca certifications (AS1/AS2 or higher).
  • Experience with Tosca DEX, TestCase Design, Test Data Management, Test Events.
  • Experience testing federal or DoD applications, preferably with DCSA programs.
  • Experience working with Jira, GitLab, GitHub, ServiceNow, SonarQube, or WalkMe.
  • Experience implementing automation in cloud environments.

Job Title: Therapeutic Strategy Lead - IMM - (Mandarin Speaker)

Join Our Team as a Therapeutic Strategy Lead!

Are you passionate about creating innovative delivery strategies that meet customer needs? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where you can make a real impact? If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you!


Purpose

As a Therapeutic Strategy Lead, you’ll develop and implement effective delivery strategies tailored to customer needs during the RFP/Bid Defense cycle. You’ll bridge the gap between sales, medical, and operational teams to ensure seamless project execution and support sales teams throughout the Business Development process.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Actively collaborate with Sales, Medical, Operations, and other functions and provide guidance to ensure tailor-made strategies to project or programs that differentiate IQVIA from the competition resulting in compelling, feasible proposals and continuously drive business growth.
  • Scan the therapeutic and operational landscape and take account of wider impacts to develop long term implementation strategies that maximize opportunities to add value.
  • Maintain an understanding of current and future market trends that may impact current and/or future innovative operational delivery strategies.
  • Act as champion for project centricity within the organization through enabling the project delivery team assigned to an awarded project to understand and implement the project strategy that was sold.
  • Drive the team to leverage and consolidate all available data to build the project strategy. Balance use of external research and data with IQVIA’s internal data sources.
  • Guide and mentor assigned Project Leader so that they can confidently present the project strategy to the client and the internal stakeholders.
  • Actively support Sales in the preparation and conduct of customer and bid defense meetings e.g. training and preparation of the assigned project team.
  • Attend, present and lead or bid defense meeting or customer meeting, as required
  • Identify any quality issues within the study and provide coaching on resolution of issues, including implementation of corrective and preventative action plans and escalation.
  • Ensure project/program budget(s) meet financial and company goals, including Gross New Business.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Deep and current knowledge of the scientific, clinical operations, real world, regulatory, operational, commercial and competitive landscape in applicable therapeutic area.
  • ·Strong global knowledge and awareness/understanding of the biopharma industry, drug development lifecycle and operational clinical trial delivery.
  • In-depth knowledge of applicable clinical research regulatory requirements; e.g. Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines.
  • Strong business acumen including confidence with financial considerations, excellent negotiation and influencing skills, and comfort working in both sales and operational environments.
  • Strong customer management skills and demonstrated ability to understand customer needs, have difficult conversations with internal/external stakeholders and customers, negotiate solutions and understand impacts on the overall program/portfolio.
  • Strong leadership skills, ability to lead a virtual team in a matrix organization.
  • Ability to work strategically to realize organizational and project goals, identifying and developing positive and compelling visions for the successful delivery of projects and taking account of a wide range of issues across, and related to, the projects and the organization.
  • Strong presentation skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal communication and interpersonal skills, including good command of English language (both written and spoken).
  • Proficiency in Mandarin language
  • Strong software and computer skills, including MS Office applications.
  • Must have prior experience in the Clinical Research Organization (CRO) industry

MINIMUM REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences and relevant global clinical research experience (director level), including hands on operational delivery and/or drug development experience in the applicable therapeutic area (IMM)

jobs.title: ML Engineer (Forward Deployed)
jobs.excerpt: Applied Computing was founded in 2023 to build Orbital, a physics-informed foundation model for energy operations.
jobs.description:
Applied Computing was founded in 2023 to build Orbital, a physics-informed foundation model for energy operations. We’re live across oil and gas, refineries, and petrochemicals, working towards our mission: sustainable

abundance for a growing planet.

The hydrocarbon industry keeps the world running. But its complexity has left operators tied to legacy systems, making critical decisions on less than 10% of available data. We built Orbital to change that. It’s a foundation model built specifically for energy that lets companies use AI at scale, harnessing all of their operational
data and optimising in real time for any metric. Decisions get faster, operations get safer, and carbon intensity falls.

We’ve raised over $32 million, including one of the largest seed rounds for an
AI company in the UK. We’re just getting started

As a Forward Deployed ML Engineer, your job is to make Orbital’s AI systems work in customer reality. You will deploy, configure, tune, and operationalise our deep learning models inside live industrial environments; spanning cloud, on-premise, hybrid, and air-gapped infrastructure.

This is nota pure research role.

You are not training experimental models in isolation. You are adapting production AI systems to customer data, configuring agents and RAG pipelines, tuning anomaly detection, and ensuring models deliver value in production workflows.

If Research builds the models, you make them work on-site.

Operating Context

Forward Deployed ML Engineers operate in pods of threealongside:
• Full Stack Engineers
• Data Engineers
Each pod delivers2–3 customer deployments per quarter, owning AI configuration, model tuning, agent orchestration, and inference reliability in production.

  • MSc in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred).

  • Solid software engineering background; designing and debugging distributed systems.

  • Experience building and running Dockerised microservices, ideally with Kubernetes/EKS.

  • LLM API integrations (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini), FastAPI for ML services and REST inference APIs

  • Familiarity with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Comfort working in hybrid cloud/on-prem deployments (AWS, Databricks, or industrial environments).

  • Exposure to time-series or industrial data (historians, IoT, SCADA/DCS logs) is a plus.

  • Domain experience working as a data scientist in oil and gas or energy is a plus.

  • Ability to work in forward-deployed settings, collaborating directly with customers.

  • Comfortable in customer-facing technical roles.

  • Able to operate in forward-deployed environments.

  • Strong troubleshooting capability in production AI systems

What Success Looks Like
• AI systems are deployed and running in customer environments.
• Models are tuned to customer data and delivering operational value.
• Anomalies and predictions are trusted by engineers.
• Multi-agent copilots function reliably in production workflows.
• RAG systems retrieve accurate, domain-relevant insights.
• Inference pipelines run with high uptime and low latency.

1) AI System Deployment & Configuration

• Deploy Orbital’s AI/ML services into customer environments.
• Configure inference pipelines across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid infrastructure.
• Package and deploy ML services via Docker/Kubernetes.
• Ensure inference services are reliable, scalable, and production-ready.

2) Time Series & Predictive Model Tuning

• Deploy and tune time-series forecasting and anomaly detection models.
• Adapt models to customer-specific industrial processes.
• Configure thresholds, alerting logic, and detection sensitivity.
• Validate model outputs against engineering expectations.
Typical model classes include:
• Gradient boosting models (LightGBM)
• Transformer models
• Statistical anomaly detection methods
• Multivariate monitoring systems
3) Multi-Agent & LLM System Configuration
• Deploy and configure multi-agent AI systems for customer workflows.
• Set up LLM provider integrations (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini).
• Configure agent routing and orchestration logic.
• Tune prompts and workflows for operational use cases.
4) Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
• Deploy RAG pipelines in customer environments.
• Ingest customer documentation and operational knowledge.
• Configure knowledge graphs and vector databases.
• Tune retrieval pipelines for accuracy and latency.
5) Intelligent Data Agents
• Configure SQL agents for structured customer datasets.
• Deploy visualization agents for exploratory analytics.
• Adapt agents to customer schemas and naming conventions.
6) Explainability & Interpretability
• Generate SHAP explanations for model outputs.
• Build interpretability reports for engineering stakeholders.
• Explain anomaly drivers and optimisation recommendations.
• Support trust and adoption of AI insights.
7) Forward Deployment & Customer Integration
• Deploy AI systems into restricted industrial networks.
• Integrate inference pipelines with:
o Historians
o OPC UA servers
o IoT data streams
o Process control systems
• Work with IT/OT teams to satisfy infrastructure and security constraints.
• Debug production issues in live operational environments.
8) Production Reliability & MLOps
• Monitor inference performance and drift.
• Troubleshoot production model failures.
• Version models and datasets (DVC or equivalent).
• Maintain containerised ML deployments.

• Support CI/CD for model updates.

jobs.description:
Werden Sie selbstständiger Überführungsfahrermit DriiveMe Partner

Erhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.

👉Registrieren Sie sich hier, um auf die Aufträge zuzugreifen:

DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.

Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe, um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar und viele weitere.

In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.

Worin besteht ein DriiveMe-Auftrag?

Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

  1. Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

  2. Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

  3. Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

  4. Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

  5. Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

  6. Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

  • Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

  • Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

  • Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

  • Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

  • Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

Wie viel verdiene ich?

Ihr Umsatz hängt davon ab, wie viele Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

Jeder Auftrag hat eine eigene Vergütung, die sich nach der Strecke, der Anzahl der Kilometer und der Komplexität des Transports richtet.

Bevor Sie einen Auftrag buchen, kennen Sie alle wichtigen Informationen: Abholort, Zielort, Vergütung und Bedingungen. Sie entscheiden frei, welche Aufträge Sie annehmen möchten.

Who We Are

HeadSpin is a unique developer platform that combines data science insights and global device infrastructure to enable companies to perfect their digital experiences during the engineering cycle. HeadSpin platform is present in over 50 countries. Its data science platform has an ability to assess over 130 performance KPIs, analyze root cause of the poor experience issues and recommend solutions to address them. HeadSpin differentiates itself from other testing solutions that only focus on functional or load testing. By using HeadSpin, companies have enhanced their customer experience, reduced time to market and optimized the cost of their digital applications.

About the Role

As a Junior Support Engineer you'll be on the front line keeping HeadSpin's device in the Cloud and On-Premises running smoothly. You will be supporting and maintaining the devices, servers and proprietary infrastructure that make up the core of the HeadSpin platform. Your primary responsibility will be responding to incidents and outages, both from proactive monitoring and from customer reports. This can include offline and unresponsive hardware and services, security incidents or other disruptions to HeadSpin services. You will manage the lifecycle of these issues from first report to resolution and handle appropriate escalation of issues to other teams within HeadSpin. You will work with a team of other professionals creating a robust, accountable and responsive process able to deal reliably, rapidly and accurately to outages and issues in the HeadSpin platform.

As a Support team member you will be expected to understand the roles of other technical and engineering teams at HeadSpin to properly collaborate and escalate issues. You will also be expected to understand our infrastructure, vendors and major customers around the world to properly address global issues spanning HeadSpin sites, data centers and customer locations. Most commonly you will work directly with support staff from our Data Center Logistics and Data Center Engineering teams at HeadSpin sites and datacenter to recover or debug unresponsive hardware and services.

The Support team at HeadSpin is part of our critical infrastructure and members of the team are expected to be part of an on-call rotation to provide continuous coverage for incidents.

HeadSpin values the unique knowledge provided by our frontline operations teams, your feedback on common issues, operational pain points, and processes will be key for the rapid growth of HeadSpin. You will be encouraged to give your input and help make our operations teams healthy and dynamic places to work.

What You’ll Do

  • Triage and respond to tickets relating to incidents and outages both generated by automated monitoring and customer reports

  • Directly work with global HeadSpin sites and Data Center smart hands or technician to debug and recover systems and hardware

jobs.excerpt: OverviewPatchstack protects WordPress sites for hosts, agencies and developers, and we're now launching a security product for people building JavaScript apps with AI tools like Claude Code.
jobs.description:
Overview

Patchstack protects WordPress sites for hosts, agencies and developers, and we're now launching a security product for people building JavaScript apps with AI tools like Claude Code. That product is early. We have good signals from hosts and hackathons, but we haven't yet found who it serves best, what they value, or why they'll keep paying for it.

You'll be the product manager who finds that out. You'll talk to customers, use the product in real AI-assisted workflows, test ideas quickly with our designer and engineers, and build the measurement that tells us what's working. You'll work alongside two small engineering squads, a senior product designer, QA and infrastructure. You own which customer problems we invest in and how we learn from the results.

About you

You're happiest early, before the answers exist. You'd rather run a small test this week than wait for perfect data. You're comfortable in a terminal and have built things with AI-assisted tools, so you can use our product the way our customers do. You form your own view on technical claims rather than taking "it's not feasible" or "the metric improved" at face value. You say what you think, including when it's awkward, and you change your mind when the evidence says so. You work well in a flat team with little process, and you help people around you get better rather than taking work off them.

Responsibilities

  • Run customer discovery for the JavaScript product: interviews, observed usage, support and event feedback, and your own hands-on use.
  • With Growth and Product Marketing, recommend which customers and problems to focus on, backed by evidence of who uses, who pays and why.
  • Shape what we build with the Senior Product Designer from early discovery through testing. You own the problem and intended outcome; they own the design response.
  • Agree outcomes and priorities with the engineering squads and help them turn validated problems into work. Squads own delivery.
  • Build and ship small prototypes, experiments and product changes yourself where that's the fastest way to learn, within our review and QA process.
  • Own product measurement in PostHog: define the actions that matter, get tracking in place, and combine the numbers with customer evidence to explain what's working.
  • Keep what we've learned, decided and assumed visible in Notion so the team can make good investment calls.
  • Raise risks, gaps and decisions early, and escalate anything beyond your remit.

Requirements

  • Experience as a product manager on a technical or developer-facing product, ideally pre or early product-market fit.
  • Examples of changing or stopping a product direction based on customer and technical evidence you gathered yourself.
  • Hands-on with AI-assisted development, the command line, packages and dependencies. You don't need to be a production engineer, but you need to be at home in that environment.
  • Strong customer research and data analysis skills, including building useful measurement from little reliable data.
  • Clear, direct communication with designers, engineers and leadership in a remote, low-process team.

Benefits

  • €75–100k salary, depending on location and experience, plus company stock options
  • 4.5-day working week (half-day Fridays)
  • Remote-first, with reasonable overlap with EU timezones
  • 38 days' paid time off a year (including public holidays) plus 3 health days
  • Company laptop, and co-working membership or home-office equipment
  • AI tooling budget
  • Quarterly health and wellness allowance
  • Travel for conferences, events and our annual company meetup

jobs.excerpt: Revenue team · Reports to the Head of Revenue · Remote first The roleArc makes precision engineered aluminium and titanium cases for the devices people use most, sold as an object rather than an accessory.
jobs.description:
Revenue team · Reports to the Head of Revenue · Remote first

The role

Arc makes precision engineered aluminium and titanium cases for the devices people use most, sold as an object rather than an accessory. The business has grown quickly on one hero product, trades worldwide with the US and UK as its core markets, and has built a large and growing customer base along the way.

That customer base is the opportunity. Arc has invested heavily in acquiring customers and comparatively little in developing them, which means there is substantial untapped value in people who already own and like the product. The platform, the agency support and the data are in place. What comes next is the programme that makes the most of them: sharper segmentation, a lifecycle built around how customers actually buy, and a loyalty proposition that suits a considered, upgrade driven purchase.

This is a build role, and a commercially significant one. Improvement here falls through to profit without media cost attached, which makes retention the one lever that strengthens acquisition economics and revenue at the same time. You will be hands on, you will make the case for investment, and you will have room to build it your way.

What you are accountable for

  • Developing customers beyond a first purchase: growing the proportion who return, and the value they bring when they do.

  • Revenue generated through owned channels: email, SMS, loyalty and any channel added over time, and their contribution to the overall number.

  • The customer database as a commercial asset: its structure, accuracy, health and usefulness to the wider team.

  • The lifecycle experience after purchase: everything between the order confirmation and the next purchase.

  • Customer understanding: being the person who understands the customer best, and making sure the rest of the business benefits from it.

  • The contribution of our CRM partner: the output we get, the value we receive, and how the relationship develops.

What you own

Lifecycle strategy and roadmap

  • The retention plan, its sequencing, and the case for what gets built first

  • The flow architecture end to end: welcome, browse and basket recovery, post purchase, fitting and care, upgrade moments, replenishment and back in stock

  • The campaign calendar, and how it maps to the trading year and to product launches

  • Identifying the moments that matter commercially and building around them, rather than sending to a fixed schedule

Segmentation and customer data

  • Developing the segmentation model around behaviour and value, building on what exists today

  • Identifying high value customers early and treating them accordingly

  • Recognising that customers return for different reasons, and tailoring programmes to each

  • List health: growth, engagement, suppression and consent across markets

  • Making the database genuinely useful to the acquisition side for audience building and exclusion

Owned channels: email, SMS and beyond

  • Strategy, calendar, briefing and final approval on what goes out

  • Campaign programming: the mix of brand, product, launch and promotional sends, and the frequency the audience will bear

  • Deliverability and sender reputation

  • The testing programme across subject lines, creative, offer and timing

  • Platform configuration, and getting the most from the current stack

  • Growing the channel mix over time. SMS is the immediate opportunity, with direct mail and other owned channels worth evaluating where the price point and the customer justify them

Reactivation and lapsed customers

  • The lapsed customer strategy, including how lapse is defined by behaviour rather than by a fixed window

  • Win back programmes, and the judgement on which customers are worth reactivating and at what cost

  • Testing reactivation offers against holdouts, so the true cost of winning someone back is known rather than assumed

  • A sunset policy, so that attention and spend concentrate where there is a realistic prospect of return

Voice of the customer

  • Owning customer feedback loops: reviews, surveys, post purchase responses and recurring support themes

  • Working closely with customer support, who own the queue, to turn what customers actually ask and complain about into briefs for the site, the product pages, the lifecycle programme and the product roadmap

  • Keeping segments and personas alive as working tools rather than a one off exercise

  • Being the voice of the customer in trading and planning conversations, and bringing evidence rather than opinion

Agency direction

  • Reviewing what is live, forming an independent view, and setting the roadmap from there

  • The brief, the targets and the review rhythm

  • Assessing value delivered and guiding how the partnership develops

Offer and lifecycle promotions

  • When an offer is used, at what level and for whom

  • Protecting margin by reserving incentives for customers who genuinely need them

  • Agreeing policy with the Head of Revenue and holding to it

Loyalty

  • Designing a proposition suited to a considered, upgrade driven purchase rather than a generic points scheme

  • Evaluating and selecting a platform where one is needed

  • Launch, adoption and ongoing management

Cross sell and lifecycle merchandising

  • Growing the number of customers who buy more than one product, led by lifecycle rather than discount

  • Post purchase and accessory sequences, and the timing of them

  • Working with the brand and product side on what is promoted and when

Post purchase experience and foundations

  • The full sequence: confirmation, dispatch, arrival, fitting and care, review request and follow on

  • Working with brand and operations so the unboxing and follow up match the price point

  • Integrations between the ecommerce platform, CRM, advertising platforms and the support desk, so reporting can be trusted

Where this role starts and stops

This role owns the customer database and the lifecycle after purchase. The Acquisition Manager owns the journey up to and including the first purchase, and the website that carries it, because the majority of Arc's traffic is new to the brand and site conversion is an acquisition measure. Where the two meet:

  • Email and SMS capture on site: you own the mechanic and the offer. Acquisition owns placement and its effect on conversion.

  • Audiences built from customer data: you own the segments. Acquisition owns how they are applied in platform.

  • Paid activity aimed at existing customers: Acquisition executes it, measured jointly with you on repeat revenue.

  • Pages for returning and logged in customers: you brief the requirement. Acquisition owns the roadmap and build priority.

  • Promotional offers: you own lifecycle offers. Acquisition owns acquisition offers. Policy is set with the Head of Revenue.

  • Customer feedback and support themes: customer support owns the queue and the response. You own the insight and what the business does with it.

Crossover is expected and healthy. Where ownership is not obvious, the test is simple: which measure moves if this works, and who is accountable for it. The Head of Revenue settles anything genuinely ambiguous.

Working with our agency partner

  • Partner: campaign and flow build. You: strategy, and the roadmap the build serves.

  • Partner: design and deployment. You: briefing, approval and quality control.

  • Partner: platform reporting. You: deciding what is measured and what good looks like.

  • Partner: executing the calendar. You: owning the calendar and what belongs on it.

  • Partner: recommending tactics. You: judging which tactics fit the brand and the margin.

How the role is measured

Targets are set with the Head of Revenue and reviewed quarterly.

  • Repeat customer rate

  • Repeat purchases as a share of total revenue

  • Revenue and gross profit per acquired customer over twelve months

  • Owned channel share of sessions and of revenue

  • Split between automated flow revenue and campaign revenue

  • Reactivation rate of lapsed customers, and the cost of achieving it

  • Discount rate applied to repeat orders

  • Cross sell rate, and average order value on multi product orders

  • Time between first and second purchase

  • Engaged list size and growth, alongside deliverability health

  • Loyalty enrolment and participation, once live

  • Review volume and rating trend, and customer insight translated into action elsewhere in the business

Practical terms

  • Reporting line: Head of Revenue

  • Level: Manager, with a clear route to Head of as the channel and team grow

  • Location: Remote first. UK or European time zones, with a quarterly in person meet up

  • Team: Agency partners from the outset, with additional headcount planned as the channel matures

  • Salary: £40,000 to £55,000 base salary, dependent on experience

Requirements

The calibre we are looking for

  • Has owned a CRM platform hands on, personally building flows and segments rather than briefing others to do it

  • Has developed a retention programme from an early stage rather than only maintaining a mature one. The first year here is about building

  • Comfortable with cohort and lifetime value analysis. Can read a repeat purchase curve, size the opportunity and argue for the investment

  • Commercially minded about promotions, and able to judge when an incentive is genuinely earning its cost

  • A self starter who is comfortable building process in a small, fast moving team

Useful, but not essential

  • Launched a loyalty programme

  • SMS as well as email, or offline channels such as direct mail

  • Premium or considered purchase categories

  • Products tied to a replacement or upgrade cycle

  • Running customer research, surveys or structured feedback programmes

  • Experience of a CRM platform migration

Job Title: Director, Medical Safety

Job Location: Reading, Berkshire, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Responsibilities

  • Conduct medical review of clinical trial and post-marketing safety data, including adverse events (AEs), adverse drug reactions (ADRs), coding, causality, expectedness, seriousness assessments, and benefit-risk evaluations.
  • Provide medical oversight and review of safety documentation, including narratives, aggregate reports, annual and periodic safety reports, risk management plans, regulatory submissions, labeling, protocols, investigator brochures, and case report forms.
  • Support safety governance activities, including Data Safety Monitoring Boards, Safety Monitoring Committees, medical information escalations, pharmacovigilance oversight, and 24-hour medical support as required.
  • Serve as Global Safety Physician, project lead, or medical safety advisor, ensuring quality, compliance, operational delivery, training, stakeholder communication, and timely completion of deliverables.
  • Present safety findings and provide expert medical consultation to clients, internal teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Lead and develop medical safety teams through people management, workload planning, performance management, mentoring, training, resource allocation, and succession planning.
  • Oversee financial, operational, and quality performance of assigned projects, ensuring appropriate resourcing and regulatory compliance.
  • Contribute to business development activities, including proposals, budgeting, bid defenses, client presentations, strategic planning, and service-line growth initiatives.
  • Represent the Medical Safety function internally and externally, maintaining key stakeholder relationships and supporting organizational objectives.
  • Drive continuous improvement through awareness of industry, regulatory, and pharmacovigilance developments, and undertake special projects as required.
  • Provide global medical safety and pharmacovigilance oversight across clinical development and post-marketing programs.
  • Lead medical review of safety data, regulatory reports, risk management strategies, and benefit-risk assessments.
  • Manage medical safety projects, ensuring quality, compliance, stakeholder engagement, and on-time delivery.
  • Lead, develop, and resource teams of physicians and medical safety professionals globally.
  • Support business growth through client engagement, proposals, strategic initiatives, and service-line leadership.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Experience

  • Strong knowledge of global pharmacovigilance, clinical research, safety reporting, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • In-depth understanding of clinical development, pharmaceutical research, and medical safety/monitoring activities.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality outcomes in a complex environment.
  • Strong consulting, communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence clients and cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated leadership capability, including people management, project oversight, financial accountability, and strategic decision-making.
  • Medical degree (MD or equivalent) from an accredited institution, with substantial clinical practice experience and/or pharmaceutical physician experience.
  • Significant experience in medical safety, pharmacovigilance, or medical monitoring within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or healthcare industry.

Job Description

Job Title: Data Engineering Senior Manager

Cushman & Wakefield (NYSE: CWK) is a leading global commercial real estate services firm for property owners and occupiers with approximately 52,000 employees in nearly 400 offices and 60 countries. For additional information, visit www.cushmanwakefield.com.

Career Level: M6

Role Summary:

We are seeking a Manager of Data Engineering who is equally comfortable engineering data platforms and developing the engineers who build on them. This is a hybrid technical and people leadership role: the successful candidate will continue to contribute hands-on to data engineering deliverables on Databricks and Azure while also leading, mentoring, and growing a team of 5–8 data engineers and analysts.

Reporting to the Global Head of Data Architecture & Engineering, the Data Engineering Manager will be a member of the Global Data Leadership team and will help shape data engineering strategy, standards, and execution across the organization. The role requires fluency with Databricks and the Azure ecosystem today, and the adaptability to evaluate and adopt additional data technologies as our platform evolves.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership

< >Platform ownership: Lead the design, build, and continuous improvement of scalable data pipelines, Lakehouse architectures, and data products on Databricks and Azure, ensuring our engineering and architectural standards for performance, reliability, and cost are consistently delivered. Hands-on contribution: Remain an active practitioner by contributing to high-impact pipelines, code reviews, architecture reviews, and complex troubleshooting.Quality and governance: Champion data quality, observability, security, and governance practices, embedding them into the team’s engineering lifecycle and platform standards.

People Leadership

< >Team management: Directly manage a team of 5–8 data engineers, owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, compensation recommendations, and retention.Coaching and development: Provide regular coaching, feedback, and career development planning for each team member, with clear growth paths for both individual contributor and leadership tracks.Culture and engagement: Foster an inclusive, high-trust team culture grounded in psychological safety, technical curiosity, accountability, and continuous learning.

Project and Work Orchestration

< >Delivery ownership: Plan, prioritize, and orchestrate the team’s portfolio of data engineering work, ensuring on-time, on-quality delivery aligned with global data and business priorities.Agile execution: Establish and refine agile delivery practices (intake, estimation, sprint planning, retrospectives) that balance discovery work, platform investment, and run-the-business commitments.Risk and dependency management: Proactively identify, communicate, and resolve risks, blockers, and cross-team dependencies, escalating clearly and constructively when needed.Operational excellence: Own production health for the team’s data products, including SLAs, on-call posture, incident response, and post-incident learning.

Stakeholder Management and Cross Team Collaboration

< >Business partnership: Build trusted relationships with business and technology stakeholders, translating their objectives into clearly scoped, prioritized data engineering outcomes.Global team collaboration: Partner closely with peers across the Global Data Leadership team - architecture, data engineering, AI, governance, and product - to deliver cohesive, end-to-end data solutions.Communication and storytelling: Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, roadmaps, and progress effectively to audiences ranging from engineers to senior executives.Essential Skills, Knowledge & Experience:

< >Significant data engineering experience, including hands-on delivery on Databricks (Spark, Lakeflow, Spark Declarative Pipelines (DLT), Delta Lake, Lakebase/Postgres, Unity Catalog, etc.) and the Azure data ecosystem.Demonstratable experience formally managing data engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development.Track record of delivering production-grade data platforms and pipelines at scale with strong attention to reliability, security, and cost.Demonstratable ability to lead complex technical work through influence, not authority.Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and prioritization skills in a global, matrixed environment, with a client‑service mindsetFamiliarity with modern data architecture patterns (Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, medallion, data mesh), DataOps practices, and metadata-driven and configuration-driven pipeline frameworks.Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience:

< >Experience leading teams through technology transitions and adopting new data tooling beyond an established core stack.Familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code tooling for data pipelines using Azure DevOps, Databricks Automation Bundles (DABS), GitHub Actions, or equivalentExperience leading cross‑team initiatives and working across multiple geographies and time zones as part of a global data organization.

jobs.description:
About Surefire Cyber

Surefire Cyber is redefining the incident response model by delivering a swifter, stronger response to cyber incidents such as ransomware, email compromise, malware, data theft, and other threats. Our client-centric approach reduces stress and provides clients the confidence needed to prepare, respond, and recover from cyber incidents – and fortify their cyber resilience after an event.

Surefire Cyber’s approach and delivery are designed by industry veterans who have worked shoulder-to ­shoulder with law firms, insurance carriers, brokers, law enforcement, and impacted organizations in responding to cyber incidents. We are marshaling this experience to address the industry’s persistent challenges of efficiency, predictability, and transparency.

Job Title: Consultant, Restoration and Remediation

Location: Remote (USA)

Role: Full time / Exempt

What Makes You Stand Out

You are a systems-savvy problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments and brings hands-on experience restoring compromised systems and implementing remediation strategies. You’ve worked in roles like IT Engineer, System Administrator, or Cybersecurity Consultant, and now want to apply those skills in a high-stakes, incident response setting.

You’re comfortable collaborating with Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) teams, diagnosing problems quickly, and supporting clients with empathy and clear communication during urgent cyber events.

How You'll Make an Impact

As a Consultant on the Restoration and Remediation (R&R) team, you’ll contribute technical expertise during active incidents — helping clients recover from ransomware, malware infections, and breaches. You’ll execute remediation tasks, restore systems, and collaborate with forensic analysts to support response efforts. Through meticulous remediation efforts and application of technical expertise, they’ll help clients regain operational stability and strengthen their defenses against future threats

Your Role in Action

  • Support post-incident recovery efforts, collaborating with DFIR teams to assess the scope and impact of cyber incidents
  • Participate in restoring compromised systems to a pre-incident state, including data recovery, system configuration, and hardening
  • Assist in developing and executing tailored remediation plans based on technical, operational, and regulatory requirements
  • Reimage, rebuild, and reconfigure endpoints, servers, and affected services such as Active Directory, Exchange, Group Policy, and VPN
  • Use systems administration skills to restore and configure computing environments
  • Troubleshoot network issues and assist in resolving infrastructure-level connectivity or access problems
  • Contribute to the collection of digital artifacts and forensic evidence, supporting broader incident response
  • Apply foundational knowledge to investigate and address malware infections, unauthorized access, and system integrity issues
  • Implement endpoint protection and access control tools under supervision from senior R&R team members
  • Document all actions taken in a clear, structured format, capturing technical findings, decisions made, and lessons learned
  • Participate in after-hours (on-call/weekend rotational) support when needed to ensure 24/7 incident response coverage

Your Expertise

  • Foundational knowledge of Windows, Linux, and MacOS environments and their security features
  • Experience with firewalls, VPNs, Active Directory, Group Policy, Exchange, and common endpoint security tools
  • Understanding of cyber incident impact, attacker techniques, and indicators of compromise (IOCs)
  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills and a proactive, team-first attitude
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to manage competing tasks, adapt quickly to changing scenarios, and contribute in high-pressure situations

Expertise in all these areas is not required, but you should be excited by the opportunity to learn new things and comfortable with working with other team members to expand your knowledge base and experience. We at Surefire Cyber invite you to apply even if you do not feel you have mastery in all the requirements listed on the job description and welcome a further discussion.

Interview Process

  • Submit application on our website
  • Preliminary phone interview with the People Team (approx., 30 mins)
  • Virtual/Teams Interview with Restoration Team Members
  • Virtual/Teams interview with hiring leader/Director of R&R (approx., 45 minutes)
  • Take Home Mock Scenario (approx., 45 minutes)
  • Virtual/Teams interview with the Chief Deliver Officer
  • Virtual/Team interview with our CEO

Voted the #1 EHR by PC Magazine, WRS Health is a physician-owned company delivering a fully integrated, AI-powered cloud EHR and practice management platform to medical practices across 25+ specialties. We support physicians with continuously improving products and services, including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination, and billing.

We are seeking a Marketing Operations Strategist to develop and execute strategic marketing plans that drive brand awareness, customer acquisition, and revenue growth. You will build repeatable, measurable marketing systems that align with company goals, using HubSpot, AI-driven automation, and data science to turn marketing data into smarter decisions. This role is ideal for a results-driven, creative, and collaborative leader with a strong B2B SaaS background who enjoys managing projects, documenting processes, analyzing performance, and optimizing the website for better user experience, conversion rates, and lead generation.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Design and execute a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with company objectives, target markets, and healthcare IT industry trends.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to define marketing goals, KPIs, and budgets.

AI-Focused Marketing Workflows

  • Design and implement AI-powered workflows for lead scoring, content generation, audience segmentation, chatbots, and campaign personalization.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools (including HubSpot's AI features) into the marketing stack, with clear guidelines for quality, brand voice, and HIPAA-conscious data use.

Data Science & Marketing Analytics

  • Apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and attribution modeling to forecast pipeline, identify high-value segments, and measure channel effectiveness.
  • Design and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across emails, landing pages, and website experiences, turning results into actionable recommendations.

HubSpot & Marketing Automation

  • Manage HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs), including automation workflows, processes, and data hygiene.
  • Analyze reports and dashboards in HubSpot to track KPIs, campaign performance, and ROI for stakeholders.

Campaign & Website Optimization

  • Build and manage the email marketing program from segmentation to execution.
  • Improve forms, email templates, landing pages, and website experiences to increase conversion rates and lead generation.

Project Management & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Manage marketing operations projects from initiation to completion, tracking progress, risks, and bottlenecks to stay on schedule and within budget.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service teams to integrate processes and document repeatable workflows.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Management, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in marketing, marketing operations, and project management, preferably in B2B SaaS.
  • Advanced expertise in HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs) and strong proficiency in marketing automation technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted marketing workflows (e.g., predictive lead scoring, AI content tools, chatbots, or personalization).
  • Strong analytical and statistical skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Advanced database management and data visualization skills.
  • Solid understanding of customer journey mapping and business processes.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple projects at once.
  • Strong communication skills, including knowing how to ask the right questions and turn answers into systems.

Preferred

  • HubSpot certifications (Marketing, Sales, Operations, or related).
  • Experience as a HubSpot trainer or in HubSpot customer support.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or R for marketing data analysis.
  • Experience with BI tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Familiarity with marketing attribution, predictive analytics, or machine learning concepts.
  • Experience marketing to healthcare providers or in health IT, with awareness of HIPAA considerations.

A Day in the Life

Your day blends strategy, systems, and data. You might start by reviewing HubSpot dashboards to check overnight campaign results and pipeline movement, then meet with Sales to refine how AI-driven lead scores route new leads to the right reps. Later, you could be building an automated nurture workflow that personalizes content by specialty, analyzing an A/B test on a demo-request landing page, or running a quick attribution analysis to show leadership which channels are actually driving booked demos. Along the way, you're cleaning up data, documenting processes so they can be repeated, keeping marketing projects on track, and testing new AI tools to see where they can save the team time without compromising quality.

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline and revenue growth: Measurable increases in marketing-qualified leads (MQLs), demo requests, and marketing-sourced revenue.
  • Conversion improvements: Higher conversion rates across the website, landing pages, forms, and email campaigns, validated through A/B testing.
  • AI-driven efficiency: AI and automation workflows in place that reduce manual work, improve lead scoring accuracy, and speed up campaign execution.
  • Data quality and insight: Clean, reliable HubSpot data and accurate dashboards and attribution reporting that leadership uses to make decisions.
  • Operational excellence: Marketing projects delivered on time and within budget, with documented, repeatable processes adopted across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service.

Symmetrio is seeking multiple Senior Network Engineers to support a major enterprise network transformation initiative for our customer, a large government organization. This role centers on the implementation of Juniper MX960 routers and the transition from MC-LAG to EVPN/VXLAN fabrics.

This role will involve leading high-impact cutovers and migrations in a production environment, contributing to both hands-on implementation and network architecture design across a multi-overlay fabric.

This is a remote role based out of Philadelphia, offering a salary range of $110,000 to $150,000. The position is a 12-month contract with potential for extension, and quarterly travel to Philadelphia is expected.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, prioritization, and execution of enterprise-scale Juniper router migrations (MX960 platform).
  • Design and validate EVPN/VXLAN architectures with multiple overlays to ensure scalability, performance, and redundancy.
  • Collaborate closely with the customer’s Network Engineering team to achieve seamless integration with minimal disruption during migrations.
  • Configure, test, and deploy Junos OS across MX and EX platforms in production environments.
  • Provide expert-level guidance on the migration from MC-LAG to EVPN, including design validation, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop and maintain detailed documentation for network designs, cutover strategies, and post-migration processes.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Juniper routing, EVPN/VXLAN fabrics, and advanced routing protocols.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience as a Network Engineer in enterprise or large data center environments.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Juniper MX and EX platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of core routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
  • Proficiency with Junos OS configuration and troubleshooting in production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting large-scale router replacement or network migration projects.
  • Familiarity with EVPN design, deployment, and operations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Juniper certifications (JNCIP, JNCIE, or equivalent).

jobs.description:
XPRIZE Overview

XPRIZE is an established global leader in designing and executing large-scale competitions to solve humanity’s greatest challenges. As a 501(c)3, our unique model democratizes innovation by incentivizing crowd-sourced, scientifically viable solutions to create a more equitable and abundant future for all. Since our founding in 1994, we’ve launched $519 million in prize competitions that are driving more than $31 billion in social and economic impact — a 60x return on philanthropic investment. These competitions not only de-risk early-stage breakthrough ideas but also mobilize capital, talent, and momentum to accelerate solutions from concept to real-world scale.

We operate across 5 areas of impact,including:

  • Deep Tech + Exploration
  • Energy + Climate + Nature
  • Food + Water + Waste
  • Health
  • Learning + Society

Project Description

XPRIZE is seeking an experienced AI-Native Software Engineer to support the build of our new Prize Execution Platform — a unified system replacing our current, fragmented set of tools and expanding significantly on what they do today. The platform will manage the full lifecycle of an XPRIZE competition in a single ecosystem connecting four core user groups:

  • XPRIZE staff, who design and configure competitions, manage milestones and timelines, oversee submission intake, coordinate judging, and track prize disbursement.
  • Competitors, who register teams, submit applications and milestone deliverables, track their progress through the competition lifecycle, and receive AI-assisted matchmaking with relevant mentors.
  • Judges, who review and score submissions — supported by AI-assisted scoring and automated submission review tools that surface relevant context and flag issues before human review.
  • Alumni, who stay connected to the XPRIZE ecosystem post-competition through community and continued-engagement features.

AI is embedded directly into the product, not just the development process. Core AI-powered capabilities include:

  • AI-assisted judging and scoring to support judges with consistent, efficient evaluation.
  • Automated submission review to pre-screen and triage incoming applications and deliverables.
  • Competitor-mentor matchmaking to connect competing teams with relevant subject-matter mentors.
  • An applicant-facing chatbot to answer questions and guide competitors through the application and submission process.

This is a net-new platform, not a like-for-like migration — it will consolidate and significantly extend the capabilities of XPRIZE's current tooling. The engagement will be built using spec-driven and AI-assisted development practices on a .NET, Angular/React, and Python stack.

The ideal consultant can move quickly within a defined scope, work independently with minimal ramp-up, and deliver production-quality results on a set timeline — while also helping XPRIZE's internal engineering team build lasting capability in AI-assisted and spec-driven development practices.

Scope of Work:

  • Design, develop, and deliver features and modules across the Prize Execution Platform, including competition management, submission intake, judging/scoring, competitor and mentor matchmaking, and applicant-facing AI tools within the defined project scope, using .NET, Angular/React, and Python as needed.
  • Collaborate with the internal product and engineering team to confirm requirements, milestones, and acceptance criteria for the engagement.
  • Deliver clean, maintainable, and tested code that meets the quality, security, and testing criteria defined in the Statement of Work and the technical guidelines provided at kickoff.
  • Submit work product for XPRIZE review at agreed milestones, and join technical planning and review sessions as needed to confirm requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as the primary development workflow — for scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and documentation.
  • Apply AI-first, spec-driven development practices, translating specifications into AI-assisted implementation, and document this workflow so it's reusable by the internal team after the engagement ends.
  • Evaluate and refine AI-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit.
  • Transfer knowledge to XPRIZE's internal engineers — including training on AI-assisted and spec-driven development methods used on this project — as part of project deliverables.
  • Deliver clear technical documentation enabling the internal team to maintain and extend the solution post-engagement.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience developing full stack web applications, including prior consulting/contract engagements.
  • Demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on an existing codebase and deliver independently within a defined scope and timeline.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar in a professional workflow, with concrete examples of impact on delivery speed and quality.
  • Demonstrated experience with AI-first, spec-driven development, with the ability to teach this approach to an internal team as part of a knowledge-transfer deliverable.
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated code for security, performance, and architectural consistency.
  • Strong proficiency in .NET technologies and Python.
  • Proven experience with Angular (v12+) or React w/ TypeScript.
  • Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Proficiency with SQL Server or other relational database systems.
  • Familiarity with Azure, Git, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar).
  • Able to deliver the milestones in the Statement of Work within the engagement timeline.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills; comfortable working independently with minimal day-to-day oversight.

Work Arrangement

This is a fully remote engagement. The consultant may work from any location within the United States, subject to applicable tax and legal requirements. The consultant determines when and where the work is performed. The consultant will attend milestone reviews and collaboration sessions, which are scheduled by mutual agreement and are expected to occur approximately 2-3 times per week. The consultant is expected to be reasonably responsive to XPRIZE team communications during U.S. Pacific business hours. Expected effort is approximately 30-40 hours per week, not to exceed 40 hours without written approval.

Tools and Access

XPRIZE will provide access to the AI-assisted development tools, repositories, cloud environments, and accounts needed for this engagement (including Claude Code, GitHub, Azure etc.). To protect XPRIZE data and systems, the consultant will use XPRIZE-provided tools and environments for all work involving XPRIZE code, data, or confidential information, and will not input XPRIZE confidential information into unapproved AI tools or services. The consultant is responsible for providing their own computer, internet connection, and general office equipment. Access will be revoked at the end of the engagement.

Intellectual Property and Confidentiality

All work product created under this engagement, including code, documentation, specifications, prompts, workflows, and training materials, will be owned by XPRIZE and assigned to XPRIZE under the consulting agreement. The consultant will be required to sign a confidentiality agreement and IP assignment before starting work.

Independent Contractor Status

The consultant will be engaged directly by XPRIZE as an independent contractor and will receive IRS Form 1099. The consultant is not an employee of XPRIZE and is not eligible for employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans, or paid time off. The consultant is responsible for their own taxes, insurance, and business expenses. The consultant controls the means and methods of their work, within the scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria agreed in the Statement of Work.

Compensation

$75-85/hour based on skills and experience

Please note: Submitting a resume or proposal does not make you a candidate for engagement. You will be considered a candidate only after XPRIZE contacts you directly to begin the engagement process, which may include interviews, a technical assessment, reference checks, and a background check where permitted by law. Final engagement is contingent on execution of a written independent contractor agreement, including confidentiality and IP assignment terms. XPRIZE is an equal opportunity organization and considers all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Note: if you experience any issues or errors while trying to submit your application, please try clearing your cache and cookies or applying through a different browser (for example, Safari instead of Google Chrome).
