jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

What We Do

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Role Overview

The Product Auditor provides independent assurance over the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of product controls across payment, wallet, settlement, switches and other related products across the organisation

The role ensures that new and existing products are deployed with adequate financial, operational, security, and regulatory controls, safeguarding the organization against revenue leakage, settlement failures, regulatory breaches, and technology-driven risks.

The Product Auditor will independently evaluate product risk exposure and control maturity prior to scale.

Key Responsibilities

Audit Universe & Risk-Based Planning

  • Maintain a living Product Audit Universe covering all payment products, features, and integrations ranked by risk.
  • Own the annual Product Audit Plan, ensuring coverage is allocated dynamically based on risk ratings, product complexity, regulatory sensitivity, and change velocity.

Product Design & Control Assurance

  • Review PRDs, business rules, and transaction workflows to identify logic gaps, unmitigated risk paths, and missing exception-handling routines before products reach production/go-live.
  • Analyse product path scenarios, verify Maker-Checker enforcement, and provide formal control design sign-off before any material release goes live.

Live Product Assessment ( Continuous Audit Review)

  • Periodically assess live payment products to confirm they continue to operate within approved design parameters.
  • Detect configuration drift, identify silent divergence from original PRDs, and analyse live transaction data for emerging risk patterns.

Go-Live Readiness & Control Gate

  • Execute mandatory pre-production Product Audit reviews as an independent control gate for all material releases.
  • Confirm reconciliation logic, exception queues, and fallback controls are tested and functional.
  • Escalate critical deficiencies with risk ratings and hold recommendations where a product is not safe to release.

Transaction Logic & Mathematical Integrity

  • Interrogate the Fee Engine using SQL to mathematically prove that commissions, VAT, discounts, and splits are posted with complete precision.
  • Validate duplicate prevention mechanisms and ensure transaction integrity within complex, multi-step payment sequences, and test reversal, refund, and chargeback logic to confirm financial symmetry is maintained in every scenario.

Settlement & Ledger Integrity

  • Trace fund flows, confirming continuous synchronisation between wallet sub-ledgers and the General Ledger.
  • Assess reconciliation logic for breaks and evaluate the authorisation, documentation, and reversibility of manual settlement overrides.

Product Change & Configuration Integrity

  • Confirm that all product modifications: fee tables, routing rules, limit parameters passed through an approved change management cycle.
  • Identify silent changes made outside formal release processes and audit the integrity of product master data to ensure it is access-controlled, version-tracked, and consistent with approved product terms.

Vendor & Third-Party Product Risk

  • Assess controls over vendor-managed product components, evaluate SLA performance against contractual commitments, and identify single-vendor dependency risks within critical payment flows.
  • Evaluate the organisation's ability to detect unilateral changes in third-party API behaviour, fee logic, or settlement processes.

Control Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Engage product and engineering teams early in the design cycle to provide informal control advisory, reducing findings at the formal review stage without compromising independence.
  • Participate in design reviews and architecture discussions, and build a control-by-design culture across product teams.

Incident Review, RCA & Regulatory Alignment

  • Lead post-incident reviews for product failures,producing structured RCA reports that identify underlying logic failures, not just surface symptoms.
  • Assess corrective actions for adequacy and track findings to verify closure.
  • Ensure product logic complies with CBN guidelines, PCI DSS, and consumer protection obligations at the design level, and evaluate the regulatory impact of new features before release.

Reporting & Governance

  • Prepare risk-rated audit reports for Executive Management and the Audit Committee, leading with findings, financial impact, and required action.
  • Maintain a Product Risk Register, deliver quarterly control maturity updates, and ensure governance bodies are never surprised by a product failure that was visible at the design or portfolio review stage.

Required Knowledge & Skills

Technical Skills

  • Advanced SQL for independent data extraction and transaction interrogation
  • Payment systems architecture : Wallets, card processing, direct debit, settlement, and reconciliation
  • API and integration literacy (Basic)
  • End-to-end transaction lifecycle knowledge: Authorisation, posting, clearing, settlement, and exception handling
  • PRD and process flow analysis: translating product documentation into control flowcharts
  • Mathematical precision: fee calculations, interest computations, and split payment structures

At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose: Honesty, Reliability, Curiosity, Collaboration, and Passion.

About the role and what you'll be doing: Ensono's global Commercial Contracting Office has opened a position for a Corporate Counsel role. This position provides front line support for Ensono's global sales and strategic revenue generating commercial transactions by collaboratively setting deal structure and strategy, performing contract review, drafting and negotiation, coordinating internal approvals and taking overall responsibility for deal completion. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted business advisor to Sales and internal stakeholders, balancing risk management with commercial objectives and developing practical solutions that enable transactions to move forward.

We are looking for a talented attorney with strong business acumen, initiative, drive and experience who can handle a high volume of varied and complex commercial transactions. This position will play a pivotal role in Ensono achieving its strategic and financial objectives by providing consultative, strategic and analytic support services on commercial transactions. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated ability to develop strong working relationships with key internal stakeholders, as well as Ensono's sophisticated enterprise sales or outsourcing customers. The ideal candidate is a collaborative, commercially minded negotiator who thrives in a fast-paced sales environment and takes ownership of driving transactions to successful outcomes.

What You Will Do

• Lead commercial transactions to closure in prudent and expeditious and solutions-oriented manner

• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex transaction agreements

• Identifying and mitigating issues and risks and ensuring that the business understands risks associated with contract language and positions, while developing practical alternatives that support business objectives

• Provide risk assessment and commercial legal advice, including advice related to relevant laws and regulations

• Exercise judgment and delegated authority on wide-ranging issues

• Coordinate across multiple internal organizations to resolve issues ensure compliance with laws, regulations and company policies

• Vet contract issues/requests with appropriate internal organizations, track responses, and draft resulting feedback

• Prepare and administer escalations as necessary

• Advising on existing contracts, including but not limited to contractual obligations and the resolution of contract disputes, with a focus on achieving commercially reasonable outcomes

• Identify, develop and drive implementation of solutions to deal roadblocks through creative problem-solving, stakeholder alignment and effective negotiation

• Project manage multiple deals to closure simultaneously

• Present training to client groups on transaction legal issues and strategies

• Continuously seek to improve the transaction support process

• Partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Finance, Security, Privacy and executive leadership to structure transactions that achieve strategic, operational, and financial objectives.

• Limited travel may be required

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

What You Will Need:

  • Demonstrated success in complex contract review, drafting and negotiation for sales/outsource transactions involving technology products/services.
  • General understanding regarding data privacy laws and regulations and impact on commercial transactions
  • Experience with responsibility for all aspects of commercial transactions, including basic financials and all non-pricing business issues and contract terms
  • Familiarity with all phases of sales/outsource contracting from pre-contract Requests for Proposals/Bids to contract negotiation/execution and post-contract legal support
  • Experience contracting with state and local government clients
  • Successful record of interacting with sophisticated enterprise customers, and their third-party representatives, as transaction counterparties
  • Proven ability to provide entrepreneurial, quick-thinking, pragmatic, business-oriented advice and recommendations in support of revenue-generating transactions
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including ability to summarize issues to clients/management
  • Ability to effectively counsel clients concerning legal and business risks in sales transactions while preserving momentum and advancing negotiations toward resolution
  • Ability to work independently with little supervision in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to rapidly assess potential risks, benefits and consequences of business decisions
  • Well-honed project management and organizational skills needed to manage multiple/complex transactions
  • Must be able to prioritize to meet deadlines
  • Independent initiative to develop, lead and implement special projects that enhance contracting processes
  • Strong work ethic and strong sense of responsibility for high quality work product
  • Ability to achieve results under pressure/deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements in a manner that builds credibility with counterparties and facilitates successful deal completion.
  • Strong commercial judgment with the ability to distinguish between material risks and negotiable positions and to recommend practical paths forward.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance legal, operational and financial considerations while supporting business growth and revenue objectives.

Requirements:

  • J.D. from an accredited law school
  • Active bar admission in at least one US jurisdiction
  • 3-5 years of relevant and recent complex commercial transactions experience in an IT Managed Service Provider environment, outsourcing and consulting contract experience required

Why Ensono?

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things we want Ensono to be the place you can do it.

We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.

Associate Director, Merchandise Planning

Brilliant Earth is searching for an Associate Director, Merchandise Planning to lead our Inventory Planning function and the team behind it. Reporting to the Senior Director of Merchandising, you'll own forecasting, open-to-buy, and inventory strategy across every category and function, as well as the roadmap that takes our planning capabilities to the next level. This is a builder's role as much as a planner's: our planning infrastructure is actively evolving, and you'll set the direction, partner with Technology and Merchandising to implement new tools, and raise the analytical bar for the whole team.

You'll build planning approaches that work for attribute-based, specification-driven assortments while holding the line on turn, in-stock, and margin. We have a social and environmental mission at the core of our company, and we're looking for someone excited to deliver exceptional business results while helping us advance it.

What You'll Do:

Inventory Strategy and Forecasting

  • Own sales and inventory forecasts across all categories and functions, and hold the team accountable for the accuracy, timeliness, and achievement of inventory plans and KPIs.
  • Set inventory strategy for fine jewelry assortments, including diamond, gemstone, and precious metal commodities, establishing the parameters (weeks of supply, safety stock, reorder points) that balance service levels against inventory productivity.
  • Lead inventory planning for new showroom launches and growth initiatives, directing the scenario modeling and statistical analysis that pressure-test those plans.

Open-to-Buy and Financial Planning

  • Own and continue to evolve the OTB alignment and consensus process, translating financial plans into actionable buying strategies with Merchandising and Finance.
  • Contribute to the annual bookings, ASP, and margin budget-setting process, bringing the inventory point of view to category and department targets and reporting consistently against inventory KPIs.

Planning Systems and Process

  • Create and drive the Inventory Planning roadmap. Work with leadership to initiate, prioritize, and approve projects, and manage long-term program schedules through to adoption.
  • Partner with Technology on planning system implementation and maintenance, leading the broader team’s adoption of new demand planning and reporting tools.
  • Adapt planning tools and models to integrate cleanly with our evolving enterprise systems and reporting, identifying gaps, developing workarounds, and replacing them with durable solutions.
  • Leverage AI tools to automate recurring analysis and reporting, and drive identification and rollout of new AI-enabled planning workflows across the function.

Team Leadership and Partnership

  • Manage, coach, and develop a growing planning team through hiring, feedback, and clear team objectives.
  • Raise planning fluency across the organization by mentoring cross-functional Merchandising partners on forecasting and inventory principles, and by representing Planning credibly to executive leadership.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years in merchandise planning, inventory planning, forecasting, or quantitative analysis within retail, product, or e-commerce, including demonstrated success leading and developing a team.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certification a plus.
  • Experience with attribute-based or commodity inventory planning (precious metals, gemstones, or other specification-driven categories) is a strong plus.
  • Expert Excel skills: complex formulas, pivot tables, financial modeling, and efficient handling of large datasets. Retail math is second nature.
  • Hands-on experience with demand planning software (Blue Yonder, Logility, Demantra, o9, MI9, or similar) and reporting/BI tools (Domo, Tableau, Power BI); NetSuite or comparable ERP experience a plus.
  • A track record of leading system implementations and cross-functional programs end to end—from defining business requirements and guiding development through adoption—including new forecasting tools, report automation, and process redesign.
  • Experience with AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Excel Copilot, BI-native AI features, Snowflake Intelligence) to automate analysis and reduce manual effort; familiarity with prompt engineering and connecting AI tools to live data sources such as data warehouses or ERP is highly valued.
  • Comfort operating in an evolving systems environment: you can spot the gap, build the workaround, then turn it into lasting process.
  • Expert written and verbal communication, with clear, direct, concise presentations to broader teams and executive leadership.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit and a self-starter mindset, with the ability to think critically and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to respect and inclusion in the workplace.
  • Interest in socially and environmentally responsible organizations and products.

What We Offer:

  • Career Growth. We want to see you sparkle! Through regular 1-1’s with your manager, a variety of training opportunities, and an annual 360 review process for all employees, our leaders are dedicated to creating clear pathways for growth. Ask the hiring team for more information on how Brilliant Earth creates a culture of collaboration and growth during your interview conversations!
  • Diverse, mission-minded team. We were founded to cultivate a more transparent, sustainable, compassionate, & inclusive jewelry industry. Learn more about our impact and team diversity Here!
  • Lifestyle Spending Account. At Brilliant Earth, we're committed to your well-being. Enjoy company reimbursements for eligible wellness expenses, such as gym memberships, massage, counseling, and more!
  • Continued Education. Company-sponsored learning in leadership, professional skills, diversity & inclusion, and access to tuition reimbursement for role-specific trainings.
  • Employee Discounts. As an employee at Brilliant Earth, you’ll receive a generous discount on our jewelry.
  • Mental Wellness Perks. We offer access to mental health resources, such as self-care apps and seminars. Our Employee Assistance program offers 24/7 access to counseling!
  • Giving Back and Volunteer Opportunities. In addition to our giving back programs, our teams support local initiatives and spend time together by volunteering.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision. We offer multiple plans to choose from, including a $0 monthly premium option for employee health insurance and employer HSA contributions. Insurance kicks in on the first day of your 2nd month!
  • 401k match. We know that saving for the future is important. That's why we offer a generous 401k match.
  • Paid Time Off. We know it’s important to recharge and relax
  • Parental Leave. We aim to support our growing families. Employees can utilize our paid parental leave to bond and care for their new additions.
  • Disability and Life insurance. 100% employer-paid.
  • Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits

More About Us

At Brilliant Earth, our mission is to cultivate a more transparent, sustainable, compassionate, & inclusive jewelry industry. We believe in creating jewelry you can feel good about wearing, without ever compromising between quality and conscience. We are hard-working team players that welcome challenges and rise to any occasion. Our community of collaboration, respect and encouragement is fostered by frequent team events, cross-departmental meetings and celebrating our wins, big and small. As one of the fastest growing e-commerce jewelers in the world, we're searching for bright and passionate people who are excited to make an impact from day one and grow with the company to take on greater responsibility over time.

Brilliant Earth recognizes the value of diversity and inclusion on our team, as we work together to reinvent fine jewelry in a thoughtful and modern way. At Brilliant Earth, we celebrate each other – our successes, the lessons along the way, and the unique perspectives each individual brings to our team. We're looking for a Senior Director of Marketing to lead our Marketing team and drive the strategy and systems that fuel Two Chairs growth.

This leader will oversee Brand and Product Marketing, Commercial Operations, and Integrated Marketing across all of Two Chairs target audiences, with a heavy emphasis on our health plan partners. They will partner closely with Growth, Product, Clinical, Operations and Leadership to distill and communicate our complex value proposition, highlight the benefits of our differentiated clinical model and technology platform, strengthen our payer relationships, accelerate patient demand, and position Two Chairs as the behavioral health provider delivering on superior clinical outcomes.

This is both a strategic leadership role and an operating role. You'll set the long-term vision for Marketing while ensuring the team delivers measurable business impact.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Marketing Strategy & Organizational Leadership

Payer Growth & Value-Based Care Narrative

Product Marketing, Commercial Enablement & Go-to-Market

Insights, Analytics & Operational Excellence

Impact & Success Indicators

Where you'll make an impact in your first 90 days:

jobs.excerpt: About the Job:As a Staff Engineer on LaunchDarkly's Experimentation team, you'll build the platform that helps engineering teams make data-driven decisions with confidence.
jobs.description:
About the Job:

As a Staff Engineer on LaunchDarkly's Experimentation team, you'll build the platform that helps engineering teams make data-driven decisions with confidence. Our Experimentation product enables customers to run A/B tests, measure the impact of feature changes, and optimize experiences — integrated with a feature management platform that processes trillions of evaluations daily.

This role sits at the intersection of data science and platform engineering. You'll design the statistical engine, warehouse-native analysis pipelines, and adaptive experimentation systems (including contextual bandits) that power our customers' most important decisions. We want someone who brings genuine depth in applied statistics and ML — as fluent in statistical validity as in system architecture.

You'll also architect warehouse-agnostic features that run analysis directly inside customers' data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery) — modular computation layers that abstract across warehouse environments while maintaining statistical correctness.

Deep technical experience, a scientific mindset, and the ability to influence product and technical direction are critical. You'll lead by example: setting the bar for rigor, mentoring teammates, and owning systems end to end, including on-call.

Responsibilities:

  • Build the experimentation statistical engine — hypothesis testing, sequential analysis, variance reduction (CUPED, Winsorization), power analysis. Ensure statistical correctness across all experiment types.

  • Design warehouse-native experimentation that runs analysis inside customer warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery). Build modular, warehouse-agnostic abstractions for rapid new backend support.

  • Lead adaptive experimentation — contextual bandit systems, Bayesian optimization, automated allocation beyond simple A/B tests.

  • Drive the platform roadmap with product, design, and data science. Shape what we build, not just how.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Warehouse Integrations, SDK, Platform, and Data Science teams.

  • Mentor engineers and raise the team's bar for statistical rigor and system design.

  • Own operational excellence — monitoring, observability, incident response, on-call. Robust telemetry and alerting.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years building large-scale experimentation platforms, statistical analysis systems, or data-intensive backend services.

  • Applied-statistics knowledge: hypothesis testing, sequential analysis, variance reduction (CUPED), power analysis, experiment design. Comfortable with frequentist vs. Bayesian trade-offs.

  • Experience with adaptive experimentation ML — contextual bandits, Thompson sampling, Bayesian optimization, or RL-based allocation.

  • Track record designing warehouse-agnostic systems across Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar.

  • Expertise in Go, Python, or similar for backend services and statistical computation.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and large-scale data processing.

  • Cloud environments (AWS, GCP) with infrastructure-as-code.

  • Technical leadership: setting direction, breaking down complex problems, influencing across teams.

  • Ability to translate statistical concepts for product and engineering audiences.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 5:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $214,800 - $295,350*
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $193,400 - $265,870**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $182,600 - $251,0202**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Who The Client Is: Our client is an Australian-based premium distributor partnering with professional haircare brands that are known for innovation, quality, and sustainability. Rather than simply supplying products, they focus on helping salon owners and stylists grow thriving businesses through education, support, and long-term partnerships.

Working closely with creative professionals across the industry, they champion brands that inspire artistry, encourage individuality, and deliver meaningful results. Their mission is to empower salon businesses to achieve greater success—both creatively and commercially—by providing the tools, knowledge, and support needed to grow with confidence.

Role Overview: We’re looking for a creative, hands-on Social Media Manager & Video Editor to manage multiple social media accounts of the client. You’ll turn raw footage of hair transformations, product features, educational sessions, and industry events into polished, engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok, while managing content calendars, captions, publishing, and community engagement across several brand accounts.

You’ll also build the business’s TikTok presence from the ground up and support the founder’s LinkedIn content. Working closely with the in-house marketing team, you’ll help maintain consistent brand identities, grow engagement with hairdressers and salon owners, and use creative ideas and AI tools to improve content. As the business grows, there may be opportunities to take on broader marketing responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

Video Editing & Content Creation

  • Edit raw footage into polished, engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.
  • Adapt video pacing, length, hooks, and formats to suit each platform.
  • Create content featuring hair transformations, educational tips, product features, behind-the-scenes footage, and industry events.
  • Add captions, text overlays, transitions, music, and sound effects while maintaining each brand’s visual identity.
  • Colour-correct and grade footage to ensure hair colour and products look accurate and premium.
  • Repurpose longer videos, educational sessions, and event footage into multiple short-form clips.
  • Use AI tools to streamline editing, generate ideas, and improve content quality.

Social Media Management

  • Manage the main Instagram account and multiple brand-specific social media accounts.
  • Plan and maintain content calendars across all accounts.
  • Write engaging captions that resonate with hairdressers and salon owners.
  • Schedule and publish content consistently across platforms.
  • Maintain consistent content quality, brand voice, and presentation across all accounts.

Community Engagement

  • Respond promptly to comments and direct messages in the appropriate brand voice.
  • Monitor tagged posts and engage with relevant salon and client content.
  • Proactively comment on, share, and interact with posts from the salon community.
  • Build relationships with hairdressers and salon owners to grow engagement across accounts.

TikTok Growth

  • Build and grow the business’s TikTok presence from the ground up.
  • Monitor trends, sounds, and content formats, adapting relevant ideas to suit each brand.

LinkedIn Content Support

  • Assist with managing the founder’s personal LinkedIn profile.
  • Repurpose relevant content from other social channels into posts suited to a professional audience.

Requirements

Must have:

  • 2–3 years minimum experience in video editing and social media management for brands
  • A strong portfolio of short-form video content (Reels and TikTok) showing high-quality editing
  • Advanced skills in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve
  • Solid working knowledge of Instagram and TikTok, including Reels, Stories, trends, algorithms and insights
  • Experience managing multiple brand accounts at once, each with its own voice
  • A strong eye for aesthetics, with a feel for how hair, colour and product should look on camera
  • Clear understanding of how tone and content differ across Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn
  • Great written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Organised, reliable and self-directed, with strong attention to detail
  • Availability during South Australian business hours

Nice to have:

  • Experience in the hair, beauty or fashion industry, as is a genuine passion for the space
  • Experience using AI tools for video editing and content creation
  • Broader marketing or marketing management experience
  • Familiarity with social scheduling tools such as Meta Business Suite, Later or Planoly

This is a remote role that may be set up as either an independent contractor engagement or via an Employer of Record (EOR), depending on client preferences and legal structure.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Be available for meetings and collaboration during core [AEST or PHT] business hours

jobs.title: Partnerships Development Associate
jobs.excerpt: 🕙 Role details: This is a full time role (40 hours per week) 💷 Salary: £29,000 - £35,000pa + Performance-related commission + Equity options 🌍 Location: We're a remote first team, based throughout the UK & Ireland.
jobs.description:
🕙 Role details: This is a full time role (40 hours per week)

💷 Salary: £29,000 - £35,000pa + Performance-related commission + Equity options

🌍 Location: We're a remote first team, based throughout the UK & Ireland. We offer the flexibility to work outside of the UK/Ireland up to 90 days per year, however you must be able to work and live permanently within the UK or Ireland, and able to travel to London at least four times a year for company meet ups and additionally as needed.

The role

We're looking for an ambitious, curious and commercially minded Partnerships Development Associate to join our growing commercial team and help bring Isla's technology to more healthcare organisations.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to build a career in consultative sales. You'll combine research and proactive business development with the opportunity to connect with NHS clinicians and decision-makers, understand the challenges they're facing and show them how Isla could help.

You'll take ownership of the early stages of our sales process, from finding and reaching out to potential partners to building relationships, running introductory meetings and demonstrating our platform.

This isn't just about generating leads or booking meetings. You will get to know the people you're speaking to, ask great questions and understand what matters to them. You'll learn to spot where Isla could make a real difference and work closely with our senior Partnership Leads to turn those initial conversations into lasting partnerships.

We're looking for someone who enjoys meeting new people, is naturally curious and loves getting to the bottom of a problem. You'll need the confidence to start conversations, the resilience to keep going when things don't work out and, just as importantly, the ability to listen, build trust and make people feel understood.

You don't need to know the NHS or other healthcare systems inside out. We're much more interested in your attitude, initiative and willingness to learn. If you're excited to take on responsibility early, develop your skills and play a part in changing how healthcare is delivered, we'd love to hear from you!

------

Who we are

Isla Health is a venture-backed health-tech scale-up, supporting our partners across the UK, EU and internationally. We have built a new category of healthcare technology which we refer to as the Digital Pathway Platform (DPP). Founded in 2019, we now support 25% of NHS Trusts and a submission of patient data is made on the platform every 20 seconds

As a company, we're all laser focused on enabling a scalable model of care which empowers healthcare staff and improves patient outcomes. The DPP supports this by setting up digital pathways which are remote-first and asynchronous. As pathways harness sophisticated automation, clinical algorithms and intelligent cohorting, patients always take the optimised route through their pathway, thereby delivering a step change in clinical productivity.

------

Over the next 12 months you will:

  • Identify and develop new opportunities: Research NHS organisations, clinical services and regional priorities to identify where Isla could deliver meaningful value. Take ownership of targeted outbound activity across email, phone and LinkedIn, finding thoughtful and effective ways to engage prospective partners.
  • Lead early-stage customer conversations: Build relationships with clinicians, operational teams and NHS decision-makers. Run initial discovery meetings, asking insightful questions to understand their challenges, priorities and existing ways of working.
  • Demonstrate the value of our platform: Deliver engaging introductory and clinical demonstrations of Isla, adapting your approach to different audiences and helping prospective partners understand how our technology could improve their services.
  • Qualify prospective partnerships: Go beyond generating interest to understand whether there is a genuine opportunity for Isla. Explore customer needs, relevant stakeholders, potential impact and next steps, ensuring opportunities are well understood before progressing them.
  • Build a high-quality commercial pipeline: Work closely with senior Partnership Leads to progress qualified opportunities, providing the insights and context needed to develop successful partnerships. Take ownership of follow-up and maintain momentum throughout the early stages of the sales process.
  • Develop your understanding of the NHS: Build a strong knowledge of NHS structures, clinical pathways and the challenges facing healthcare organisations, enabling you to have increasingly credible and valuable conversations with prospective customers.
  • Continuously improve our approach: Track your activity and opportunities through our CRM, share insights from customer conversations and use data, feedback and AI tools to make our outreach and qualification processes more effective.

Requirements

  • A consultative mindset: You're naturally curious and enjoy understanding people's challenges. You ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully and focus on finding the right solution rather than simply delivering a sales pitch.
  • Exceptional communication skills: You can write clear, concise and engaging outreach that cuts through the noise of a busy clinician's inbox. You're equally confident building relationships, leading conversations and communicating complex ideas to different audiences.
  • Commercial drive: You're proactive, motivated by results and enjoy the challenge of creating new opportunities. You're comfortable picking up the phone, initiating conversations and following them through.
  • Strong research and analytical skills: You enjoy getting to grips with complex topics, digging into data and identifying opportunities. You can connect the dots between an organisation's challenges and where Isla could add value.
  • Confidence and resilience: You're comfortable stepping outside your comfort zone, aren't discouraged by rejection and are always looking for ways to learn and improve.
  • Ownership and initiative: You take responsibility for your work, manage your time effectively and follow through on commitments. You're proactive in finding solutions rather than waiting for direction.
  • Technical aptitude: You're comfortable learning new technologies, confident using tools like Google Sheets and interested in how AI can make your research, outreach and workflows more effective.
  • Collaborative, mission-driven approach: You're excited about Isla's impact on patient care, enjoy working towards shared goals and take pride in seeing opportunities you've helped create develop into successful partnerships.
  • Experience:
    • Ideally, you'll have at least one year's experience in a fast-paced, commercial or customer-facing environment, such as sales, business development or account management.
    • Experience in B2B sales, SaaS or healthcare would be beneficial.

We appreciate you might not meet all of the requirements for this position. If your experience looks somewhat different to the requirements in the job spec but you think you can bring value to this role, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

🏡 Work where you do your best work either from home or at our office in London (Moorgate) 🏢

🕜 Flexible working times

🌍 Work abroad for up to 90 days per year

🏖️ 25 days annual leave on top of bank holidays. Plus, take your birthday off and another significant day off of your choice 🎂

🍜 Quarterly meal on us - enjoy £75 to treat friends or family

🧘‍♀️ Wellbeing allowance - £50 per month for gym membership/wellbeing activities or private medical insurance

💡 Salary sacrifice pension and access to Mintago for retail discounts, financial coaching, childcare vouchers, virtual GP and more

🎉 Enhanced parental leave to support your family when it matters most

🎳 Quarterly company meet-ups

📚 An annual learning budget to support your growth

📈 Share in our success with share options

💗 Work with purpose - you'll be delivering social impact through improved patient healthcare

🚀 Join at an exciting stage - we're a well-funded, rapidly growing health tech company tackling a global challenge

🌱 Help shape the future of Isla - your ideas won't disappear into layers of management. You'll have real ownership, real impact, and help define how we grow the business

------

What is the hiring process for this role?

  1. A video submission. Successful applicants will be invited to submit a quick video so we can get to know the person behind the CV!
  2. An initial call with one of our People Operations team - 15 minutes
  3. A short take-home written task
  4. A role play interview with one of our Partnerships Leads - 30 minutes
  5. An interview with our Director of Partnerships, Chris - 30 minutes
  6. A final interview with our Co-founder/CEO, Pete - 30 minutes

------

Diversity and Inclusion

Isla is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building an inclusive and diverse team. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply. We do not discriminate against anyone on the basis of their race, gender, disability, religion, national origin, age, or any other protected category. We choose to celebrate our team’s differences and see them as one of our most valuable assets.

Recruitment is not one-size-fits-all and we're happy to tailor our hiring process to better meet the needs of individual applicants. Please email with any requests for support.

jobs.excerpt: PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised.
jobs.description:
PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real.

Come join us.

Job Summary:

We are looking for enthusiastic candidates interested in applying quantum computing to real-world challenges. At PsiQuantum, we are particularly focused on use cases of quantum computing in chemistry, drug design, materials science, and fluid dynamics. Along these lines, we are offering internships in the areas of quantum algorithms and quantum compilation.

Your work could entail the -

  • Development of quantum algorithms to solve impactful problems,
  • Optimization of ubiquitous subroutines in fault tolerant quantum algorithms,
  • Compilation of quantum algorithms to logical gate sets,
  • Incorporation of architecture-aware optimizations,
  • Estimation of quantum resources.

Prior work in the field of fault tolerant quantum algorithms and compilation is preferred, but enthusiasm for quantum computing is essential.

Desired experience and skills:

  • Currently studying for, or completed a postgraduate degree related to quantum algorithms, quantum circuit compilation, fault tolerance or another aspect of quantum computing OR 5+ years working professionally in one or more of these fields.
  • Experience with programming languages (e.g. Python) and collaborative software development tools (e.g. Git).
  • A creative and adaptable approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative team.

jobs.excerpt: InsightRX | Engineering About the RoleInsightRX is looking for a Full Stack Engineer to help build our Astra AI platform — a system that combines a modern web application with conversational AI agents to support pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) analysis and clinical trial data workflows.
jobs.description:
InsightRX | Engineering

About the Role

InsightRX is looking for a Full Stack Engineer to help build our Astra AI platform — a system that combines a modern web application with conversational AI agents to support pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) analysis and clinical trial data workflows. You'll work across the client, server, and agent layers, understanding how they fit together end to end: how the frontend talks to the API, how the API queues and tracks work, and how LLM-powered agents process data and return results.

This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys working across the stack, is comfortable navigating both traditional web application architecture and newer LLM-agent design patterns, and wants to build tools used directly in pharmaceutical R&D decision-making.

What You'll Work On

  • Build and maintain features across our React/TypeScript client and NestJS/TypeScript backend, including UI components, REST APIs, and the data layer connecting them.
  • Design and extend the client-server architecture: state management, routing, authentication (including SSO/SAML), real-time updates via WebSockets, and background job processing via AWS SQS.
  • Collaborate on the integration layer between the web app and our LLM-based agents — message schemas, queue-based communication, and file/data handoff.
  • Work with our conversational AI agent system, which orchestrates multiple specialized agents for statistical modeling, data quality checks, and PK/PD analysis workflows.
  • Contribute to database schema design and migrations (PostgreSQL/Sequelize), API documentation (Swagger), and test coverage (Jest, pytest).
  • Participate in code review, architecture discussions, and production support across the stack.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong professional experience building production level full stack web applications, comfortable owning features from database to UI.
  • Strong TypeScript skills across both frontend (React) and backend (Node.js/NestJS) contexts.
  • Experience designing REST APIs, relational data models (PostGresSQL, MongoDB), and authentication/authorization flows.
  • Familiarity with message-queue or event-driven architectures (SQS, similar).
  • Comfort reading and reasoning about systems that integrate with LLMs — understanding agent/tool patterns, prompt-driven workflows, and the practical quirks of working with LLM output, even without deep AI/ML research background.
  • Strong problem-solving, ownership, and ability to debug across web applications and nondeterministic AI behavior.
  • Uses Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI coding tools effectively while understanding, validating, and taking responsibility for the resulting code.
  • Good instincts for reliability and correctness in domains where data quality matters — you ask "what happens when this fails or the data is malformed."
  • Clear communicator, comfortable working across an evolving codebase with detailed technical documentation.
  • Operate with a high level of independence and cope with ambiguity

Nice to Have

  • Experience with LLM agent architecture a plus
  • Experience with SAML SSO, multi-tenant systems, or healthcare/life-sciences software.

The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Security Engineer, Network & Zero Trust, to own the network pillar of Sezzle's zero-trust program: every connection explicitly allowed, authenticated by service identity, and attributable after the fact — across our Kubernetes clusters, AWS accounts, and the paths between them.

You will take ownership of our network-policy program — default-deny micro-segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters — and carry the rest of the pillar forward with it: identity-aware service-to-service transport, per-application private access, flow-level visibility, and network configuration managed as reviewed code.

This is an engineering role: you will write the policies, the tooling, and the rollout automation yourself, and you will carry changes through other teams' services without breaking delivery. You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and detection and response, and with the platform and IAM teams on service identity — your network controls are what their work relies on, and your telemetry is what their detections run on.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows — flow analysis, policy generation from observed traffic, drift review — that let the team segment a large estate.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own east-west segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters: design the segmentation model, derive network policies from observed traffic, and keep every workload reachable only through explicitly allowed, identity-bound paths — a default that holds as the estate grows, not a one-time project.
  • Deliver identity-aware transport — design and roll out mutually authenticated, encrypted service-to-service connections (mTLS), so that authorization decisions rest on verified service identity.
  • Keep a live map of the network: VPC peerings, tunnels, cross-account links, and every public entry point — built from cloud APIs and reconciled continuously, so every path into production is known and justified.
  • Own segmentation of production and the cardholder-data environment: implement and enforce the CDE and high-trust-tier boundaries, review every peering and public exposure against them, and run segmentation testing with the security team.
  • Partner with IT on private access: evaluate and help deliver per-application access (ZTNA) for engineers and operators reaching production systems.
  • Own network telemetry: flow logs east-west and north-south, with enough identity on both ends that "who talked to what, when" is answerable in minutes — and feed it to our SIEM for the detection team.
  • Own cluster admission control and hold the line on drift: workload admission policy (pod security, image provenance, network policy), security groups and firewall rules declared in git, applied only through the IaC pipeline, with admission control at the gate and drift detected and reverted automatically.
  • Contain: build the levers that let us isolate a workload or segment quickly when detection flags lateral movement, and take part in incident response when the network is in play.
  • Participate in threat modeling and design reviews for anything that changes how traffic flows, and in the on-call rotation for the controls you own.

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of experience in security, network, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on ownership of network controls in cloud production environments.
  • Deep, practical Kubernetes networking knowledge: CNI, NetworkPolicy semantics, DNS, ingress/egress — and experience rolling segmentation out on live clusters without outages.
  • Strong AWS networking: VPCs, subnets, security groups, peering and Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, load balancers, flow logs.
  • Hands-on experience with mTLS and service-to-service authentication (service mesh, proxies, or CNI-level encryption).
  • Infrastructure as code as your default way of working — Terraform and Helm or equivalents, through merge requests and CI, across repositories you don't own.
  • Ability to write real code (Go, Python, or Bash) for tooling and automation, not only configuration.
  • Ability to investigate directly with packet captures, flow logs, and system-level data.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS network requirements — segmentation, scoping of the cardholder-data environment, segmentation testing.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Cilium / eBPF in production, including Hubble or equivalent flow observability.
  • mTLS at fleet scale, including certificate lifecycle — service mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, Cilium service mesh) and workload identity standards such as SPIFFE/SPIRE.
  • You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — flow analysis, policy generation, drift review.
  • Experience evaluating or deploying ZTNA / identity-aware proxy products. ● Policy-as-code and admission control (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, conftest).
  • Experience with network detection — IDS/IPS, anomalous-flow and lateral-movement detection — and with containment during incidents.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 and with FFIEC-style examination expectations for network security. ● Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or other regulated environments.

About You:

  • You'd rather close a path than document it - an allow-list that exists in production beats a diagram of how the network should look.
  • You change other teams' systems without breaking them - you roll out in observe mode first, measure, and earn the right to enforce.
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang

  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. Hello, potential future Oatly employee. It’s us, the original oatmilk company that started in Sweden back 25 or so years ago and has since expanded to the U.S., where we’ve continued growing at a rate such that we need more brilliant minds to come work with us to keep the momentum going and the oatmilk flowing.

Sustainability, health, and transparency are the core values that guide everything we do. Basically, we exist to help people live a healthier life without recklessly taxing the planet’s resources in the process, and to change the food system for the better. We drive that change through the power of oats and through a significant reduction in cow’s milk consumption. If any of this resonates with you, then maybe you’d like to work for Oatly, too. Now onto the formal stuff.

We are looking for a Manager, Category Management + Insights to join our team. This role will be responsible for building Oatly’s reputation as a best-in-class category and insights leader at all levels with our key customers.

Here are the things we want to hire you to do:

  • Collaborate with Sales teams on key account objectives and identify opportunities to educate customers about plant-based foods, our categories, and our brand

  • Build custom analyses using syndicated scan, consumer, and shopper card data, translating those insights into compelling presentations addressing each customer’s unique goals

  • Leverage data as a foundational springboard from which all recommendations are built

  • Be the functional expert on all syndicated data, including leading the optimization and development of Oatly insights reporting and scorecarding across the NA business unit

  • Develop a mastery of Oatly’s category, customer, consumer, and competitive performance that will inform our narrative and recommendations

  • Lead with a bias for the facts and demonstrate that Oatly’s category and insights leadership will help drive customer growth and profit

  • Question assumptions about major trends, validating or redefining those assumptions into new narratives both internally and externally

Here are the things we think you need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree Required

  • 6+ years of CPG experience, with an emphasis on Sales, Category Management, and Insights

  • Retailer-facing experience preferred

  • Demonstrated deep understanding and experience with Syndicated Data and platforms (Nielsen, Spins, IRI)

  • Experience with Panel and Shopper Card Data (e.g., Numerator, Stratum, Shopper360)

  • Expert knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint/presentation-building skills

  • Exceptional storytelling ability and presentation skills – be able to find and tell the compelling narrative that can be told through data

  • Passion for seeing the forest through the trees, how different pieces connect to the whole, and delivering insights that keep the big picture in mind

  • Ability to connect disparate data sources, interpret analysis results, and communicate analytical findings and business insights to diverse audiences

  • Naturally curious and self-motivated with the ability to embrace change and deliver results, managing multiple/diverse priorities

And here’s another list of qualities we think make a good Oatly team member:

  • You feel connected to our mission of encouraging health, sustainability, and transparency

  • You are a self-starter who doesn’t need direct supervision to motivate you for success – we believe strongly in building a culture of individual accountability and ownership and need partners that can embrace that mentality

  • You are ready to make your mark in a smaller, growing brand, leveraging your experience to deliver amazing results and build an outstanding company

  • You have an entrepreneurial spirit in that you’re comfortable with ambiguity and are energized by the process of building something lasting from the ground up

  • You enjoy sharing your quirkiness and talents with your coworkers

Another bulleted list felt a bit too…bullet-y. So we wrote this long, awkward sentence to let you know all the ways we sweeten the deal when you work with us, like flexible vacation (take it when you need it), really great benefits (yes, pet insurance is in there), paid volunteer days off throughout the year (doing good is fun), free six packs of...(drumroll)…oatmilk, and you’ll also get genuinely great coworkers who are rooting for each other and the company to thrive. Oh, one more short but very important sentence: We are nimble and agile (not chaotic) in how we work, and we’re grounded in a long company history dating way back to the last century.

Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. Compensation may also include bonus, commission, or equity as applicable. Our good faith estimate for base salary is $120,000.

  • Use IBM z/OS mainframe communications products, including Virtual Telecommunications Access Method (VTAM), Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), and File Transfer Protocol (FTP).
  • Create, update, and debug Job Entry Subsystem (JES2) parameters and statements.
  • Use knowledge of storage management tools and techniques including Data Facility Hierarchical Storage Manager (DFHSM), IBM utility used for backup and recovery (ADRDSSU), Systems Managed Storage (SMS) and virtual tape systems to perform installation, upgrade and debugging of IBM z/OS platform issues

Qualifications:

  • IAT-I Certification
  • Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math and seven years' experience installing/maintaining an IBM z/OS, utilization of required software tools and utilities, implementation and testing of related software.

About the Company

Our client is a growing U.S.-based healthcare support organization that provides remote administrative and operational assistance to medical practices across the United States.

The company partners with healthcare professionals to simplify administrative processes, improve practice efficiency, and ensure that medical teams can focus more of their time on patient care.

Its remote workforce supports essential healthcare operations, including patient documentation, insurance coordination, authorization requests, and provider-related administrative processes.

With an emphasis on accuracy, reliable communication, and efficient workflows, the organization continues expanding its remote support teams to meet the needs of healthcare providers across different medical specialties.

About the Role

We are seeking Bilingual Medical Administrative Coordinators to provide remote operational and administrative support to U.S.-based healthcare practices.

In this position, you will help medical teams manage patient information, coordinate insurance-related processes, maintain electronic health records, and support documentation required for prescriptions, authorizations, and provider enrollment.

You will interact with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, pharmacies, and patients to ensure administrative requests are handled accurately and efficiently.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with previous medical administration or healthcare support experience, strong organizational skills, and the ability to communicate professionally in both English and Spanish.

What You'll Do

Medical Records & Patient Information

  • Review and update patient demographic information in electronic health record systems.

  • Maintain accurate and organized EMR/EHR documentation.

  • Upload and organize laboratory reports, referrals, clinical notes, and other medical documents.

  • Support accurate and confidential handling of patient information.

Insurance Verification & Authorization Coordination

  • Communicate with insurance carriers regarding pending decisions and additional requirements.

  • Follow up on authorization denials, appeals, and outstanding documentation.

  • Keep authorization records updated to support timely healthcare services.

Prescription & Pharmacy Administration

  • Communicate with pharmacies regarding medication-related requests.

  • Track prescription authorization statuses and pending responses.

  • Help resolve documentation issues that may delay prescription processing.

  • Keep healthcare teams informed about outstanding medication-related requests.

Provider Credentialing Support

  • Update and maintain provider information in CAQH and other credentialing platforms.

  • Track credentialing applications and enrollment progress.

  • Monitor important provider documentation, including professional licenses, DEA registrations, and malpractice insurance.

  • Help identify upcoming credential expirations and outstanding enrollment requirements.

Healthcare Administrative Operations

  • Communicate with patients, providers, pharmacies, and insurance companies.

  • Maintain organized records of requests, updates, and follow-up activities.

  • Support daily administrative processes across medical practices.

  • Coordinate outstanding tasks to help reduce administrative delays.

  • Handle protected health information responsibly and maintain patient confidentiality.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 1 year of relevant experience in medical administration, medical reception, healthcare virtual assistance, medical records, prior authorizations, credentialing, or a related healthcare support position.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1/C2) and fluent Spanish, both written and spoken.

  • Experience verifying patient insurance eligibility and benefits.

  • Familiarity with Electronic Medical Records (EMR) or Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems.

  • Understanding of healthcare administrative procedures and medical documentation.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.

  • Professional written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

  • Commitment to protecting confidential patient information and maintaining accurate records.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with medical or pharmacy prior authorization processes.

  • Experience with provider credentialing and insurance enrollment.

  • Knowledge of CAQH, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance requirements.

  • Understanding of HIPAA regulations and healthcare documentation standards.

  • Accuracy: You carefully review patient records, insurance details, and medical documentation.

  • Organization: You can manage several administrative processes without losing track of important information.

  • Follow-through: You consistently monitor pending requests and take action when additional information is needed.

  • Communication: You interact professionally with healthcare teams, patients, and insurance representatives.

  • Adaptability: You can work across different administrative workflows and learn new procedures.

  • Confidentiality: You understand the importance of protecting sensitive healthcare information.

How Success Is Measured

  • Patient records and electronic medical documentation remain complete and accurate.

  • Insurance eligibility information is verified and updated appropriately.

  • Prior authorization requests are submitted and followed up on efficiently.

  • Prescription-related administrative requests are coordinated in a timely manner.

  • Provider credentialing documentation and enrollment records remain organized.

  • Pending requests are tracked and communicated effectively.

  • Medical teams receive reliable administrative support that contributes to efficient daily operations.

  • Patient information is handled according to applicable confidentiality and compliance requirements.

Why Join Us?

  • Join an expanding healthcare support organization.

  • Gain experience across multiple areas of medical administration.

  • Work with insurance verification, EMR/EHR systems, prior authorizations, and provider documentation.

  • Develop specialized skills in U.S. healthcare administrative processes.

  • Contribute to smoother operations for medical professionals and their patients.

  • Previous exposure to U.S. healthcare practices is highly valued.

  • The position requires availability during U.S. business hours.

  • This is an administrative support position; clinical responsibilities are not part of the role.

This is a fully remote position.

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Principal Data Architect who owns the hardest data architecture challenges, sets technical direction across data platforms, and serves as the senior technical voice on how organizations model, move, govern, and trust their data. You set the standard for warehouses, lakes, lakehouse environments, streaming systems, and the data foundations that power AI/ML at scale.

In this role, you will operate as the senior technical authority on data architecture — championing data mesh, data product, and governance strategies, owning high-stakes decisions on platform direction, and shaping the data foundations behind production AI systems. You will partner closely with leadership and clients on data strategy, mentor experienced engineers and architects, and drive a long-term vision for data that is scalable, secure, and built to compound in value over time.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Set the standard for data architecture across warehouses, data lakes, and lakehouse environments, including medallion architecture and open table format strategy
  • Design for data and AI governance, including data governance, lineage, quality, cataloging, access control for AI agents, and evaluation data
  • Define vision and direction for batch and streaming data systems at scale and the orchestration that runs them
  • Champion enterprise data modeling strategy across dimensional, Data Vault, data mesh, and data product paradigms
  • Own the architecture of data foundations for AI/ML at scale, including feature stores, embeddings and vector store strategy, and RAG and real-time retrieval data pipelines
  • Architect semantic layers, knowledge graphs, and unstructured data pipelines (documents, text, images, audio) that give AI agents trusted business context
  • Drive infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and observability standards that govern how data platforms are built and operated
  • Champion performance, scalability, cost, and reliability optimization across the data estate
  • Own security, governance, and compliance posture across data assets (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2, PII, data residency, and audit readiness)
  • Stay hands-on: prototype, write production code, and review designs and pull requests alongside delivery teams
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Cursor, and other modern AI assistants to ship higher-quality work at pace

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with senior leadership and clients as the principal technical voice on data strategy and platform direction
  • Support pre-sales as the senior data voice, shaping solution approaches, scoping, estimates, and proposals, and joining client conversations
  • Communicate the most complex data architecture concepts clearly to engineering and executive stakeholders alike
  • Engage across engineering, AI, analytics, and product organizations to align data architecture with enterprise strategy
  • Set the standard for data architecture documentation, modeling and governance practices, and data contracts across teams

Leadership & Influence

  • Define and champion architectural standards and best practices on the engagements you support
  • Build reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and templates that scale the data practice and speed delivery across engagements
  • Mentor experienced engineers and architects, helping them grow their technical judgment and impact
  • Own the most difficult architectural and integration challenges, serving as the senior technical decision-maker
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend tools, frameworks, and patterns that improve architecture over time

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Calm when it gets hot. When scope, timeline, and stakeholders pull in three directions, you slow the room down enough to make the right call. You’d rather raise the hard trade-off in week two than absorb it in week eight.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.
