  • Demonstrated leadership skills with experience coaching, developing, and managing high-performing digital marketing and marketing project management teams.

  • Expertise developing and executing integrated digital marketing plans and initiatives across email, websites, marketing automation, and other digital channels that support organizational and business objectives.

  • Strong understanding of website strategy, user experience, customer journey mapping, audience engagement, and conversion optimization.

  • Experience leading and optimizing marketing technology platforms, customer relationship management (CRM) systems, marketing automation, digital analytics, and customer data strategies. Experience with Sitecore CMS and Informz email marketing platform preferred.

  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing principles with the ability to align digital plans and channels with enterprise marketing campaigns and business priorities.

  • Demonstrated expertise in marketing project management, including resource planning, prioritization, workflow management, and operational process improvement.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret digital marketing metrics, customer insights, website analytics, and campaign performance to inform decision-making and optimize results.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and partner effectively across leadership, Information Technology, business teams, and cross-functional marketing functions.

  • Strong business judgment, problem-solving, and change management skills with the ability to lead teams through evolving priorities, technologies, and organizational initiatives.

  • Commitment to continuous improvement, innovation, and staying current on emerging digital marketing technologies, customer behaviors, industry trends, and best practices.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Information Systems, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience in digital marketing, marketing technology, marketing operations, or a related field, including management experience with direct accountability for leading and developing marketing, digital, or project management professionals.

  • Experience developing and executing integrated digital marketing plans and initiatives across web, email, marketing automation, and other digital channels.

  • Experience leading marketing technology initiatives and collaborating with Information Technology to implement and optimize digital platforms.

  • Experience managing complex marketing projects, improving operational processes, and using digital analytics and customer insights to drive informed decision-making and continuous improvement.

Physical Requirements:

In addition to the responsibilities outlined in the job description, the following requirements represent the essential functions of this job, which must be met by an individual to perform successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions. Upon request, the company will engage in an interactive process to identify and implement reasonable accommodations.

This position involves frequent sitting, standing, walking, and reaching, along with regular repetitive hand motions such as typing and mouse use. It requires prolonged periods of desk work and extensive use of standard office equipment. Occasional travel may be necessary.

To perform effectively, the individual must have sufficient visual acuity to read printed materials and digital screens, as well as the auditory ability to comprehend spoken communication. The role demands strong mental stamina to manage multiple tasks, solve problems, determine the appropriate course of action when making decisions, and interpret and apply both oral and written instructions. Regular communication and interaction across various platforms are essential, along with the ability to remain alert, focused, and responsive throughout the workday.

This position also requires proficiency in processing information, communicating across diverse platforms, and analyzing data to inform decision-making. The role involves proactive problem-solving and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to drive organizational objectives, achieve measurable results, and continuous improvement, often with limited direct supervision.

Total Compensation:

The target pay range for this role is $128,160-$142,400

** In addition to the salary range listed, we offer a wealth of benefits to make working at AACN even more rewarding. Benefits include generous paid time off, low-cost health plans for medical and mental health services, dental, and vision, company-paid life and short-term disability insurance, a variety of other benefits, and retirement savings program with employer matching and additional company contribution. jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

What We Do

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community, dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We have several products that provide essential services for businesses, such as credit, overdrafts, etc. We leverage artificial intelligence and data to make our decisions, but also have the technology and data-driven best practices used to support our businesses.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SRE to engineer the reliability of our highly distributed platform. You will combine deep knowledge of distributed systems with strong coding skills to define SLOs, lead incident response, and build automation and self-healing mechanisms into our systems. You will balance immediate operational stability with long-term strategic engineering to ensure our services scale linearly with our hyper-growth.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in on-call rotations. Act as the Incident Commander during major severity incidents: initiating war rooms, coordinating cross-functional teams, and providing clear status updates.
  • Instrument code to expose high-cardinality metrics and distributed traces. Collaboratively define, measure, and defend Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets with product owners.
  • Write high-quality, production-ready code (in Java, Go, or Python) to build internal tooling, automation platforms, and self-healing mechanisms that eliminate manual operator intervention.
  • Partner with Product Engineering teams during the design phase to ensure new services are built with reliability, scalability, and observability patterns (circuit breakers, rate limiting, backpressure, fallback strategies) from day one.
  • Analyze system performance and traffic patterns to model future capacity needs. Conduct load testing and chaos engineering experiments to verify system resilience under failure conditions.
    .

Requirements

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in SRE or Backend Engineering with a strong ability to write clean, performant, and tested code in Java, Go, Rust, or Python.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and design patterns. You possess a strong command of microservices fundamentals, event-driven architectures, and the underlying principles required to build systems that scale.
  • Extensive experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar cloud providers (AWS/Azure). You are proficient in running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE/EKS) and troubleshooting cluster/infrastructure issues.
  • Experience designing observability strategies using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, New Relic, Datadog, or SigNoz to improve system visibility.
  • Familiarity with operating and tuning production data stores (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ) in a high-throughput environment.

What we can offer you

  • Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
  • A technical interview with the Hiring Manager
  • A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.excerpt: Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own.
jobs.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

Empower is transforming how Americans experience wealth, bridging workplace retirement and personal wealth products and services to deliver more holistic, accessible financial solutions. We are seeking a seasoned attorney to join our legal team as a strategic partner to our Personal Wealth product organization.

This role has primary accountability for supporting the development and delivery of personal wealth products. You will partner across retirement, wealth, compliance, and business teams where those areas intersect. Few organizations operate at this scale across both retirement and personal wealth, creating a unique opportunity to design integrated solutions for millions of customers.

You will help design and launch next-generation wealth solutions that reach millions of customers. If you are energized by building, not just reviewing, and want to help shape the future of retail wealth, this role offers a unique platform to do so.

What you will do:

  • Serve as lead counsel to the Personal Wealth product organization, advising on the design, development, implementation and distribution of innovative wealth offerings
  • Partner closely with product, compliance, risk and business leaders from concept through launch, ensuring aligned, practical solutions across legal, risk and compliance while enabling speed to market
  • Coordinate across Empower’s broader legal team to deliver aligned, consistent, and business-oriented guidance, ensuring a “one voice” approach to legal advice
  • Navigate complex legal and regulatory frameworks, including the Investment Advisers Act, the Exchange Act, SEC and FINRA rules, ERISA/DOL fiduciary standards, and state laws and regulations
  • Advise on product structures and distribution across direct-to-consumer and advisor-led channels
  • Provide guidance on SEC and ERISA fiduciary obligations as applicable, Reg BI, conflicts of interest management, and client disclosures
  • Advise on and help shape Empower’s approach to the responsible use of artificial intelligence and data-driven technologies in wealth products, including evolving state and federal guidance and rulemaking related to predictive analytics, conflicts of interest, model governance, and client communications
  • Support product governance, regulatory filings and client-facing materials
  • Advise on third-party partnerships and evolving fintech capabilities
  • Monitor regulatory and industry developments, translating them into practical guidance for product, compliance, and other legal stakeholders

What Sets This Role Apart

  • Direct impact: Shape products that support millions of retirement plan participants and personal wealth clients as their financial needs evolve
  • Builder mindset: Work closely with the product organization to shape strategy and enable execution
  • Innovation with purpose: Help expand access to sophisticated wealth solutions
  • Enterprise impact: Shape products and solutions that serve millions of investors across their financial lifecycle
  • Strategic seat at the table: Partner directly with senior product and business leaders to shape product direction, not just advising on execution
  • Innovation in a regulated environment: Help navigate and define approaches in emerging areas like AI, digital advice, and retail access to new products and services

What You Bring

  • J.D. and active bar membership
  • 15+ years of experience advising retail wealth management businesses (RIA, broker-dealer, or hybrid)
  • Strong knowledge of wealth management legal and regulatory frameworks including deep familiarity with SEC, FINRA, and state regulatory regimes particularly related to duties of care, disclosure, and conflicts of interest
  • Exposure to emerging wealth products including direct indexing, alternatives, retirement income strategies
  • Experience supporting product strategy, development and launch, ideally in a fast-paced or technology-enabled environment
  • Sound judgment and ability to balance legal and regulatory risk with business objectives
  • Comfort operating in evolving or ambiguous regulatory environments
  • Operates as a senior individual contributor with strong cross-functional influence
  • Executive presence and ability to communicate practical legal guidance clearly to senior business, product and other legal stakeholders

Preferred Experience

  • Experience at integrated retirement/wealth service providers, asset managers, RIAs, broker-dealers, fintech platforms, or other scaled financial services firms
  • Strong knowledge of wealth management legal frameworks, with familiarity or experience in retirement/ERISA frameworks strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with digital platforms, data-driven personalization, or fintech partnerships
  • Experience advising on distribution across retirement, direct-to-consumer, and advisor-led channels
  • Experience with product governance committees, disclosure/conflicts governance, and regulatory examinations
  • Familiarity with emerging retail products such as cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and prediction markets

How We Work at Empower

At Empower, how we work matters as much as what we build. We value collaboration, transparency, and shared ownership, and our legal team is viewed as a critical enabler of innovation—not a barrier.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Operates with a “one team” mindset, building strong, trust-based relationships across functions
  • Communicates clearly and pragmatically, translating complex legal concepts into actionable guidance
  • Takes accountability, exercises sound judgment, and leads with integrity
  • Embraces Empower’s values and contributes to a culture where diverse perspectives and ideas drive better outcomes
  • Proactively aligns with legal, compliance, and risk partners to ensure consistent, enterprise-wide positions, avoiding siloed or fragmented advice

Why Empower

Empower is uniquely positioned at the convergence of retirement and wealth. This creates an opportunity to build differentiated products and to do so in a way that meaningfully improves financial outcomes for millions of people. This role offers the opportunity to help define how retirement and wealth solutions converge, an area of increasing focus across the industry, but one where Empower is uniquely positioned to lead.

If you’re looking for a role where you can influence strategy, build innovative solutions, and be part of a collaborative, mission-driven culture, we’d like to meet you.


***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)

jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that power exceptional member, provider, and associate experiences.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that power exceptional member, provider, and associate experiences.

The Director, Enterprise Quality Methodologies, Governance & Enablement will lead the definition, governance, and enterprise adoption of quality engineering standards, methodologies, compliance alignment, quality intelligence, AI-enabled engineering practices, and transformation enablement. This leader will establish “what good looks like” for Quality Engineering across Humana’s software delivery ecosystem and ensure quality practices are consistently embedded across the SDLC, Agile ways of working, engineering platforms, DevOps governance routines, and responsible use of AI-enabled capabilities.

This role will partner closely with Quality Engineering, Enterprise Engineering Enablement, Agile Office, Product, Engineering, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Audit, Data and AI teams, and segment technology teams to mature enterprise quality practices, strengthen governance frameworks, enable platform adoption, and improve quality outcomes across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Quality Strategy, Policy, and Standards

  • Define and evolve the enterprise Quality Engineering strategy, standards, methodologies, and operating procedures across software delivery teams.
  • Establish SDLC quality standards, policies, and practical guidance that embed quality earlier and more consistently across planning, development, testing, release, and production validation.
  • Create and maintain enterprise engineering best practices, including “What Good Looks Like” guidance for quality planning, test automation, code quality, regression testing, deployment validation, performance testing, release readiness, production quality, and AI-assisted quality engineering practices.
  • Align Quality Engineering ways of working with Agile Office practices, DevOps governance, platform standards, enterprise delivery models, and responsible AI expectations.
  • Partner with engineering enablement teams to ensure quality standards are reflected in enterprise tooling, pipelines, templates, reusable workflows, development practices, and AI-enabled engineering workflows where appropriate.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering and Transformation

  • Lead the integration of AI-enabled quality engineering practices into enterprise methodologies, governance models, coaching programs, and SDLC quality standards.
  • Define guidance for responsible use of AI in quality engineering, including test design, test generation, defect analysis, requirements analysis, code review support, test data analysis, automation acceleration, quality intelligence, and productivity improvement.
  • Partner with Data, AI, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Engineering stakeholders to ensure AI-enabled quality practices align with enterprise policies, risk controls, privacy requirements, and responsible AI principles.
  • Evaluate opportunities to use generative AI, machine learning, analytics, and intelligent automation to improve quality planning, coverage analysis, risk-based testing, defect prevention, release readiness, and production quality insights.
  • Establish governance and measurement practices for AI-enabled quality capabilities, including adoption, value realization, risk management, human oversight, and continuous improvement.

Governance, Compliance, and Quality Maturity

  • Establish and maintain enterprise Quality Engineering governance frameworks that improve consistency, transparency, risk management, compliance alignment, and responsible AI adoption.
  • Define, implement, and mature a Quality Engineering maturity model that helps teams assess capability, prioritize improvement opportunities, and measure progress over time.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Audit, AI governance, and technology stakeholders to align quality engineering practices with enterprise controls, regulatory expectations, internal policies, and emerging AI governance standards.
  • Develop governance routines, decision forums, scorecards, and reporting mechanisms to monitor adoption of quality standards and identify systemic risks.
  • Use governance insights to drive continuous improvement across SDLC quality practices, DevOps controls, AI-enabled engineering practices, release quality, automation adoption, and production readiness.

Education, Enablement, and Transformation Support

  • Lead organizational enablement programs that help teams adopt enterprise Quality Engineering standards, methodologies, tools, AI-enabled capabilities, and ways of working.
  • Oversee Quality Engineering coaches who guide teams through quality planning, maturity assessments, platform onboarding, automation adoption, AI-assisted quality practices, and SDLC quality improvement.
  • Partner with platform and engineering enablement teams to support onboarding and integration across enterprise engineering platforms, including Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Enterprise, LaunchDarkly, SonarQube, and related quality tools.
  • Lead QE Community of Practice forums, learning initiatives, training programs, enablement content, and knowledge-sharing routines that strengthen enterprise quality capability and AI fluency.
  • Support enterprise quality transformation initiatives by translating strategy into practical adoption models, playbooks, coaching plans, metrics, and change management approaches.

Quality Intelligence and Analytics

  • Define and advance enterprise quality intelligence capabilities that provide actionable insight into engineering quality, SDLC compliance, quality maturity, release readiness, AI adoption, and production quality trends.
  • Partner with data, platform, DevOps, AI, and engineering teams to develop dashboards and scorecards for quality standards adoption, automation coverage, code quality, deployment validation, performance testing, defect trends, governance compliance, and AI-enabled quality outcomes.
  • Leverage quality and engineering metrics, including DevOps, DORA, pipeline, code quality, pull request, build, deployment, AI productivity, and compliance indicators, to guide improvement efforts.
  • Translate quality data into executive insights, risk themes, maturity trends, and recommendations that improve technology delivery outcomes.

QE Audit and Control Support

  • Lead Quality Engineering coordination for internal and external audits, including audit planning, evidence collection, control alignment, response coordination, and remediation tracking.
  • Partner with Audit, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, AI governance, Engineering, and platform teams to ensure Quality Engineering standards and evidence are aligned to applicable controls.
  • Establish repeatable audit support processes, evidence repositories, ownership models, and reporting routines to improve audit readiness and reduce operational friction.
  • Identify audit findings, control gaps, AI-related control considerations, and recurring evidence challenges; partner with stakeholders to drive corrective actions and sustainable improvements.

Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team focused on quality methodology, governance, enablement, coaching, analytics, AI-enabled quality practices, and audit support.
  • Influence leaders and teams across a matrixed enterprise environment to adopt consistent quality standards, measurable engineering practices, and responsible AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, continuous improvement, learning, responsible innovation, and customer-centered quality.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior technology leaders on enterprise Quality Engineering maturity, AI-enabled transformation, risk, compliance, standards adoption, and transformation progress.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of experience in quality engineering, software engineering, DevOps, technology governance, IT risk, compliance, technology enablement, AI-enabled engineering transformation, or related disciplines.
  • 5 or more years of leadership experience managing technical teams, enablement teams, governance functions, or enterprise-scale transformation capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience defining and implementing software quality standards, methodologies, operating procedures, or SDLC governance practices.
  • Experience applying or governing AI-enabled capabilities in software engineering, quality engineering, test automation, analytics, productivity improvement, or technology transformation.
  • Experience with Agile delivery, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, software engineering controls, release readiness, and production quality practices.
  • Experience developing maturity models, governance frameworks, scorecards, dashboards, and executive-level reporting.
  • Experience partnering with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Audit, Engineering, Product, AI/Data, and technology leadership stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of quality engineering practices, including test automation, regression testing, deployment validation, code quality, performance testing, defect prevention, and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence enterprise adoption of standards and best practices in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong executive communication, analytical, organizational, and change leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated environment.
  • Experience leading Quality Engineering enablement, Agile transformation, DevOps governance, engineering excellence, AI-enabled engineering transformation, or enterprise platform adoption.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Enterprise, LaunchDarkly, SonarQube, CI/CD templates, reusable workflows, feature flags, code quality tooling, DevOps governance practices, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Experience with audit evidence management, control mapping, SDLC compliance, segregation of duties, access controls, vulnerability scanning, software delivery governance, and AI governance considerations.
  • Experience applying DORA, SPACE, code quality, pipeline, release, AI productivity, quality intelligence, and compliance metrics to improve engineering performance.
  • Experience building Communities of Practice, coaching models, training programs, learning journeys, AI literacy programs, or enterprise enablement frameworks.

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. jobs.excerpt: About the Role We are looking for a proactive, resourceful, and highly organised Project Manager – Real Estate & Property Development to help drive complex real estate projects forward, from land acquisition and due diligence through zoning, permitting, approvals, and ongoing project coordination.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, resourceful, and highly organised Project Manager – Real Estate & Property Development to help drive complex real estate projects forward, from land acquisition and due diligence through zoning, permitting, approvals, and ongoing project coordination.

This role is ideal for someone who understands the practical realities of real estate development and can manage multiple stakeholders, navigate approval processes, track outstanding documentation, and keep projects moving without needing constant supervision.

You will work closely with attorneys, tenants, government offices, city and state authorities, utility providers, and other stakeholders to coordinate requirements, resolve obstacles, and ensure important tasks are completed on time.

The ideal candidate is a strong independent problem-solver who takes ownership, anticipates potential delays, and consistently follows through. You should also be comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT to support research, organise information, draft correspondence, and identify next steps, while independently verifying information before acting on it.

Experience with U.S. real estate processes is strongly preferred.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Real Estate Project Coordination

  • Manage and coordinate real estate and property development projects from acquisition through due diligence, approvals, and ongoing execution.
  • Track project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, deadlines, and outstanding requirements.
  • Coordinate land acquisition activities and support due diligence processes.
  • Monitor project progress, identify delays, and proactively implement solutions to keep projects moving.
  • Manage multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously while maintaining accurate records and clear priorities.

Zoning, Permitting & Approvals

  • Coordinate zoning, permitting, and other regulatory approval processes with relevant authorities.
  • Follow up with city and state government offices regarding applications, outstanding documentation, approvals, and project requirements.
  • Track approval statuses, submission deadlines, and dependencies between different stages of a project.
  • Identify potential roadblocks and work proactively with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.
  • Maintain organised records of applications, permits, correspondence, approvals, and supporting documents.

Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination

  • Communicate professionally with attorneys, tenants, government representatives, utility providers, and other project stakeholders.
  • Follow up consistently on outstanding actions, legal documentation, approvals, and information requests.
  • Coordinate with water companies and other utility providers to manage service requirements, connections, approvals, and project-related dependencies.
  • Maintain clear communication between stakeholders to ensure everyone understands outstanding requirements and next steps.
  • Escalate complex issues when necessary, while taking initiative to identify practical solutions before escalation.

Documentation & Project Administration

  • Maintain accurate, centralised project documentation, trackers, correspondence, and records.
  • Monitor outstanding documents, signatures, submissions, approvals, and follow-up actions.
  • Use spreadsheets, shared documents, email, calendars, and project management tools to organise workflows and maintain visibility across projects.
  • Provide regular progress updates, highlighting completed tasks, outstanding items, risks, blockers, and upcoming deadlines.
  • Ensure information is accurate, organised, accessible, and kept up to date.

AI-Assisted Research & Productivity

  • Use professional AI tools such as ChatGPT to conduct preliminary research, organise information, draft correspondence, summarise documents, and identify potential next steps.
  • Apply AI tools to improve administrative efficiency, structure project information, and support decision-making.
  • Independently verify AI-generated information, particularly when dealing with legal, regulatory, zoning, permitting, or other critical project requirements.
  • Use sound judgement when handling confidential project information and ensure sensitive information is shared only through approved tools and channels.

Minimum Requirements

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience managing real estate, property development, or closely related projects.
  • Practical experience coordinating project activities involving multiple stakeholders, documentation, deadlines, and dependencies.
  • Experience with land acquisition, due diligence, zoning, permitting, or regulatory approval processes.
  • Strong organisational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Proven ability to manage projects independently and follow through without repeated reminders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify blockers, recommend solutions, and drive tasks to completion.
  • Professional proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT for research, drafting, information organisation, and workflow support.
  • Ability to independently verify information and exercise sound judgement when using AI-generated outputs.
  • Comfortable using spreadsheets, shared documents, email, calendars, and project tracking tools.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with U.S. real estate markets, including familiarity with local zoning, permitting, municipal approvals, and property development processes.
  • Experience coordinating directly with attorneys, tenants, city or state authorities, and utility providers.
  • Exposure to water service applications, utility connections, infrastructure requirements, or related property development processes.
  • Experience managing complex, unconventional, or non-standard projects requiring initiative and independent problem-solving.
  • Familiarity with project management software and document management systems.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for moving projects forward and consistently follows through on commitments.
  • Proactive Problem-Solving: Identifies obstacles early, investigates solutions, and takes action rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Organisation & Attention to Detail: Maintains accurate documentation, tracks dependencies, and ensures deadlines and outstanding requirements are not overlooked.
  • Stakeholder Management: Communicates effectively with diverse stakeholders and maintains professional relationships.
  • Independent Judgement: Makes informed decisions, recognises risks, and knows when to escalate complex issues.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable navigating unfamiliar processes and managing projects that do not always follow a straightforward path.
  • AI & Technology Proficiency: Uses AI tools and digital platforms confidently to improve research, organisation, communication, and productivity.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking ownership of complicated projects and figuring out how to move them forward. You should be resourceful enough to chase outstanding approvals, investigate delays, coordinate different parties, and recommend solutions without needing someone to manage every step for you.

The successful candidate will demonstrate practical real estate project experience, strong independent judgement, and a consistent track record of turning outstanding tasks into completed outcomes.

Candidates who rely heavily on reminders, struggle to manage documentation, overlook important details, or lack practical experience navigating approvals and multiple stakeholders are unlikely to be a suitable fit.

jobs.excerpt: 🤙🏼 About gaiiaAt gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers.
jobs.description:
🤙🏼 About gaiia

At gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers. Our core product is an operating system (OS) for telcos that manages billing, operations, automation and everything in between.

We're passionate about taking care of our people, and it's not just lip service. We want you to focus on your job while we care for everything else. We offer competitive pay and benefits, attractive stock options, unparalleled transparency, and a 100% remote environment. We're excited to have you join us for your next career adventure!

🎭 Role & Team

Following our $40M Series B, we’re scaling our technical teams, and we’re hiring our first dedicated recruiter to lead it. As our first Technical Recruiter, you’ll report directly to our CEO and own technical hiring end to end: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate experience, offer, and close.

This is a true founding seat. There is no People team, no recruiting ops, and no inherited sourcing playbook today. You’ll inherit Rippling as our ATS and a dedicated Slack channel for candidate submissions, and you’ll build everything else. You’ll partner closely with our CEO and our Sr. Director, Customer Solutions Engineering to calibrate the profile, hold the bar, and move fast.

The searches you’ll take over

Your first priorities are Forward Deployed Engineer and Data Migration, two customer-facing technical roles on our Customer Solutions Engineering team. These engineers combine deep networking knowledge with strong TypeScript/JavaScript and modern tooling, and they work directly with our customers to get them live on gaiia. Adjacent profiles such as Solutions Architect, Implementation Engineer, Integration Engineer, and Professional Services Engineer draw from the same talent pool. As gaiia grows, you’ll also support product engineering hiring (backend, frontend, infrastructure, AI/agentic).

A successful candidate is energized by white space. You build the playbook instead of waiting for one, and you’re technically credible enough to run a first conversation with a senior engineer from the telco and network-vendor world.

🪄 What you’re going to do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for the Forward Deployed Engineer and Data Migration roles, then expand to broader engineering hiring.
  • Build and continuously refine Boolean search strategies in LinkedIn Recruiter, and source directly through GitHub, networking and telco communities, and referrals.
  • Screen profiles at high volume and run initial phone screens, making fast, disciplined yes/no calls.
  • Assess candidates on networking depth, TypeScript/JavaScript, curiosity about modern tooling (AI tools, n8n, Zapier), and customer-facing experience, and submit only candidates who clear the bar, with honest candidate briefs.
  • Coordinate scheduling across our interview process.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience. Our bar for candidate communication is very high.
  • Confirm work authorization early and flag AI-generated or fraudulent resumes.
  • Partner with our CEO and engineering leaders to sharpen the ideal candidate profile from interview feedback, and push back when the bar slips.
  • Set up Rippling workflows and report funnel metrics to leadership without being asked.
  • Negotiate and close offers in a market-calibrated comp posture.

🌈 Who we're looking for

  • A scrappy, self-sufficient operator who doesn’t need a support staff to be effective.
  • A quality-over-volume mindset. You won’t send us low-signal candidates just to hit a number.
  • A direct, no-BS communicator who gives and takes real-time feedback, including uncomfortable truths, with candidates, hiring managers, and the CEO.
  • Comfort partnering directly with an executive, with the confidence to challenge and calibrate.
  • Strong opinions about tools, held loosely. You work pragmatically with what’s available.
  • Enough fluency in networking, TypeScript, and integration work to tell real depth from hand-waving.
  • Proficiency in English (French is a bonus).
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to meet key candidates in person and join critical interview loops and team offsites.

🎖️ Qualifications

Recruiting fundamentals

  • 5+ years of technical recruiting, with a track record of sourcing technical talent (not just sales or operations roles).
  • Proven experience filling niche, hard-to-fill technical roles, and examples of where those candidates came from.
  • Boolean search expertise, and comfort reviewing 50–100 profiles in a session.
  • Direct sourcing strength. You don’t rely on inbound applicants or agencies.
  • Experience closing candidates and negotiating offers.
  • Familiarity with the networking, telecom, and infrastructure space. You don’t need to be an expert, but you recognize signal words like ISP, OSS/BSS, MPLS, provisioning, and TypeScript.

Technical screening fluency

  • Networking concepts, the deepest must-have: you can tell when a candidate actually knows networking.
  • TypeScript/JavaScript: you can assess whether someone is genuinely productive or only conversant.
  • APIs, Postman, and integration patterns: you know what a strong answer to “walk me through a recent integration you built” sounds like.
  • Awareness of whether candidates actually use AI tools and workflow platforms (n8n, Zapier).

Nice-to-have

  • Experience recruiting for ISP, telecom, or networking-software companies.
  • Familiarity with names like Cloudflare, Cisco, Itential, Calix, Ciena, Nokia, Juniper, and Arista.
  • Experience recruiting Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or Professional Services Engineers at SaaS companies.
  • Prior experience as a solo or near-solo recruiter, or at a startup or scale-up.
  • Hands-on Rippling experience, or a track record of ramping quickly on modern ATS tools.
  • Experience hiring for AI-native or AI/agentic platform companies.
  • Bilingual English/French.

💰 Salary

At gaiia, we have a transparent salary philosophy and a robust evaluation and compensation framework. It translates to a fair and impartial model where salaries are published internally, healthy discussions around compensation and performance can exist, and taboos are removed.

🔆 Benefits

  • Flexible 25 days of vacation.
  • Stock Options Plan.
  • Group Insurance.
  • Telemedicine.
  • Life Spending Account.
  • Employee-sponsored RRSP.
  • Flexible working hours & all-remote work.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity. Our workplace is fully remote and boasts accessible technologies, ensuring all team members can thrive. Should you require accommodations due to a disability during the application process, please contact us at 581-996-9639 or as per the Accessible Canada Act and human rights legislation. We're here to support you every step of the way.

Developer Advocates at Datadog are engineers who share their expertise with technical practitioners, help customers tell their stories, and represent the perspectives of our community inside Datadog.

As a Manager II on the Advocacy team, you will lead our Community Advocacy functions. You will manage a team of Developer Advocates responsible for global programs such as Datadog Ambassadors, Champions, and User Groups, as well as opportunities for customer engineers to share their expertise through technical writing, public speaking, and other community contributions.


Across these interconnected programs, your team will enable customer engineers to contribute technical knowledge, lead communities, and turn their experiences into compelling content and conference talks for Datadog and third-party channels. This role combines people leadership, program strategy, technical judgment, and cross-functional influence to amplify authentic customer voices, deepen understanding of Datadog and its products, and foster a thriving community of practitioners.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and develop a team of Developer Advocates, setting clear expectations, guiding priorities, coaching performance, supporting career growth, and fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture
  • Own the strategy, goals, and roadmap for Community Advocacy, translating broader Advocacy and company priorities into focused programs and measurable outcomes
  • Guide the continued development of our Ambassador, Champion, and User Group programs, creating clear contributor journeys, expectations, enablement, recognition, and opportunities for customer engineers to increase their impact
  • Build repeatable systems that enable customer engineers to contribute technical knowledge, create content, share best practices, and serve as trusted leaders within their communities
  • Develop a strong pipeline of customer stories by identifying compelling practitioners and helping them shape authentic, technically credible narratives
  • Oversee the support, co-development, and coaching of conference talks by customer engineers—from identifying an idea and developing an abstract through content review, rehearsal, and delivery—for Datadog events, including our flagship user conference, DASH, as well as third-party industry conferences
  • Establish measures of success for Community Advocacy, using qualitative and quantitative insights to evaluate program health, contributor engagement, content quality, audience impact, and customer outcomes
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, Customer Success, and regional teams to align priorities, identify opportunities, and scale customer participation across Datadog initiatives
  • Ensure insights from Ambassadors, Champions, User Group participants, speakers, and other community members are shared with the appropriate teams inside Datadog, strengthening the connection between our customers and our products
  • Balance strategic leadership with selective hands-on contribution, including coaching speakers, reviewing technical content, participating in community programs, and representing Datadog when appropriate

Who You Are:

  • You are an experienced people manager who has led autonomous technical professionals, coached performance, developed talent, and translated complex goals into achievable plans
  • You have experience defining and delivering successful developer advocacy, developer relations, technical community, or a related functions
  • You have built or meaningfully contributed to programs that enable external practitioners to participate, contribute, create content, or lead communities at scale
  • You have experience helping technical practitioners develop and communicate their stories, including coaching conference speakers or co-developing technically credible talks and content
  • You are a former software developer, SRE, or other technical practitioner—or have equivalent technical depth—with the judgment needed to assess technical accuracy and coach effective technical narratives
  • You are a thoughtful cross-functional leader who can build alignment, make prioritization decisions, and influence partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, and customer-facing organizations
  • You use both data and community insight to evaluate program effectiveness, identify opportunities, and make decisions about where the team should invest
  • You understand how to build trust with technical communities and value authentic practitioner voices over purely promotional messaging
  • You are comfortable operating through ambiguity, establishing structure where needed, and evolving programs as Datadog’s products, customers, and technical audiences grow

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Design a quality strategy that works across .NET, PHP, and Node and TypeScript. You're not bringing a single-stack playbook. You're defining an approach to quality that holds up across a portfolio of different systems.

Build the automation layer. API and end-to-end test coverage, integrated into each platform's delivery pipeline, with agentic and AI-driven tooling brought in deliberately so coverage scales without adding headcount for every new surface.

Define and own the quality gates across all products. No ticket exits development without a clear testing designation. Nothing ships to production without documented evidence that tests passed on an environment that genuinely mirrors production, same stack and same configuration. You own the standard, and you own sign-off on environment parity.

Own regression protection through various legacy technology modernization eforts. Build the safety net that lets engineering re-platform aggressively without silently breaking customer-facing behavior. This is the difference between a modernization that ships and one that stalls under fear of breaking things.

You are fluent in modern automation and comfortable that the stacks differ. You can reason about quality in a .NET system, a PHP system, and a Node and TypeScript system, and design an approach that generalizes rather than one that only fits what you already know.

You treat AI and agentic tooling as the force multiplier that makes cross-stack quality possible for a small team.

You have protected a product through a major migration, re-platform, or rewrite, where regression was the central risk and the cost of getting it wrong was customer trust.

When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. jobs.description:
About Synapticure

Synapticure is the largest, most comprehensive specialty care and life sciences company in the country for those living with neurodegenerative diseases. Founded by patients and caregivers living with these diseases, we are redefining the care and the research paradigm for conditions like Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS in all 50 states.

Our business is powered by two connected engines.

The CARES Engine (Clinical Operations)

A scalable, 50-state virtualized clinical network providing timely access to expert neurologists and cutting edge treatments with wraparound care coordination and behavioral health support. Our team creates personalized care plans focused on education and empowerment, connecting patients with a multidisciplinary team of subspecialty neurologists, geriatricians, psychologists, and care coordinators who collaborate to deliver comprehensive care.

The CURES Engine (Research & Innovation)

Leveraging our deeply engaged, well characterized national patient cohort, CURES partners with life science, pharma, biotech, and medical device companies to accelerate the development of neurodegenerative treatments, spanning discovery stage lab services, clinical trial services, and real world evidence data and analytics.

Partnering with providers, health plans, and life sciences companies, including CMS' GUIDE dementia care model, Synapticure is dedicated to transforming the lives of millions of individuals and their families living with neurodegenerative diseases.

About the Role

    We're hiring a Manager, Licensing & Credentialing to lead our licensing, credentialing, and payer enrollment function. You'll combine operational leadership and direct ownership of complex, high-priority licensing and credentialing workflows (including the full provider onboarding and offboarding process and license pathway determinations) with day-to-day leadership of our L&C team. You will ensure providers stay licensed and credentialed as we grow into new states and payer relationships. It's behind-the-scenes work, but it supports every patient in its own way: every license kept current and every enrollment completed on time is what lets a patient see their provider without interruption.

The Day-to-Day

    Provider Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Own the full onboarding sequence end-to-end: execute license pathway determinations, perform compact licensure assessments (IMLC/PSYPACT/NLC/APRN), manage start-date sequencing, transcript/employment verification, and COI tracking.
  • Run sanction/exclusion screening at onboarding and set up DEA registration where applicable.
  • Own the offboarding and termination process end-to-end: deactivating licenses, payer enrollments, and supervision agreements, notifying payers, and archiving records.

    • Licensing & Credentialing Operations Support

  • Support and oversee multi-state provider licensing applications and renewals (executed by State Licensing leads), maintaining the Master Licensing Sheet and State Coverage Maps to prevent lapses.
  • Support and oversee payer enrollment and credentialing across Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers (executed by Payer Enrollment leads), including CAQH/Availity management, revalidations, and re-credentialing cycles.
  • Monitor APP restrictions, practice authority, and state board notifications to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
  • Serve as the go-to escalation point for complex or unusual licensing, credentialing, and billing/care operational questions.

    • Collaboration Agreements & Credentialing Committee

  • Execute and maintain collaboration/supervision agreement tracking and routine drafting, transitioning toward full operational ownership under the Director's coaching.
  • Execute Credentialing Committee logistics, managing scheduling, agendas, and documentation while partnering with the Director on committee discussions.
  • Support payer contracting, denials, and appeals, coordinating with the Director on escalation pathways.

    • Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Manage and coach the L&C team: workload distribution, regular feedback, performance management, and professional development.
  • Set team priorities, process standards, quality checks, and SOP Playbooks for licensing and credentialing work.
  • Hold regular 1:1s with your team.
  • Partner with the Director of Practice Operations on team capacity, staffing needs, and workflow design as the team grows.

    • Reporting, Compliance & Process Improvement

  • Own regulatory and compliance documentation to keep the organization audit-ready and support internal/external audits.
  • Maintain routine tracking and metrics (license status, credentialing turnaround time, expirables, payer rosters) for leadership visibility.
  • Spot inefficiencies in L&C workflows and drive continuous improvement by leveraging tracking technology, systems optimization, and automation to accelerate onboarding timelines.
  • Lead internal and external operational communications regarding licensing and enrollment status.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of direct, hands-on experience in state provider licensing, credentialing, and payer enrollment/revalidation workflows.
  • 2-3+ years of team leadership or people management experience managing a licensing and credentialing team or operational function.
  • Solid understanding of the broader U.S. healthcare landscape: payers, regulatory environment, and care delivery models within telehealth.
  • Working knowledge of compact licensure pathways (IMLC, PSYPACT, NLC, APRN Compact).
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills, with comfort owning ambiguous, detail-heavy processes independently.
  • Familiarity with credentialing/licensing tracking software and CAQH/PECOS.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting CMS reimbursement programs or PC-MSO structures.
  • CPCS or CPMSM certification, or actively pursuing.
  • Background in a multi-market, high-growth, or telehealth healthcare environment.
  • Familiarity with leveraging automation or technology integrations to optimize credentialing workflows.

Compensation

Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Our Values

We are a remote-first company. While our team is located all across the United States, these core principles tie us together around a common identity:

  • Relentless focus on patients and caregivers: We are determined to provide an exceptional experience for every patient we have the privilege to serve, and we put our patients first in everything we do.
  • Embody the spirit and humanity of those living with neurodegenerative disease: Inspired by our founders, families, and personal experiences, we recognize the seriousness of our patients' circumstances and meet that challenge every day with empathy, compassion, kindness, joy, and hope.
  • Seek to understand, and stay curious: We start by listening to one another, our partners, our patients, and their caregivers. We communicate with authenticity and humility, prioritizing honesty and directness while recognizing we always have something to learn.
  • Embrace the opportunity: We are energized by the importance of our mission and maintain a strong bias toward action.

Benefits & Perks

Full time employees are eligible for:

  • Remote First: Work from anywhere in the 50 United States, with home office technology provided.
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision insurance options for you and your family.
  • Financial & Retirement Support: 401(k) plan with employer matching, plus short and long-term disability, and basic and supplemental life insurance.
  • Time Off & Leave: 15 vacation days, 5 sick days, 12 paid holidays, and 2 floating holidays, plus a fully paid end-of-year company holiday break (typically Christmas through New Year's).
  • Wellness & Family Growth: Comprehensive family-building and fertility services through Kindbody (where available) at a 20% discount, 24/7 mental health support via Health Advocate and Talkspace (including 12 free on-demand sessions per year), and access to One Medical.

Travel Requirements & Remote Workplace Setup

We're a remote-first company and provide the necessary technology to work from home. Most roles involve only occasional travel, such as for team meetings or professional collaboration events, unless otherwise specified in the job-specific details above.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Synapticure is an equal opportunity employer and a remote-first workplace. We believe that embedding equity, inclusion, compliance, and operational excellence across all aspects of our employee lifecycle directly reflects our core values. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please apply even if you feel you do not meet all qualifications.

At this time, Synapticure is unable to provide work visa sponsorship.

JOB SUMMARY:

Natera is seeking a Data Privacy Director to help advance and operationalize the enterprise privacy program across our commercial, clinical, and product environments. This is a broad, hands-on leadership role supporting the full range of the Privacy team's work — from privacy impact assessments and regulatory analysis to contract and legal privacy-focused reviews — with a strong business-enablement orientation. This role reports to the Vice President, Data Privacy and partners with cross-functional teams to embed privacy principles throughout the lifecycle of data, technology, and innovation initiatives. The Director may also provide guidance and mentorship to privacy team members and external resources supporting the program.

The Director will also serve as a key integration point between Privacy and Product, embedding privacy-by-design into product and software development lifecycles and partnering with engineering to make privacy practical and scalable. In partnership with Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, and Data Sciences (R&D), this leader will also enhance and maintain data governance frameworks that support clinical research initiatives and the responsible use of data for quality improvement and development activities. Together, these efforts will help strengthen Natera’s privacy program, building efficient, repeatable processes that expand team capacity while enabling responsible innovation and growth.

Regarding culture, we seek people who demonstrate Natera's values, enjoy challenging problems, empower others to thrive, lead by example, and adapt their playbook when necessary.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Privacy Program Enablement

  • Lead privacy impact assessments, regulatory analyses, and risk-based recommendations that balance compliance with business enablement

  • Conduct privacy reviews of contracts and legal engagements, drafting recommendations for counsel review, alignment, and approval

  • Apply a risk-based lens to enable business decisions

  • Provide direction and mentorship to team members and external resources as the program scales

Privacy Integration & Engineering

  • Serve as the integration point between Privacy and Product/Engineering, embedding privacy-by-design into product and software development lifecycles

  • Partner with technical teams to translate privacy requirements into practical controls, patterns, and reusable technical solutions

Data Use Governance & Decision Frameworks

  • Drive consistency in how data use decisions are evaluated, approved, and documented across the organization

Data Ethics & Responsible Data Use

  • Operationalize guardrails for use of sensitive and regulated data, AI/ML training data, and advanced analytics

  • Embed ethical considerations into governance processes and decision-making

Commercial & Clinical Data Ecosystem Governance

  • Govern data flows and usage across marketing/advertising technologies, commercial partnerships, and third-party data sharing

  • Serve as the embedded privacy partner for Medical Affairs and Clinical Operations, advising on privacy requirements for clinical research protocols, clinical trials, real-world evidence studies, and secondary use of clinical data

  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations to ensure data flows and consent frameworks align with applicable regulations (HIPAA, IRB requirements, GCP guidelines) and internal governance standards

  • Strong ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across functions

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or managing privacy professionals or cross-functional teams

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

jobs.excerpt: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims.
jobs.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

About the role

We are seeking highly organized and customer-focused Rideshare Bodily Injury Adjuster to join our team. In this role, you will manage bodily injury claims arising from incidents involving vehicles operating on rideshare platforms. You’ll serve as the main point of contact for injured parties, policyholders, attorneys, medical providers, and other stakeholders—working to deliver timely, fair, and compliant claim resolutions.

You’ll assess liability, evaluate medical treatment and injury severity, review documentation, and negotiate settlements across a variety of bodily injury exposures. These claims often involve layered insurance structures specific to rideshare operations. Strong communication, attention to detail, and negotiation skills are key.

You will also work closely with our internal product and engineering teams to share insights that drive process improvements and technology enhancements across the claims journey.

What you'll do

  • Provide prompt, courteous and high-quality customer service to all policyholders and claimants by answering customer calls, filing claims, and resolving customer requests
  • Manage an inventory of litigated and non-litigated cases
  • Analyze and review auto insurance claims to identify areas of dispute, investigating and gathering all necessary information and documentation related to the claim, evaluating liability and damages related to the claim, and negotiating and settling claims with opposing parties or their insurance providers
  • Ensure compliance with specific state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures
  • Manage both non-litigation and litigation cases related to auto claims disputes, communicate with involved parties, attending mediations, arbitrations, and court hearings as necessary, and communicating regularly with clients, claims adjusters, attorneys, and other stakeholders
  • Collaborate with defense counsel, claims counsel, and litigation claims management for strategic planning, including developing and maintaining positive working relationships with approved defense firms and other vendors in the industry
  • Review legal documents and ensuring compliance with initial suit-handling plan of action
  • Serve as corporate representative for discovery review and depositions, and appearing as Corporate Representative at depositions and trials when needed
  • Analyze policy language and reaching appropriate coverage decisions, drafting coverage correspondence, and proactively managing non-litigated and litigated claim files from inception to closure
  • Direct and control the activities and costs of outside vendors including defense counsel and coverage counsel, experts and independent adjusters
  • Maintain adjuster licenses and continuing education requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)
  • Experience with Ride Share (or TNC/Livery) is required.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience on point and concentrated in rideshare claims adjusting, ideally with:
    • commercial auto exposures
    • Both attorney-represented and unrepresented claims
    • Third-party bodily injury, including catastrophic losses
    • UM/UIM bodily injury
    • Litigation experience
    • PIP a plus, but not required
  • Knowledge of state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures.
  • Willingness to travel for clients and claims need
  • Active adjuster license required: resident state license if available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license and be willing to obtain all licenses within 60 days, including completing state-required testing.

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house.   • Take ownership of architectural and design decisions for billing system components.
  • Lead technical discussions, participate in code reviews, and drive best practices in maintainability and performance.
  • Mentor and support the growth of junior team members, including coaching on effective and safe use of AI development tools.
  • Lead improvements to CI/CD pipelines and development processes.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Optimize database queries and system architecture to handle growing merchant and transaction volumes.
  • Implement robust security measures to protect sensitive payment and merchant data and ensure compliance with PCI DSS standards, including when working with AI development tools.
  • Communicate project status, risks, and technical decisions effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Developers, and QA teams to ensure successful product releases.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate risks, including security risks, throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Provide feedback and resolutions to escalated support issues.
  • Research and evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve system performance and developer productivity.

  • Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to mentor others, contribute to a strong team culture, and work with others across teams to move projects forward.
