jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About The Role:

We are looking for aSenior Forward-Deployed Engineerto join our Professional Services team. This role is focused on working directly alongside developer teams in our most strategic enterprise customers to drive transformational outcomes across frontend modernization, platform migrations, and AI adoption.

In this role, you will lead complex Next.js migrations, architect high-performance applications, and build production AI solutions - all within customer environments. You'll work hands-on-keyboard alongside customer teams, whether you're migrating a legacy React application to App Router, conducting a deep-dive code audit, or deploying production agents using Vercel's eve framework and AI SDK.

Our Forward-Deployed Engineers operate with high agency and autonomy. You'll navigate ambiguous enterprise environments, assess technical debt, design migration strategies, and deliver measurable business value - all while building long-term relationships that expand our partnership with each customer.

There are two main profiles for this role: Next.js experts, and AI builders. Next.js experts work on deep customer code optimization, performance audits, AEO and SEO, and teaching customers how to build Next.js apps with AI instrumentation - such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc with Next.js and Vercel agent skills. The AI builder profile is less focused on deep Next.js experience, and more on identifying, evangelizing, and building AI applications and agentic workflows. Your job in this role will be to understand customers’ businesses, scope, design, and build AI agents, and prove their value. The two profiles are not mutually exclusive and we appreciate expertise in both.

You will report to the Global Manager of Forward Deployed Engineering. This role is remote-first with travel to customer sites expected occasionally. Travel requirements vary, but most of our engineers travel no more than 3-4 days every other month.

What You Will Do:

  1. Build production AI solutionsusing Vercel'seveframework, AI SDK, and AI Cloud infrastructure, including conversational interfaces, production agents, MCP servers, and agentic workflows that transform customer operations.
  2. Lead complex frontend migrations -modernizing legacy React, Vue, or other frameworks to Next.js, including Pages to App Router transitions, incremental adoption strategies, and large-scale codebase transformations. Automation of migrations is key to engineering efficiency.
  3. Conduct code audits and help analyze and improve website performance, analyzing customer codebases for performance bottlenecks, architectural anti-patterns, and optimization opportunities - delivering actionable roadmaps that drive measurable improvements.
  4. Architect and implement high-performance Next.js applications, leveraging App Router, Server Components, streaming, ISR, and advanced rendering strategies to meet enterprise scale and performance requirements.
  5. Embed with strategic customersto build production applications - working within their systems, understanding their constraints, and shipping TypeScript code that goes live.
  6. Drive enablement and knowledge transferthrough workshops, pair programming, and documentation - ensuring customer teams can extend and maintain solutions independently.
  7. Navigate complex enterprise environmentsby building relationships with stakeholders across engineering, product, and executive teams - translating technical capabilities into business outcomes.
  8. Contribute to our service evolutionby identifying repeatable patterns, building reusable components, and sharing implementation insights back to Product and Engineering teams.

About You:

  • 6+ years of experiencein software engineering with at least 2 years in a customer-facing technical role (consulting, solutions architecture, forward deployed engineering, or technical founder experience).
  • Experience using AI instrumentationsuch as harnesses, skills, and MCPs to build and deploy web applications, backend systems, and/or agentic workflows.
  • High agency with comfort in ambiguity -you thrive when given a problem to solve rather than a task to complete, and you can navigate complex organizations to create a plan and drive a project.
  • Exceptional communication skillswith the ability to conduct technical discovery, present to executives, mentor engineers, and build lasting customer relationships - all with a low-ego, collaborative approach.
  • Business acumento understand customer objectives, translate technical capabilities into ROI, and identify expansion opportunities throughout engagement lifecycles.
  • Willingness to traveloccasionally to customer sites for embedded work and relationship building.

Next.js-focused Candidates:

  • Expert-level TypeScript skills -You are fluent in TypeScript and have strong opinions on type safety, patterns, and tooling.
  • Deep expertise in Next.js, with a proven track record of architecting and delivering complex applications using App Router, Server Components, server-side rendering (SSR), static generation (SSG), and incremental static regeneration (ISR), and personalization.
  • Demonstrated experience leading frontend migrations -you've converted legacy applications to Next.js, navigated incremental adoption strategies, and understand the challenges of migrating large codebases in production environments.
  • Mastery of Reactand its ecosystem, including advanced state management, performance optimization, and modern patterns like streaming, suspense, and concurrent features.

AI-focused Candidates:

  • Production experience with LLMs and AI applications, including agent development, cloud sandbox & filesystem agent patterns, human-in-the-loop patterns, and value optimization. Familiarity with Vercel's eve framework and AI SDK is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to identify business cases for AI agents- many customers need guidance not only on how to build AI agents, but where and why to use AI. You’ll need to listen and understand a day-in-the-life of customers’ teams to build proposals.

Bonus if you:

  • Have led enterprise AI transformation initiatives, including building production agents that automated manual processes or replaced legacy systems.
  • Have taught others how to develop software using AI, best practices for building agents, harnesses, skills, and MCPs.
  • Have led large-scale migrations from legacy frameworks (Create React App, Gatsby, custom webpack setups) to Next.js in enterprise environments.
  • Have expertise in performance optimization and Core Web Vitals, with experience diagnosing and fixing LCP, CLS, and INP issues at scale.
  • Have contributed to the Next.js, React, or AI SDK open-source projects, or maintain popular related libraries.
  • Have experience with enterprise deployment patterns including security reviews, compliance requirements, and multi-region architectures.
  • Have a background in financial services, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, or media - industries with complex frontend ecosystems and growing AI adoption.
  • Have spoken at conferences or published thought leadership on frontend architecture, migrations, or AI applications.

Benefits:

  • Great compensation package and stock options.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off - Flexible vacation policy with a recommended 4-weeks per year, and paid holidays.
  • Remote Friendly - Work with teammates from different time zones across the globe.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

Disclosures:

  • Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data.
  • Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a Senior Test Lead to support Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) programs through hands-on automated testing, test strategy, team coaching, and stakeholder alignment.

Our client is a technology integrator that supports government customers with IT modernization, performance engineering, and cybersecurity. Its engineering teams collaborate on complex technical programs in a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and professional development.

What will you do

The Senior Test Lead is a player/coach who spends 50–70% of their time hands-on with the team building, executing, and debugging automated tests, and the remaining time setting strategy, coaching, and driving stakeholder alignment. The role leads delivery across the Tricentis Quality Engineering platform: Tosca, qTest (Manager/Insights/Launch), Elastic Execution Grid (EEG/DEX), NeoLoad, and LiveCompare, fully integrated into CI/CD for Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency programs.

The role requires a senior testing professional capable of operating independently with government stakeholders, managing complex testing cycles, and ensuring delivery quality across mission-critical systems.

This is a key-person position on the contract and requires a highly experienced testing professional capable of operating independently with senior customer and program stakeholders.

The position may be performed remotely but requires the ability to participate in periodic customer and program meetings in the Quantico, VA or Annapolis, MD area, as required.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Hands-On Test Design & Automation

  • Build and maintain release-ready automated suites; ensure CI/CD quality gates backed by qTest traceability.
  • Author Tosca automation across UI, API, Mobile (Engine 3.0), Vision AI, and packaged apps; implement TestCase Design and TDM.
  • Configure and optimize EEG/DEX for stable, parallel execution; resolve flaky tests and environment issues.
  • Work directly with engineers to reproduce failures, collect evidence, isolate defects, and recommend release readiness.
  • Identify automation opportunities based on risk, complexity, and mission needs.
  • Serve as escalation point for complex testing and automation problems.

Test Architecture & Quality Management

  • Architect Tosca modules, reusable assets, naming standards, and automation frameworks.
  • Govern qTest structures (plans, cycles, traceability, execution, and reporting) and ensure data accurately reflects priorities and readiness.
  • Maintain requirement-to-test traceability; ensure test assets match current program releases.
  • Use qTest Insights analytics to communicate quality, coverage, and execution trends.

CI/CD Integration & Quality Gates

  • Build executable quality gates in Jenkins, GitLab, or Azure DevOps; trigger Tosca suites through qTest Launch.
  • Define gating criteria supporting continuous integration and deployment.
  • Integrate NeoLoad performance checks and LiveCompare change-impact analysis where appropriate.
  • Review and approve automation designs for scalability, maintainability, and alignment with mission workflows.
  • Oversee smoke, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated execution.

Planning & Schedule Alignment

  • Lead and participate in test cycles (smoke, integration, regression, end-to-end, API, mobile, performance).
  • Define entry/exit criteria, environments, data, and readiness checks.
  • Provide testing inputs to the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), including durations, dependencies, resource needs, and critical-path impacts.
  • Coordinate testing across development, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and government teams.
  • Identify schedule risks related to defects, environments, automation readiness, or scope changes.

Defect Triage & Release Readiness

  • Run daily defect triage; reproduce issues, attach evidence (logs, artifacts, screenshots), and drive prioritization and escalation.
  • Manage defect lifecycle, root-cause analysis, and aging trends.
  • Set quality thresholds for release gates; advise on release readiness and risk acceptance.

Coaching & Team Development

  • Coach testers on model-based design, test data strategies, and CI/CD integration.
  • Review automation for maintainability and risk-based coverage; improve practices through patterns and code reviews.
  • Mentor testers on Tricentis tools and quality engineering.

Customer Engagement & Reporting

  • Serve as senior point of contact for Tricentis testing with DCSA and contractor partners.
  • Participate in readiness sessions, technical reviews, and program leadership briefings.
  • Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Build effective relationships across development, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, DevSecOps, and program management.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Active Secret clearance (required).
  • U.S. citizenship required due to federal access requirements.
  • 8+ years of software testing, automation, or quality engineering experience.
  • 5+ years hands-on Tricentis Tosca experience.
  • Experience supporting federal systems, ideally DCSA, NBIS, or NI2 mission environments.
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD or DevSecOps workflows.
  • Strong foundation in SDLC, Agile, DevOps, and DevSecOps.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical testing teams.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Tricentis Tosca and/or qTest certifications.
  • Hands-on experience with Tosca API Testing, DEX, TestCase Design.
  • Experience with Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Git/GitLab.

jobs.excerpt: Werden Sie selbstständiger Überführungsfahrermit DriiveMe PartnerErhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.
jobs.description:
Werden Sie selbstständiger Überführungsfahrermit DriiveMe Partner

Erhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.

👉Registrieren Sie sich hier, um auf die Aufträge zuzugreifen:

DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.

Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe, um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar und viele weitere.

In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.

Worin besteht ein DriiveMe-Auftrag?

Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

  1. Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

  2. Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

  3. Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

  4. Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

  5. Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

  6. Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

  • Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

  • Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

  • Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

  • Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

  • Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

Wie viel verdiene ich?

Ihr Umsatz hängt davon ab, wie viele Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

Jeder Auftrag hat eine eigene Vergütung, die sich nach der Strecke, der Anzahl der Kilometer und der Komplexität des Transports richtet.

Bevor Sie einen Auftrag buchen, kennen Sie alle wichtigen Informationen: Abholort, Zielort, Vergütung und Bedingungen. Sie entscheiden frei, welche Aufträge Sie annehmen möchten.

Gesuchtes Profil

Um DriiveMe Partner beizutreten, sollten Sie idealerweise:

  • über eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis verfügen;

  • selbstständig sein oder bereit sein, selbstständig tätig zu werden;

  • zuverlässig, pünktlich und sorgfältig sein;

  • die Verfahren zur Abholung und Übergabe der Fahrzeuge einhalten;

  • verfügbar sein, um gelegentliche Aufträge in Ihrer Region oder in anderen Teilen Deutschlands durchzuführen.

Jetzt registrieren

Die Registrierung der Fahrer erfolgt zentral über die offizielle DriiveMe-Seite.

jobs.description:
About LOVB (League One Volleyball):
League One Volleyball (LOVB) is reimagining women's sports. Launched in 2019, our company is a mission-led sports performance, training and media enterprise that will change the game of volleyball in the USA and empower new generations of female athletes.

It is a groundbreaking time for volleyball in the US with our historic triple Olympic Gold medals in Women's Indoor, Beach and Sitting Volleyball. Volleyball is already the #1 most played girls' youth sport. There are 38M current and former players today. Of major sports, it's the only one that is women-first (~90% of players are female). But the volleyball market has been almost entirely missed by traditional sports investors, brands, and media.

LOVB is capturing this opportunity by creating a strong club business, and from that built-in audience and fandom, is creating the best Pro League in the world and a digital ecosystem that will connect all aspects of LOVB. This community-up approach will drive participation and fandom, while enabling greater empowerment for girls and young women living this amazing sport. In this role, you will join a mission-driven, roll-up-your-sleeves team of innovators and builders who have come together to change the paradigm of professional volleyball and women’s sports.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Title: Youth - Social Media Intern

Department Code & Name: 203 - Marketing - Club

FLSA Status: Nonexempt

Location: Remote (U.S.-based) with occasional travel for site visits and business-related events
Job Level & Type:Individual Contributor

Job Summary:

The LOVBYouth Social Media Intern supports day-to-day content creation, publishing, and community engagement across LOVB's Youth social channels, including @lovbclubs and @lovbtournaments. You will help bring club, athlete, tournament, and community stories to life through engaging, on-brand social content that reflects the energy and culture of youth volleyball.

Working closely with the Social Media Specialist, Youth, you will help ideate, create, edit, schedule, and publish content across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. In a remote setting, you will transform photos and videos submitted by clubs, athletes, and events into polished social content. During select tournaments and activations, you will capture and edit content in realtime and help showcase the athlete, club, and fan experience. This role is well-suited for a creative and organized emerging marketer who understands social media and is plugged into youth and club volleyball culture.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Content Creation & Publishing

  • Support day-to-day content creation and publishing across LOVBYouth social channels, including Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.
    ● Ideate and produce social content that amplifies club, athlete, tournament, and community stories under the direction of the Youth Social Media team.
  • Transform photos and videos submitted by clubs, athletes, and events into polished, on-brand social content.
  • Capture and edit photo and short-form video content using mobile and desktop editing tools, including Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, and Canva.
  • Write engaging social media captions using established LOVBbrand voice, messaging, and content guidelines.
  • Schedule and publish approved content according to established social calendars, priorities, and processes.

Live Event Coverage

  • Support social content collection and publishing during select youth volleyball tournaments, club events, and other LOVB activations.
  • Capture timely photo and video content that showcases athletes, clubs, competition, fans, and the broader event experience.
  • Edit and prepare social content in realtime using mobile or desktop tools to support timely event coverage.
  • Coordinate with Youth Marketing and event partners to understand content priorities and ensure appropriate coverage of assigned moments.

Community Engagement & Trends

  • Monitor and respond to comments, messages, and community engagement across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook using established guidelines and escalation processes.
  • Track emerging social media trends, platform features, youth volleyball conversations, and relevant cultural moments to contribute content ideas.
  • Identify and share compelling club, athlete, and community stories that could be amplified through LOVBYouth channels.
  • Gather basic social performance information and observations to help the Youth Social Media team understand content performance and audience engagement.

Required & Preferred Skills/Abilities:

  • Strong working knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, including current content formats and platform conventions.
  • Experience capturing and editing engaging photo and video content.
  • Experience creating short-form social video using tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro and CapCut.
  • Experience with light graphic design and photo editing using Canva, Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, or similar tools.
  • Strong writing skills with the ability to develop concise and engaging social media captions.
    ● Strong understanding of youth and club volleyball culture and the types of content that resonate with athletes, families, clubs, and fans.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify social trends and translate them into relevant content ideas.
    ● Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing content, assets, schedules, and deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while seeking feedback and direction when appropriate.
    ● Familiarity with Google Workspace, including Docs, Sheets, and Slides.
  • Experience building an engaged TikTok audience and creating compelling, repeat-viewing short-form content is strongly preferred.

Education and Experience:

  • Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from an undergraduate program in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media,Journalism, Sports Management, or a related field preferred.
    ● Previous internship, academic,freelance, volunteer, or professional experience creating social media contentis preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience creating and editing short-form photo and video content for social platforms.
  • Knowledge of or experience within youth, club, or collegiate volleyball is strongly preferred.
    ● Application must include a Gondola account link or social media portfolio demonstrating relevant content creation experience.

Personal Attributes

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with shifting priorities.
  • Solutions-oriented and able to identify when to escalate issues or challenges.
  • Strong collaborator with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Capable of working independently while effectively partnering with a distributed, remote team.
  • Positive, proactive, organized, and creative - brings fresh ideas to problem-solving.
    ● Highly adaptable and eager to learn in a rapidly evolving environment.
  • Curious about social media, youth culture, and emerging content trends.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and applying it quickly to creative work.
  • Brings a community-first mindset to storytelling and represents athletes, clubs, and families thoughtfully and authentically.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements (Remote):

  • Ability to operate a computer and use a keyboard, mouse, mobile device, camera equipment, and video conferencing tools.
  • Ability to clearly communicate via video, phone, and written channels.
  • Occasional travel is required January-July for tournaments, events, and activations.

Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest-to-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community.

For more information, visit .

The Opportunity

The Manager, DevOps is a hands-on leader who sets direction, builds durable processes, and develops the team that keeps our cloud platforms reliable, secure, and cost-efficient. You will manage and grow the team while staying close to the technology, and you will be measured on the systems you put in place: how we plan, how we release, how we observe our environments, and how the team executes. The ideal candidate has built high-functioning DevOps practices before and knows how to bring structure and accountability to a team without slowing it down.

What You Will Do

  1. Own the DevOps roadmap and delivery commitments across all Supplier.io environments, serving as the single point of accountability for DevOps direction and priorities.
  1. Manage, coach, and develop the DevOps team and own hiring for the team as it grows, including defining roles, interviewing, and onboarding.
  1. Establish and enforce core operational processes, including change management, release management, environment promotion standards, incident response and postmortems, on-call coverage, and documentation and runbook standards.
  1. Bring legacy, undocumented infrastructure under version control and documentation, and own disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including defined recovery time and recovery point objectives for our critical systems.
  1. Bring planning discipline to the function, including sprint planning, estimation, and clear delivery commitments.
  1. Define and drive the observability strategy, delivering centralized visibility across all environments with clear standards for monitoring, logging, alerting, and APM, and owning the related tooling decisions.
  1. Own the cloud cost optimization program, including committed-use discounts, right-sizing of compute and databases, and reduction of logging and storage costs.
  1. Drive security and compliance hygiene in partnership with the security function, including least-privilege access, access reviews, key rotation, certificate automation, and vulnerability remediation.
  1. Stay hands-on: build and review CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and Kubernetes workloads alongside the team, and lead by example on technical standards.
  1. Partner directly with Data Engineering to own the infrastructure and tooling that keeps their pipelines running: Snowflake account and warehouse administration, Airflow orchestration infrastructure, and secrets and connection management for data pipelines.
  1. Coordinate with the STAC on infrastructure decisions, such as cloud architecture, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tooling, that affect the broader platform, so infrastructure choices stay aligned with company-wide architecture standards.
  1. Participate in the on-call rotation alongside the team, especially early on, to stay close to the systems and set the standard for response quality.
  1. Build a culture of automation, accountability, and continuous improvement across the DevOps team and the broader engineering organization.
  1. Partner with software development, data engineering, AI, and platform teams to keep environments consistent and delivery fast, safe, and reliable.
  1. Evaluate emerging tools and practices, and make pragmatic decisions about what to build, buy, and adopt.

What You will Need to Succeed:

  1. 10+ years in DevOps, cloud engineering, or infrastructure roles with progressive responsibility, including 3+ years leading or managing engineers with hiring, coaching, and performance responsibility.
  1. A track record of building processes that stick: change and release management, incident response, planning and estimation practices, and documentation standards in a growing organization.
  1. Experience bringing legacy or undocumented infrastructure under management, including introducing Infrastructure as Code and disaster recovery planning where neither existed before.
  1. Strong hands-on proficiency with CI/CD platforms (Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jenkins, or similar), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm), and containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  1. Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform. AWS and Azure experience is beneficial.

jobs.excerpt: Help make the world more hospitable The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it.
jobs.description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

As Associate General Counsel, Product & Regulatory, you'll own how legal and regulatory judgement shows up inside Mews' product and fintech work, leading a specialist pod of counsel and paralegals and reporting to the Chief Legal Officer. Mews builds tightly integrated SaaS and fintech products, and the hard questions (money transmission, e-money, embedded finance, partner-bank and BaaS models, cross-border operating decisions) need someone who helps product teams work through them in practice, not from a distance. This is a chance to set the bar for how a scaling hospitality-fintech platform builds regulated products responsibly and at pace.

You'll be embedded with Product and Engineering as a genuine product counsel and builder, surfacing and triaging legal and regulatory issues across the design and release lifecycle rather than reviewing work once it's done. You'll own the Product & Regulatory legal remit end to end: setting priorities and the quality bar, deciding what the pod handles directly, what gets standardised, and what gets escalated, and building and managing an appropriately sized team as the work grows. You'll act as the senior legal point person for product-related regulatory matters across the business.

Mews operates in regulated environments, which means product decisions carry real legal and regulatory weight, from AML, BSA, KYC and KYB obligations through to supervisory expectations, audits and market entry. The teams building these products need legal support that moves at their pace and helps them make sound decisions early, with repeatable operating discipline around them. Getting this right is what lets Mews scale regulated and non-regulated products confidently.

What you would do

  • Own the Product & Regulatory legal remit across Mews' SaaS and fintech environment, setting priorities, operating norms and the quality bar for legal support to Product and Engineering.
  • Embed with Product and Engineering as a hands-on product counsel, surfacing legal, regulatory and commercial trade-offs early and resolving them pragmatically across the release lifecycle.
  • Provide senior legal guidance on regulated product design, launch and scaling, including payments, embedded finance, money transmission, partner-bank and BaaS models, and cross-border propositions.
  • Build and manage a small specialist pod of counsel and paralegals, coaching them into strong product partners and building the playbooks, templates and working norms that let teams move faster without adding risk.
  • Use AI to reshape how legal support is delivered into product development, improving speed, quality and consistency across the pod.

AI Fluency Level 3: in this role that means going beyond using AI for your own drafting and analysis. You'll redesign how the pod delivers legal support to product, using AI across intake, issue-spotting, comparison and first-draft playbooks; build approaches the rest of the team can follow, including prompt quality and review discipline; and apply strong legal judgement about when AI output is incomplete, unreliable or too risky to rely on without deeper review.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to "AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates" on Confluence.

What you would bring

  • Significant in-house legal experience in technology, SaaS or fintech, with strong evidence of working closely with product teams rather than reviewing their work after the fact.
  • Strong fintech and regulatory exposure, ideally in payments, embedded finance or money transmission, including releasing regulated products and handling partner-bank or BaaS models.
  • Working knowledge of financial-crime regulation (AML, BSA, KYC, KYB) applied to product and operational decisions, plus experience with supervisory expectations, audits, investigations or regulatory change.
  • A hands-on builder mentality with clear examples of processes, guidance or tooling you've created, and sound commercial judgement that balances legal risk with business outcomes rather than defaulting to "no."
  • People-leadership experience, ideally managing lawyers and/or paralegals, and AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands-on experience using AI in day-to-day legal work.

Nice to have

  • Experience acting as true product counsel rather than purely commercial counsel.
  • Experience in earlier-stage or scaling environments rather than highly siloed large-enterprise settings.
  • Experience leading a regional or specialist legal team while staying close to product and business execution.

Location: US, UK or EU considered

jobs.title: Chef d’équipe, Soutien à la clientèle | Customer Support Lead
jobs.excerpt: À PROPOS DE CARRUSCarrus conçoit le logiciel de gestion sur lequel les distributeurs de pièces automobiles, les grossistes et les ateliers de réparation de l’Est du Canada s’appuient pour gérer leurs activités — des catalogues électroniques de pièces et de la tarification à l’inventaire, à la facturation et à la comptabilité.
jobs.description:
À PROPOS DE CARRUS

Carrus conçoit le logiciel de gestion sur lequel les distributeurs de pièces automobiles, les grossistes et les ateliers de réparation de l’Est du Canada s’appuient pour gérer leurs activités — des catalogues électroniques de pièces et de la tarification à l’inventaire, à la facturation et à la comptabilité. Depuis 2002, Carrus sert le marché secondaire de l’automobile avec un logiciel sur lequel ses clients comptent chaque jour au comptoir.

Carrus est un excellent milieu de travail si vous souhaitez avoir une réelle autonomie sur le fonctionnement d’une équipe et un travail dont les clients ressentent l’impact le jour même. Carrus fait partie de l’écosystème de Valsoft, qui regroupe plus de 150 entreprises de logiciels verticaux, ce qui vous offre la stabilité et les ressources de l’une des entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, dans l’ambiance d’une équipe ciblée et tissée serré.

LE POSTE

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un ou d’une chef d’équipe bilingue, Soutien à la clientèle, pour diriger au quotidien l’équipe de soutien de Carrus. Si vous aimez résoudre des problèmes avec les clients au téléphone, accompagner les personnes qui vous entourent et assumer la responsabilité des résultats d’une équipe, ce poste est fait pour vous.

Vous serez responsable d’améliorer de façon autonome notre système de soutien. Vous travaillerez à cerner et à mettre en œuvre des améliorations aux processus et aux flux de travail afin d’assurer la réactivité de l’équipe et la satisfaction de la clientèle, tout en étant encouragé(e) à automatiser les goulots d’étranglement sans compromettre les normes de service. Vous serez responsable de la formation et du mentorat d’une équipe de service à la clientèle, en l’aidant à améliorer et à prioriser les files d’attente et les flux de travail pour un rendement optimal. Vous apprendrez notre pile technologique et bâtirez des relations avec la clientèle, en étant en mesure de traiter et de résoudre de façon autonome les problèmes et les escalades des clients.

Vous relèverez du directeur, Produit et Soutien, et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Développement et Intégration des clients. Vous prendrez en charge les revues quotidiennes de la file d’attente et le suivi des indicateurs de performance clés (IPC) de l’équipe, puis bâtirez le guide de soutien à partir de là : la base de connaissances, les guides d’exploitation, les modèles de réponse ainsi que les flux de travail et les ententes de niveau de service (SLA) dans Jira qui permettent de faire avancer la file d’attente.

Vous vous épanouirez dans ce rôle si vous restez calme sous pression, prêchez par l’exemple et préférez régler la cause profonde d’un problème plutôt que de résoudre deux fois le même billet. Vous serez évalué(e) selon des indicateurs quantifiables sur lesquels vous avez une influence directe : l’arriéré de billets, le délai moyen de résolution, la satisfaction de la clientèle et les délais de réponse.

CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

  • Élaborer et améliorer continuellement les processus et les flux de travail de l’organisation en matière de gestion des billets de soutien, de la collecte et du suivi des données clés pour les IPC jusqu’à l’élaboration de guides d’automatisation.
  • Accompagner et encadrer une équipe d’agents de soutien sur les pratiques exemplaires afin d’augmenter les taux de résolution des billets et la satisfaction de la clientèle.
  • Diriger l’équipe au quotidien — assurer la couverture pendant les heures d’ouverture, animer les rencontres quotidiennes et les rencontres individuelles, et établir et incarner la norme en matière de résolution rapide et rigoureuse.
  • Prendre en charge une partie de la file de billets, particulièrement les problèmes hautement prioritaires — répondre aux appels et aux demandes entrants en français et en anglais.
  • Trier et prioriser la file d’attente avec l’équipe de soutien afin que les problèmes urgents soient réglés en premier, et maintenir l’arriéré et les délais de réponse dans les cibles convenues.
  • Faire remonter les bogues aux équipes Produit et Développement avec des détails clairs et reproductibles, et en assurer le suivi jusqu’à leur résolution.
  • Diriger les communications avec la clientèle lors de pannes, de versions problématiques ou d’autres escalades, et mener le suivi par la suite ou veiller à ce que l’équipe en assume la responsabilité de façon appropriée.
  • Élaborer, en collaboration avec les développeurs et les responsables de produit, la base de connaissances, et créer et tenir à jour les guides d’exploitation internes et les modèles de réponse.
  • Assumer la configuration de Jira Service Management, y compris les catégories, les flux de travail et les SLA.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe d’Intégration des clients pour assurer une transition fluide vers le soutien pour chaque nouveau client.
  • Faire le suivi du rendement de l’équipe et des principaux facteurs du volume de billets, et en rendre compte au directeur général.
  • Traiter les problèmes de soutien impliquant des clients par l’intermédiaire de leurs partenaires informatiques et des fournisseurs technologiques de Carrus.

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

  • 3 ans et plus d’expérience en soutien de logiciels B2B, dont au moins 2 ans à diriger ou à superviser officiellement une équipe de soutien.
  • Un historique d’améliorations mesurables, comme la réduction de l’arriéré, l’augmentation de la satisfaction de la clientèle (CSAT) ou la diminution des billets récurrents.
  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.
  • Expérience dans un environnement de soutien téléphonique ou de centre d’appels, en soutien de logiciels essentiels aux activités comme des systèmes ERP, de point de vente (PDV), de gestion des stocks ou de gestion de concessionnaires ou d’ateliers.
  • Solides compétences pratiques en dépannage touchant les installations, les environnements hébergés, les autorisations des utilisateurs, le matériel de point de vente et les imprimantes, ainsi que les notions de base en réseautique.
  • Expérience de la configuration et de la gestion d’une plateforme de billetterie comme Jira Service Management, Zendesk ou Freshdesk.
  • Communication calme et claire, tant avec le personnel de comptoir mécontent qu’avec les propriétaires d’entreprise.
  • Autonomie et capacité à diriger efficacement une équipe en télétravail.

Atouts

  • Expérience dans le marché secondaire de l’automobile, par exemple dans la distribution de pièces, chez un distributeur-entrepositaire ou chez un fournisseur de systèmes de gestion d’ateliers (JMS).
  • Connaissance des intégrations avec les fournisseurs, de l’EDI et des données de catalogues électroniques de pièces.
  • Connaissances de base en SQL pour enquêter sur les problèmes de données.

**** English Version Below****

ABOUT CARRUS

Carrus builds the management software that auto parts distributors, wholesalers, and repair shops across Eastern Canada run their business on — from electronic parts catalogues and pricing to inventory, invoicing, and accounting. Since 2002, Carrus has served the automotive aftermarket with software its customers rely on at the counter every day.

You’ll find Carrus a great place to work if you want real ownership over how a team runs and work whose impact customers feel the same day. Carrus is part of Valsoft’s ecosystem of 150+ vertical software companies, giving you the stability and resources of one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies with the feel of a focused, close-knit team.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a bilingual Customer Support Lead to run Carrus’s support team day to day. If you enjoy solving problems with customers over the phone, coaching the people around you, and owning the results of a team, this is the right role for you.

You’ll be responsible for autonomously improving upon our support system. You’ll work on identifying and implementing processes and workflow improvements to ensure team responsiveness and customer satisfaction, while also being encouraged to automate bottlenecks while maintaining service standards. You’ll be responsible for training and mentoring a customer service team, helping them improve and prioritize queues and workflows for seamless performance. You’ll learn our technology stack and build customer relations, being able to handle and resolve customer issues and escalations autonomously as well.

You’ll report to the Director of Product and Support and work closely with Product, Development, and Onboarding. You’ll take over the team’s daily queue reviews and KPI routines and build the support playbook from there: the knowledge base, runbooks, response templates, and the Jira workflows and SLAs that keep the queue moving.

You’ll thrive in this role if you stay calm under pressure, lead by example, and would rather fix the root cause than solve the same ticket twice. You’ll be measured on quantifiable metrics in your control: ticket backlog, average resolution time, customer satisfaction and response times.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Develop and continuously improve the organization’s processes and workflows on managing support tickets, from collecting and tracking key data for KPIs, to the development of automation playbooks.
  • Coach and mentor a team of support agents on best practices to increase ticket resolution rates and increase customer satisfaction.
  • Lead the team day to day — ensure coverage during business hours, run daily huddles and one-on-ones, and set and model the standard for prompt, thorough resolution.
  • Carry a share of the ticket queue, particularly on high-priority issues — take inbound calls and requests in French and English.
  • Triage and prioritize the queue alongside the support team so urgent issues are resolved first and keep backlog and response times within agreed targets.
  • Escalate bugs to Product and Development with clear, reproducible detail, and follow them through to resolution.
  • Lead customer communication during outages, problem releases, or other escalations, and run the follow-up afterward or ensure appropriate ownership and accountability from the team.
  • Co-develop the knowledge base alongside developers and product owners, and build and maintain internal runbooks and response templates.
  • Own the configuration of Jira Service Management, including categories, workflows, and SLAs.
  • Partner with Onboarding on a clean handoff to support for every new customer.
  • Track and report team performance and the top drivers of ticket volume to the General Manager.
  • Handle support-related issues involving customers through their IT partners and through Carrus’s technology vendors.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 3+ years in B2B software support, including at least 2 years formally leading or supervising a support team.
  • A track record of measurable improvement, such as reducing backlog, raising CSAT, or cutting repeat tickets.
  • Fluent in French and English, written and spoken.
  • Experience in a phone-based or call-centre support environment, supporting business-critical software such as ERP, POS, inventory, or dealer/shop management systems.
  • Strong hands-on troubleshooting across installs, hosted environments, user permissions, POS hardware and printers, and basic networking.
  • Experience configuring and running a ticketing platform such as Jira Service Management, Zendesk, or Freshdesk.
  • Calm, clear communication with both frustrated counter staff and business owners.
  • Self-motivated and able to lead a team effectively in a remote environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience in the automotive aftermarket, such as parts distribution, a warehouse distributor, or a JMS vendor.
  • Familiarity with supplier integrations, EDI, and electronic parts catalogue data.
  • Basic SQL for investigating data issues.

Job Description

The Opportunity:


In this position, the Sponsored Research Contract Administrator will manage pre and post award activities for an assigned portfolio of contracts within the Office of Sponsored Research unit using knowledge of contract management rules and regulations, financial budget management, technical expertise, and analytical skills, including guidance on what issues may present a compliance liability to the university. Serve as a liaison among university administration, principal investigators, faculty, staff, and funding agency representatives. Responsible for providing guidance to principal investigators regarding federal and non-federal contract administration, including but not limited to adherence to FAR, DFAR, Part 2 CFR 200 of the Uniform Guidance and other government regulations including applicable policies, procedures, rules and regulations of the university and sponsoring agency. Responsible for monitoring and reporting on budget management of contracts awarded to the university. Responsible for recording and maintaining sponsored projects information in the university systems.


This position is eligible for hybrid/remote work.


About us

For over 100 years, Embry-Riddle has been the world's leading aviation and aerospace university, educating more than 30,000 students across residential campuses in Daytona Beach, Florida, and Prescott, Arizona, as well as through a global network of Worldwide locations and online programs. With more than 165,000 alumni around the world, our impact reaches every corner of the aerospace, aviation, defense and technology industries.

Today, our faculty, researchers and professional staff are advancing innovation across aviation, space, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, autonomous systems and next-generation engineering. Working alongside industry leaders, government agencies and innovators, they are solving real-world challenges and shaping the technologies that will define tomorrow.

Whether you are an educator, researcher, administrator, technologist or industry professional, your work at Embry-Riddle will contribute to something bigger than a job. Join a community driven by discovery, purpose and excellence—and help shape the future of aerospace.

  • Generous Time Off: Enjoy up to 18 days of paid leave in your first year, including 3 days granted upon hire and 15 days accrued throughout the year. You'll also receive 9+ paid holidays, including the day after Thanksgiving and the week between Christmas Eve and New Year's Day.
  • Tuition Coverage: Get 100% tuition coverage for yourself for one undergraduate and one graduate degree, and discounted rates for your spouse and dependent children up to age 26.
  • Retirement Contributions: ERAU contributes 6% of your base salary to your retirement plan and offers a 4% matching contribution – with no vesting period.
  • Personal Leave: Relax with 15 days of personal leave for non-exempt employees or 18 days for exempt full-time employees in your first year.

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is up to $62,000. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience, as well as applicable state regulations, internal equity, and business needs, and may fall outside of the stated range.

Qualifications

Required Education and Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field with 3-5 years of related experience.
  • CRA and/or Contract Certification(s) and master’s degree a plus.
  • In lieu of a bachelor’s degree, 5-10 years of experience in contracts, grants, or financial management will be considered.
  • Experience with sponsors who support aeronautical research (FAA, DoD, USAF, USSF, NASA etc.) a plus.
  • Excellent attention to detail, outstanding customer service and strong communication skills are required for this position.
  • Pre-award Contract management experience or demonstrated experience with managing multi-part contract proposals, technical documents, and budgets.
  • Post-award Contract management experience or demonstrated experience with managing multi-part contracts, technical documents, and budgets.
  • The ability to manage a high volume of work and competing deadlines in a fast-paced, deadline-driven work environment.
  • Comfort working remotely and using tools to facilitate remote work, e.g., Teams, Zoom.
  • Comfort with business systems that hold financial and administrative information, such as Workday.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365, to include Microsoft Word, Shared Drives, OneDrive, and Excel, to include use and understanding of Excel formulas.
  • Effective analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Familiarity with contracting guidelines as detailed in the FAR, DFAR, ITAR and CFR, also experience with STTR and SBIR contracts is a plus.
  • Experience working in higher education with knowledge of Sponsored Research, including the principles, methods, and procedures of contract administration and compliance.

Application process/requirements


To submit your application for this opportunity, please visit the Embry-Riddle Career Site and search for requisition number R310831. Please attach all relevant materials to your application when you apply online. Complete submissions include:

  • Cover letter
  • Full Resume
  • Contact information for at least three professional references (please note that references may be contacted as part of the interview/screening process)

Current Embry-Riddle employees: Please apply directly through the ERAU Employee Hub Central application within Workday.

Embry-Riddle does not accept unsolicited assistance from staffing or recruitment agencies. Agencies interested in partnering with the University should contact and should not contact hiring managers or other University employees directly. To preserve the integrity and authenticity of our hiring process, candidates are expected to participate without AI-assisted coaching, real-time response generation, or recording during interviews or assessments. Embry-Riddle does not use AI to automatically screen, rank, or select candidates.

jobs.description:
About Gumball Digital

Gumball Digital is a performance marketing company that builds and operates consumer-focused digital brands. Through brands like ActiveTrials, Benefinds, and Homebase, we combine proprietary technology, data, and marketing expertise to create high-performing customer acquisition platforms.

We’re intentionally small, profitable, and fast-moving. We give talented people the autonomy to own important parts of the business and make decisions that have an immediate impact.

Gumball builds consumer web experiences and the internal tools used to manage them. Our products include mobile-first acquisition funnels, dynamic forms and surveys, administrative tools, and reporting interfaces used across multiple brands.

We are hiring a Front-End Engineer to turn product requirements into clear, responsive, and reliable interfaces. You will work across customer-facing sites and internal tools, make practical design decisions, and collaborate with a senior engineer who provides the backend services your work requires.

Our current front-end stack is TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, and Material UI. It is a starting point, not a fixed requirement for every future problem. You should be comfortable working in this stack while remaining flexible enough to evaluate and adopt different tools when the product’s needs justify them. Most customer traffic is mobile, so mobile behavior is a core engineering requirement.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain responsive customer-facing experiences and internal web applications.
  • Create forms, surveys, editors, dashboards, and reusable interface components that are clear to first-time users.
  • Translate written requirements, brand direction, and stakeholder feedback into finished interfaces.
  • Make thoughtful decisions about layout, typography, interaction, and responsive behavior. Collaborate with the senior engineer and stakeholders when a decision affects product behavior, shared systems, or more than one brand.
  • Work with the senior engineer to define the solution. They provide the backend services and data contracts; you integrate them into the interface and identify what the front end still needs.
  • Handle loading, success, empty, validation, and failure states instead of treating the first render as complete.
  • Build for mobile use, accessibility, browser compatibility, and maintainability.
  • Test your work as a user, document the results, and respond to feedback from quality assurance and code review.
  • Keep tickets and pull requests aligned when requirements change.
  • Support production incidents when assigned by the Engineering Lead.

What we are looking for

  • Professional experience building and shipping front-end web applications, regardless of framework.
  • Experience building responsive, mobile-first web applications.
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, component design, forms, validation, and browser behavior.
  • The ability to make sound interface decisions without requiring a finished design for every screen.
  • Experience integrating front-end applications with APIs or database-backed services.
  • A record of owning work through implementation, testing, pull-request review, and follow-up.
  • Clear written communication and the judgment to ask for input before assumptions become rework.
  • Availability during the team’s Eastern Time workday.

Helpful, not required

  • React, TypeScript, Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, or Material UI.
  • Consumer acquisition funnels, multi-step forms, survey builders, or administrative tools.
  • Complex forms, validation, data tables, drag-and-drop editors, rich text, data visualization, or conditional interfaces.
  • Front-end performance, automated testing, or accessibility work.

How the team works

You report to the Engineering Lead, who is also the senior engineer, and work closely with the Technical Project Manager and business stakeholders. The Engineering Lead partners with you on the solution and provides the backend your interface needs. You own the quality, usability, and implementation of the front end.


Salary

The pay range for this role is:

$80,000.00 - $100,000.00 USD per year (Remote (United States))

About Zūm:

Zūm is revolutionizing mass mobility with its Connected Mobility Experience (Zūm CMX™) system that connects and coordinates people, vehicles, and operations in real time. In the $50 billion student mobility market – the largest segment of the mass mobility industry – Zūm CMX is transforming a daily source of anxiety and disruption into a reliable, transparent, and efficient mobility experience for students and families. Today, more than 6,500 schools rely on Zūm CMX. Recognized globally for its innovative approach and operational execution, Zūm has been named to Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50 and Changemakers, the World Economic Forum, and the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies lists. Zūm is backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, GIC, TPG, and Softbank.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Zum provides safe, reliable, technology-enabled student transportation for school districts. We are growing quickly: new districts, new yards, and new markets launch while existing ones are still being built out. The VP of Operations runs a multi-market in the east region P&L, leads general managers and their teams, and owns the operating rhythm that keeps buses running safely and on time. This is a hands-on, start-up-mode role for someone who can build, manage the process, and still step into a yard and roll up their sleeves when needed.

OPERATING RHYTHM

  • Daily: Route coverage, dispatch, on-time performance, driver safety messages, same-day escalations

  • Weekly: KPI release and action plans, labor review, customer launch calls, payroll dashboard review, AR collections

  • Monthly: Safety themes, union dues and benefits compliance, forecast-to-actual review, liquidated damages reconciliation

  • Seasonal: Back-to-school readiness, budget planning, renewals, 45-day scaling forecast

  • As needed: Involvement in bargaining, grievances, discipline, incident investigations, service-disruption planning

START-UP MODE

  • Launch new districts and yards while running existing ones, moving people and fleet across markets as needed

  • Write and standardize SOPs, RACIs, and protocols where none exist

  • Be decisive, often with incomplete information

  • Step in directly when a manager leaves or a launch stalls

NEW CONTRACT IMPLEMENTATION

Own the handoff from Sales through Day One and stabilization:

  • Handoff: Review contracts, pricing, and commitments with Sales, Legal, and Finance

  • Plan: Name an owner and build backward from first day of service

  • Staffing and training: Size teams including spares; lead recruiting, CDL training, and background checks

  • Labor and compliance: Determine CBA coverage and set up payroll and benefits

  • Customer readiness: Launch meetings, dry runs, and written scope changes

  • Stabilize: Provide go-live support, move to steady-state KPIs, and hold a post-launch review

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Regional operations: Own on-time performance, coverage, and service quality

  • Financials: Own the regional P&L, budget, forecast accuracy, and expense control

  • Renewals and collections: Lead renewals and AR, including disputed invoices and liquidated damages

  • Escalations: Be the escalation point for district and union contract disputes, working with Legal and HR

  • HQ liaison: Connect field operations with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, HR, Legal, Safety, and Technology

  • People leadership: Lead and coach GMs and field managers, handle performance issues, and run promotion panels

  • Safety and compliance: Lead incident reviews, make documented discipline decisions, and oversee training and records

  • Labor relations: Support bargaining, grievances, arbitration, and CBA implementation

  • Customer relationships: Serve as senior operational contact for district leaders

  • Driver pipeline: Oversee hiring, spare ratios, CDL training, retention, and recognition

  • Fleet and technology: Evaluate routing vendors and support yard and equipment readiness

REQUIREMENTS

  • 10+ years in operations, including 5+ leading multi-site or multi-region teams in student transportation, logistics, or similar safety-critical field operations

  • Experience in high-growth or turnaround settings, launching sites and building process from scratch

  • Strong financial skills: budgeting, forecasting, expense control, and AR management

  • Direct union experience (CBA administration, grievances, discipline, bargaining) and skill in renewals and escalations with districts and unions

  • Command of DOT/FMCSA, CDL, and state pupil-transportation requirements

  • Public-sector contract experience, including SLAs and liquidated damages

  • Fluency with operational and workforce data, turned into weekly action

  • Strong multitasking and proactive planning; exceptional written and verbal communication

  • Willingness to travel

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

See yourself at Dataminr

As a Technical Support Engineer at Dataminr, you'll be the go-to problem-solver for our enterprise customers, digging into authentication issues, platform hiccups, and integration headaches to figure out what went wrong and how to fix it. The role covers troubleshooting SSO configurations, debugging alert delivery across email, mobile, webhook, and API channels, and working through customer-side network and environmental issues, often tracing problems back through logs and data to pin down the root cause. This is a fully remote role with a consistent shift that may fall outside standard business hours, plus participation in an on-call rotation that includes occasional weekend coverage.

AI Innovation at Dataminr

Working at Dataminr you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold.

Regenerative AI: our AI technology, ReGenAI, is a new form of generative AI that automatically regenerates real-time Live Event Briefs as events unfold. Learn more here.

Agentic AI:we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here

Multimodal AI: our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here.

The opportunity

  • Configure and deploy SSO integrations for enterprise customers across various identity provider environments, and troubleshoot authentication failures when they arise
  • Investigate and resolve login failures, platform access issues, and browser-level problems
  • Debug alert delivery failures across email, mobile, webhook, and API channels
  • Troubleshoot customer-side environmental issues including network, firewall, proxy, and DNS configurations
  • Support API troubleshooting and integration-related cases
  • Investigate logs and data to identify patterns and root causes
  • Take charge of all customer issues, including questions about product functionality, initial troubleshooting, identification of root causes, issue resolution, and communication
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success on identifying and resolving product defects
  • Be an active contributor to our knowledge base and other support documentation
  • Participation in an on-call rotation that includes occasional weekend coverage

What you bring
At Dataminr, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed.

  • 3+ years of experience in a technical support, systems engineering, or related technical role
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot independently across unfamiliar systems
  • Understanding of network infrastructure, firewalls, proxies, DNS, and how corporate IT environments affect SaaS access
  • Experience with API troubleshooting or integration support
  • Experience with bug reproduction, log review, and problem isolation in web and mobile applications, SSO, and API implementations
  • Familiarity with ticketing and productivity tools such as Salesforce, Zendesk, and Jira
  • Familiarity with tools and workflows used by security operations professionals, including SIEM platforms, threat intelligence tooling, and security-focused integrations. Our customer base is heavily security-oriented, and understanding their environment and workflows is important.
  • Familiarity with writing or reading basic queries for data lookup and log review
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts in non-technical terms
  • Experience authoring, structuring, and administering documents for training and knowledge bases
  • Experience working independently without immediate supervision, managing multiple tasks, and meeting critical SLAs and deadlines
  • Professional, reliable, and comfortable operating in a business setting

About Dataminr

At Dataminr, we are a mission driven team of talented builders, creators and visionaries who have real-world impact on how organizations are able to respond to events. Dataminr’s groundbreaking, AI-powered, intelligence platform provides organizations with the earliest signals of emerging risks, events, and threats before they unfold. Trusted by two-thirds of the Fortune 50 and half of the Fortune 100, Dataminr’s platform analyzes billions of public data inputs spanning text, image, video, audio and sensor data across 150+ languages, empowering our clients to stay one step ahead in an increasingly complex world where every second counts.

Founded in 2009, we have pioneered the world’s first real-time event detection platform, long before the recent Gen AI ‘boom.’ Dataminr operates all around the world united by our passion to use AI for the greater good, be agents of positive change and put our technology into the hands of clients charged with the responsibility to keep organizations running and keep people safe.

As our employees focus on developing our revolutionary technology, we focus on our employees. Dataminr is proud to offer a variety of flexible work arrangements, offices all over the world to foster collaboration, generous PTO and sick leave, and more, as part of our competitive benefits package aimed at keeping all our employees happy and healthy. Explore all our benefitshere.

We believe our differences give us strength. Our employees are empowered to be their best, authentic selves through various opportunities, such as our robust employee resource group (ERG) network, manager development programming, professional development funds, and more.

We serve a global community made up of many cultures and strive to reflect the world and clients we serve, with a workforce built on merit and equity. We actively condemn racism and discrimination in any form. We stand for social good, fostering a culture of allyship, and standing up for those who face systemic barriers to equality. We lead with empathy and strive to be agents of positive change in our company and in our communities.

jobs.excerpt: Über das Syntax Institut (eine Marke von Bildung für Morgen) Das Syntax Institut ist eine Marke von Bildung für Morgen und ein schnell wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen aus Berlin, das von erfolgreichen Unternehmern gegründet wurde.
jobs.description:
Über das Syntax Institut (eine Marke von Bildung für Morgen)

Das Syntax Institut ist eine Marke von Bildung für Morgen und ein schnell wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen aus Berlin, das von erfolgreichen Unternehmern gegründet wurde. Unsere Mission ist es, Menschen praxisnah für gefragte Berufe in der Tech-Branche zu qualifizieren und sie erfolgreich in den Arbeitsmarkt zu integrieren. Unser Angebot umfasst praxisnahe Weiterbildungen in den Bereichen Softwareentwicklung, IT-Administration, Cloud & IT-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Projektmanagement. Darüber hinaus bieten wir deutschlandweit an mehreren Standorten Umschulungen im Bereich Fachinformatik an. Dabei vermitteln wir aktuelle Technologien, moderne Arbeitsmethoden und die Fähigkeiten, die Unternehmen heute tatsächlich benötigen.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Als Dozent*in für SAP (FI / CO) brennst du für Controlling und Finanzwesen und steckst andere mit deiner Begeisterung an. Dabei schaffst du als Wegbegleiter*in eine wertschätzende und motivierende Lernatmosphäre auf Augenhöhe. Dein Ziel ist es, die Teilnehmenden zum Abschluss zu begleiten und das Fundament zu legen für eine erfolgreiche Integration in den Arbeitsmarkt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Leitung und Durchführung von Kursen: Du planst und leitest den Unterricht im remote Format für die Fachrichtung(en) FI und/oder CO, passend zu deinem Eignungsprofil (siehe unten).

  • Praxisnahe Vermittlung: Du übersetzt komplexe Lernziele in verständliche Lerneinheiten. Diese reicherst du mit Beispielen aus deiner eigenen IT-Praxis an.

  • Teamentwicklung: Du förderst die Zusammenarbeit sowie die Selbstorganisation in den Lerngruppen und begleitest sie mit einem starken Konflikt- und Feedback-Management. Zusätzlich entwickelst du gezielte Initiativen für leistungsschwächere Teilnehmende und arbeitest eng mit unserem Student Success Team zusammen.

  • Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Lehrmaterialien: Du erstellst praxisnahe Lernmaterialien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Produktteam. Weiterhin bist du verantwortlich für die fachliche und didaktische Qualität deines Kurses.

Qualifikation

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Schwerpunkt FI / CO: Du bist SAP zertifiziert in den Bereichen FI (Finance) und/oder CO (Controlling) und bringst mindestens 2 Jahre SAP-Projekterfahrung im jeweiligen Bereich mit. Idealerweise konntest du bereits Erfahrung mit S/4HANA- sowie Implementierung- und Customization sammeln. Von Vorteil ist es, wenn du am “Train the Trainer” (PTWTTT) teilgenommen hast und EWM Erfahrung mitbringst.

  • Sprache und Kommunikation: Deine fließenden Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Niveau) und deine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke runden dein Profil ab und ermöglichen es dir, Lerninhalte klar und motivierend zu vermitteln.

  • Vermittlung: Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, SAP verständlich auf Anwender- und perspektivisch Beraterniveau zu vermitteln.

  • Freude am Lehren und Lernen: Dich begeistert es, anderen Wissen zu vermitteln und sie aktiv beim Lernen zu unterstützen. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und erklärst komplexe Themen logisch und nachvollziehbar. Du bringst eine Affinität zur (Online-)Lehre / E-Learning und web-basierten Lernprogrammen mit.

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir

  • Ein Business mit Purpose: Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die wirtschaftlich, gesellschaftlich und sozial höchst relevant sind (Digitalisierung, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit des Wirtschaftsstandorts Deutschland, Arbeitsmarktpolitik, Gleichberechtigung, Technologie etc.)

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Als Dozent*in hast du einen großen Einfluss auf die Ausgestaltung unserer Kurse und die Entwicklung unseres Unternehmens.

  • Langzeitperspektive: Wir bieten dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und fördern deine Entwicklung. Falls du noch keinen AEVO-Schein besitzt, unterstützen wir dich bei deinem erfolgreichen Abschluss, damit du optimal für die Rolle aufgestellt bist.

  • Attraktives Package: Neben einem marktüblichen Gehalt profitierst du bei uns von einem vergünstigten Sportangebot und erhältst hochwertige Betriebsgeräte.

Wenn du glaubst, dass diese Rolle gut zu dir passt, bewirb dich gerne bei uns. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Wir freuen uns über deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit CV und optional einem kurzen Anschreiben.

ROLE OVERVIEW


As a Lead, Operations Strategy - Specialty Services Implementation, you will play an integral role in developing and implementing new service lines that improve the experience of LifeStance clinicians and patients across the country and further the mission of the organization. In this role,you will be a catalyst for change, driving growth, business process improvement, and initiatives aimed at growing LifeStance’s business offerings. As a member of the Ops Strategy - Specialty Services Team, you will leverage your expertise to lead and influence stakeholders, ensuring the seamless execution of national initiatives. You will work cross-functionally with all corporate teams, including Technology, People, Finance, Clinical Leadership & Shared Services to lead teams toward solving complex problems. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to build relationships with Operations leaders across the business to understand their needs and develop initiatives that allow them to better service patients across the geographies they lead. 


Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.


KEY RESPONSIBILITES 


  • Drive the implementation of new service lines through a combination of direct involvement, partnership with the local operating team, and influence over internal stakeholder partners (shared services, corporate support, etc.).

The Associate Director, Field Launch & Change Surge provides focused, time-bound execution capacity to support major launches and high-priority change events across the field organization. This role helps stabilize performance during peak change periods by coordinating execution mechanics, readiness actions, and rapid issue resolution—so field leaders can stay focused on customers and core performance. Working in close partnership with Field Execution Leads, enablement partners, operations teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, this role strengthens launch readiness, protects field capacity, and accelerates time-to-stability after go-live.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide surge execution support for launches, major tool/process releases, and high-impact organizational changes, ensuring clear sequencing, ownership, and follow-through.
  • Translate launch/change plans into practical field actions (readiness tasks, cutover steps, stabilization activities), ensuring clarity on who does what by when.
  • Identify cross-team dependencies and readiness risks early (training gaps, workflow breaks, operational constraints) and drive mitigation actions with owners.
  • Support cutover planning and go-live readiness, including readiness checklists, field-facing timing clarity, and escalation pathways for high-severity issues.
  • Coordinate hypercare mechanics during launch/change windows to ensure rapid triage, clear ownership, and timely resolution of field-impacting issues.
  • Drive rapid stabilization by tracking issues through to closure and ensuring recurring problems are addressed with root-cause fixes, not repeated workarounds.
  • Partner across teams to align execution details (timelines, readiness expectations, support model) and reduce last-minute churn during launch windows.
  • Maintain an integrated view of launch/change readiness signals and surface actionable watch-outs to execution leadership.
  • Capture lessons learned and convert them into improved readiness playbooks, templates, and standard operating patterns.

Essential Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required from 4-year college or university.
  • 6+ years’ of experience in field operations, launch execution, program delivery, or execution-focused roles within complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in high-intensity environments with competing priorities and tight timelines.
  • Strong execution discipline, coordination skills, and ability to translate plans into clear actions and closures.
