jobs.excerpt: Join Cognizant's Workday Student Practice in Australia and New Zealand and help universities transform how they manage the student journey, from first enquiry through to completion.
jobs.description:
Join Cognizant's Workday Student Practice in Australia and New Zealand and help universities transform how they manage the student journey, from first enquiry through to completion. As a Principal Consultant, you'll lead design and configuration across Student Records, including academic structure, enrolment, progression, completion and government reporting, and extend that expertise into Recruiting and Admissions, including prospect management, applications, Tertiary Admissions Centre processes and offers. You'll guide institutions on how Workday Student can best meet their needs and support their strategic goals, lead workstreams and mentor other consultants. This is a real opportunity to grow your career while helping shape how the sector operates.

This role suits a senior practitioner with a background in student records, student administration, admissions or student systems who wants to turn their knowledge of student lifecycle regulations and processes, and their commitment to supporting students, into a consulting career. You'll bring higher education and regulatory expertise to every engagement, working closely with student administration, admissions, future students, international and technology teams. You'll be equally comfortable in functional design sessions and integration discussions, making sure your designs align with Student Financials, Academic Advising, external systems and other areas of the Workday platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery and design sessions for academic structure, student records, enrolment, unit and course changes, progression, leave of absence, withdrawal, completion and graduation.
  • Lead Admissions design across Tertiary Admissions Centre (TAC) and direct entry channels, including the pathway and alternative entry routes used by international students, transfer and non-traditional applicants, covering application processing, assessment, offers, acceptances and deferrals.
  • Configure Student Records and Admissions business processes, rules, eligibility, holds and statuses.
  • Design the end-to-end handling of Tertiary Admissions Centre (TAC) applications, preferences, offer rounds and responses, and align and collaborate with integrations and technical teams on the full solution.
  • Work with client teams to define how regional CRMs used for student recruitment interact with Workday Student, including the hand-off of prospect and applicant data.
  • Define requirements that bridge functional design and integrations, including data mapping, triggers, timing, error handling and ownership, and work closely with integration teams through build and testing.
  • Bring an understanding of how Australian or New Zealand universities manage student records to design discussions, so Workday Student is configured for local course structures, terminology, policy settings and reporting obligations.
  • Ensure designs capture the data and processes needed for TCSI reporting, Unique Student Identifier (USI) requirements, international student obligations including PRISMS and Confirmations of Enrolment, and related compliance needs.
  • Work with Student Financials and finance stakeholders to align the financial impacts of admission, enrolment, changes, withdrawal and completion events.
  • Identify data, security, privacy, records management and reporting requirements across the student lifecycle.
  • Document requirements, design decisions and configuration.
  • Prepare and execute unit testing, support end to end and integration testing and assist with defect resolution.
  • Support data conversion of historical student records, cutover preparation, training and go live readiness.
  • Provide clear advice on Workday leading practices while recognising institutional context and policy obligations.
  • Lead workstreams, coach and review the work of other consultants, and act as a trusted advisor to client process owners.
  • Contribute reusable configuration guidance, test assets and delivery methods to the Cognizant Student Practice.

Experience we are looking for

  • Senior experience in student records, student administration, admissions, student systems or a related higher education function.
  • Understanding of academic structure, enrolment, progression, completion and graduation processes, and how they are reflected in student records.
  • Familiarity with Tertiary Admissions Centre processes, such as those run by UAC, VTAC, QTAC, SATAC or TISC, including application preferences, offer rounds and data exchange with institutions.
  • Familiarity with CRMs commonly used for student recruitment in the region, such as Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365, and how they connect to a student information system.
  • Working knowledge of TCSI reporting, including how student, course and enrolment data is captured, validated and corrected.
  • Familiarity with the regulations that relate to student records in Australia or New Zealand, such as the Higher Education Support Act, the ESOS Act and National Code, the Higher Education Standards Framework, USI requirements, privacy and state records legislation, or the Education and Training Act and Single Data Return.
  • Ability to work with requirements that bridge functional and integration design, and to communicate confidently with both business and technical teams.
  • Proven experience guiding business stakeholders through key operational and policy decisions, including presenting options, explaining trade-offs and securing agreement.
  • Experience implementing, supporting or serving as a super-user for student information systems (SIS), with Workday Student experience highly regarded.
  • Experience leading a workstream or team and mentoring other consultants or practitioners.
  • Experience facilitating workshops, documenting decisions and working across student administration, admissions, international and technology teams preferred.
  • Experience with testing, data conversion, training or deployment readiness activities preferred.

About the Cognizant Workday Student Practice

The Cognizant Workday Student Practice is focused exclusively on helping universities across Australia and New Zealand transform the way they support students, faculty and administrators throughout the student lifecycle.

What makes our practice different is the combination of higher education practitioners and Workday specialists working together. Many of our consultants have worked inside universities as academic services professionals before moving into consulting. That experience allows us to bring practical insight into the operational, regulatory and policy considerations that shape solution design.

We work with institutions to design and implement sustainable Workday Student solutions that support local regulatory requirements, align to institutional strategy and remain adaptable as university needs evolve. Our goal is not simply to deploy technology, but to help universities establish a foundation they can continue to own, operate and enhance long after implementation is complete.

Why choose Cognizant:

  • Entrepreneurial environment that welcomes your ideas
  • Opportunity to do great work
  • Outreach programs that support communities and tap into your volunteer spirit
  • Learning opportunities to help current needs and advancement
  • Global operations, with opportunities in North America, Europe and Asia Pacific
  • An abundance of Affinity groups to meet your needs

Cognizant Core Values:

  • Work as One: We think beyond roles, relying on each other’s strengths to win as a team.
  • Raise the Bar: We always aim for excellence in how we work and what we deliver.
  • Dare to Innovate: We push boundaries and take chances to reimagine what’s possible.
  • Do the Right Thing: We all lead with integrity and always make the ethical choice.
  • Own It: We own the outcomes for our company, colleagues, and community.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAs Humana continues its transformation into an AI-first enterprise, we are looking for a hands-on, technically deep Principal Product Manager to define strategy and drive delivery across a portfolio of AI products.
jobs.description:
Description

As Humana continues its transformation into an AI-first enterprise, we are looking for a hands-on, technically deep Principal Product Manager to define strategy and drive delivery across a portfolio of AI products. You will set the standard for how we build AI at Humana, and personally go deep, from understanding a business challenge, to prototyping an AI solution, to proving its value, to delivering it through Humana's enterprise AI governance process. You will lead through influence, making engineers, data scientists, designers, product managers, and business leaders more effective.

What you will own

  • Portfolio strategy and vision: Define the multi-year vision and strategy for a portfolio of AI products and capabilities. Prioritize across competing product areas and adapt the portfolio as the model landscape and the business change. Set the north-star and the long-term roadmap, and reason from first principles when the problem, opportunity, and strategy are not yet defined.
  • Business discovery at scale: Partner with business-unit and enterprise leaders to map their operations end to end. Turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into a slate of AI use cases, each with a clear business case, and sequence them into a portfolio.
  • Hands-on prototyping: Build working prototypes and demos with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex) to prove feasibility and value before a full team is committed. Stay close enough to the technology to make credible technical calls.
  • Requirements and scoping: Turn validated use cases into buildable requirements: user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics. Shape the end-to-end user experience with design, because adoption depends on usability.
  • Delivery and execution: Drive the build from prototype to production across your portfolio. Sequence the work, make scope and tradeoff calls as models and constraints shift, unblock teams, and keep momentum from first demo through launch and iteration.
  • Evaluation and quality standards: Define how quality is measured. Build golden sets, error budgets, and eval frameworks; run offline and production evals; choose the right metrics (precision, recall, task success, hallucination rate); apply LLM-as-judge where it has been validated. Turn results into launch decisions and leadership readouts.
  • Solution architecture: Partner with engineering on high-level architecture and feasibility across the portfolio, while owning the context engineering and skill-creation components of the AI harness and setting the reusable patterns others build on.
  • Cross-organizational leadership: Lead engineers, data scientists, designers, product managers, and business partners without direct authority. Influence VP-level organizations through written narratives, business cases, and executive forums. Author the playbooks, skills, and solution patterns for building AI at Humana.
  • Governed delivery: Move solutions through Humana's enterprise AI governance (AIRB, LRC, Responsible AI Council), owning the product documentation, scorecards, and stage-gate reviews, and help shape the governance standards themselves as the portfolio grows.
  • Talent and standards: Raise the bar for the whole team. Mentor senior and lead product managers, contribute to hiring and promotion assessments, and set the craft standard for building with AI across the organization.
  • Communication and influence: Communicate strategy, roadmap, requirements, ROI, and eval results clearly to executive, business, and technical audiences, and represent Humana's AI product work externally with partners, vendors, and the broader community.
  • Staying current: Track advances in models, agents, evals, and emerging techniques (agent harness, loop, and graph / GraphRAG approaches), form a defensible point of view on where they are headed, and apply them across your portfolio.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product or related experience, with AI/ML or GenAI products shipped to production. Candidates with fewer years but a strong engineering background and real fluency in AI will be considered.
  • Portfolio-level impact: A track record of setting strategy and driving delivery across multiple products or a major domain, and of leading initiatives with org-wide, executive-level visibility.
  • Hands-on building: You use AI tools regularly, prototype your own ideas, and can say specifically what you would change about a model's behavior and why. You know the trade-offs that matter: context windows, latency, cost, hallucination, and RAG versus fine-tuning.
  • Evaluation expertise: You have built evals (golden sets, ground truth, and offline and live evals) and used precision- and recall-based metrics to make product decisions, and you have set eval standards that other teams adopt.
  • Systems thinking: When you find a problem, you build the infrastructure that prevents the whole class of problem, and you make that infrastructure reusable across the organization.
  • Communication across domains: You move fluently between business and technical concepts, with a track record of business cases, ROI models, and roadmaps that inform investment decisions at the executive level.
  • AI knowledge: A deep working understanding of modern AI/ML and GenAI (LLMs, agents, RAG, prompt/harness engineering, and Evals) and how it applies to enterprise problems.
  • You work from first principles, prioritize well, and make good calls quickly with incomplete information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 12+ years of product experience, or an equivalent depth of AI-native building, in a large enterprise environment.
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry.
  • A well-supported, publicly demonstrated point of view on where agentic AI, evals, and AI-native product development are headed.
  • Hands-on experience with agent frameworks, GraphRAG / knowledge graphs, and reusable skills / plugins.
  • Experience defining a new AI product category or standing up cross-organization AI standards and playbooks.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI, bias mitigation, and compliance with sensitive data.
  • A degree in computer science or engineering, or an equivalent combination of experience.

jobs.description:
Want to be a bswifter?

At bswift we’ve been transforming benefits administration since 1996, making it simpler, smarter, and more human. Our state-of-the-art, cloud-based technology and services empower employees to understand, manage, and love their benefits. From downtown Chicago, and remotely across the country, we serve thousands of companies and millions of people nationwide, reducing administrative burdens and freeing HR teams to focus on creating thriving, people-first workplaces.

We’re looking for motivated and goal-driven individuals who share our passion for delivering excellence and creating solutions that make a difference. The reward is a fun, flexible and creative environment with ample opportunity for professional and personal growth. If you love the bswift values of pursue excellence, embrace accountability, deliver superior service, and be a great place to work, we want to hear from you!

ABOUT US

bswift is a leading benefits administration company that specializes in providing tailored solutions for our clients. Our mission is to simplify the complex world of employee benefits and deliver exceptional service to our clients. We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented GRC Analyst to join our Information Security team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The GRC Analyst is a member of the Information Security team and is responsible for supporting governance, risk, compliance, and client assurance activities. This role serves as a key partner to Sales, Client Experience, Legal, Product, and Information Security teams by responding to customer security inquiries, supporting audit and compliance efforts, and maintaining processes that support security and regulatory obligations.

The ideal candidate possesses a strong foundation in information security concepts, excellent written communication skills, and the ability to translate complex technical information into clear, concise, customer-friendly responses. This individual thrives in a deadline-driven environment, enjoys collaborating across teams, and demonstrates strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR (Essential Functions)

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Client Assurance & Security Questionnaire Management

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for client assurance requests, including security questionnaires, due diligence inquiries, RFP security sections, SOC reports, bridge letters, penetration test summaries, and other security-related documentation.
  • Review and respond to detailed client security questionnaires by interpreting requirements and providing accurate, defensible responses aligned with company policies and security practices.
  • Partner with Sales, Client Experience, Legal, Product, and Information Security teams to gather information and respond to customer security inquiries within established service-level expectations.
  • Utilize approved security questionnaire and AI-enabled response tools to draft and refine responses while ensuring accuracy, consistency, and appropriate disclosure of information.
  • Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of reusable security response content and documentation.

Risk, Compliance & Audit Support

  • Support internal and external audits, including SOC 2 and other compliance assessments, by coordinating evidence requests and assisting with control documentation.
  • Collect, organize, and maintain audit-ready evidence supporting compliance initiatives and recurring review activities.
  • Assist with governance, risk, and compliance processes designed to maintain adherence to security frameworks, internal controls, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support remediation efforts by tracking action items and partnering with stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of identified issues.

User Access Review Administration

  • Own and execute recurring User Access Reviews (UARs) for critical systems and applications.
  • Coordinate with system owners and managers to validate that user access remains appropriate and aligned with least-privilege principles.
  • Collect, maintain, and organize evidence supporting access review activities.
  • Track remediation actions resulting from access reviews and partner with business and technical stakeholders to resolve identified exceptions.

Contract Review & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Support the review and negotiation of customer security addenda, contract language, and redlined security requirements.
  • Partner with Legal and Information Security stakeholders to evaluate proposed contractual obligations and recommend appropriate revisions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to internal business teams by providing guidance related to security controls, compliance requirements, and customer assurance requests.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve processes, documentation, automation, and reporting across the Governance, Risk, and Compliance program.
  • Participate in broader governance and risk initiatives as security processes mature and become more automated.
  • Contribute to ongoing program enhancement efforts that improve operational efficiency, consistency, and overall customer experience.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED (Required Education and Experience)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Business Administration, Risk Management, Accounting, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • Two (2) or more years of experience in information security, IT audit, governance, risk and compliance (GRC), security compliance, client assurance, or a related discipline.
  • Working knowledge of information security and compliance concepts including:
    • SOC 2
    • Access Management
    • Least Privilege
    • Segregation of Duties
    • Disaster Recovery
    • Data Protection
    • Security Testing and Controls
  • Experience interpreting questionnaires, gathering information from stakeholders, and preparing accurate and professional responses.
  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to explain technical and compliance concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong organizational, documentation, and follow-up skills.
  • Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and willingness to learn new technologies, products, and security requirements.

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Ability to work independently while effectively partnering across departments.

NICE TO HAVE (Preferred Education and Experience)

  • Experience completing customer security questionnaires, due diligence requests, or security sections of RFPs.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2 audits, IT audits, or compliance assessments.
  • Experience administering access certification or user access review programs.
  • Experience reviewing security contract language, security addenda, or contract redlines in partnership with Legal teams.
  • Familiarity with GRC and security questionnaire management platforms such as SecurityPal, Archer, OneTrust, MetricStream, or similar tools.
  • Background in IT audit, SOC auditing, risk management, compliance, or related disciplines.
  • Experience in SaaS, healthcare technology, benefits administration, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISA, CRISC, Security+, CISSP, or similar credentials.

OTHER DUTIES

Minimal travel may be required.

At bswift, we empower our employees to make a meaningful impact, innovate, and grow. Joining our team means stepping into a collaborative and dynamic environment that values creativity, initiative, and a passion for client success. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and values each team member’s unique contributions.

jobs.excerpt: Metabase is the easiest way for people to get insights from their data, from tiny startups who get up and running quickly to major corporations with tens of thousands of users.
jobs.description:
Metabase is the easiest way for people to get insights from their data, from tiny startups who get up and running quickly to major corporations with tens of thousands of users. That's why people love us.
We bring data tools with the elegance and simplicity of consumer products to the crufty world of enterprise business intelligence. We provide an opinionated open source starting point for how companies should measure, analyze and share their data, which is used by tens of thousands of companies.

About the Role

    We’re looking for a Security Engineer with deep expertise in source code analysis and offensive product security research. You’ll dig into complex software architectures, trace how code behaves at runtime, uncover subtle vulnerabilities, and address the systemic flaws behind them.

    Embedded in our core engineering team, you’ll help shape security decisions from early design through release and adoption. This is a hands-on engineering and research role: you’ll combine your security expertise with frontier AI tools to find vulnerabilities, develop fixes, and make Metabase secure by default across its product, dependencies, and runtime.

Things you’ll do

  • Partner with engineers throughout feature development, bringing security expertise to design, implementation, release, and adoption.
  • Build security-focused features, lead security improvements across the codebase, and implement fixes that address root causes.
  • Use and evaluate advanced AI tools to scale code analysis, vulnerability research, and secure engineering practices.
  • Conduct offensive research into Metabase, develop proofs of concept, and validate vulnerabilities.
  • Assess findings based on exploitability and real-world impact, define clear remediation criteria, and verify that fixes are effective.
  • Turn individual findings into broader improvements that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities.

What you bring

  • A demonstrated track record of finding and exploiting application vulnerabilities through source code analysis and hands-on research.
  • The ability to independently navigate unfamiliar codebases, understand complex architectures, and reason about runtime behavior and trust boundaries.
  • Experience with application security challenges, including authentication, authorization, injection, and unsafe handling of untrusted data.
  • Sound judgment about exploitability and real-world impact, and the ability to communicate findings and remediation options clearly.
  • Strong software engineering skills, including the ability to implement durable security fixes. Experience in Clojure, or a strong desire to learn.
  • A thoughtful approach to AI-assisted security work, using these tools to extend your expertise while independently validating their output.
  • Ownership and curiosity: you pursue difficult questions, collaborate closely with engineers, and follow findings through to resolution.
Compensation
The US base salary range for this role is $160K–$225K annually, plus equity and benefits.
Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual qualifications, including skills, experience, and scope of responsibility. Pay may vary by geographic location and other job-related factors.

Benefits
We offer meaningful equity and a comprehensive US benefits package, including fully employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance (with 75% coverage for dependents), a 401(k) with employer match available to enroll after the first 30 days, flexible and unlimited paid time off including sick time, and an asynchronous, remote-first environment.
We're a global team (50% outside the US), fully distributed (from Thailand to California), who get things done asynchronously, with plenty of uninterrupted time, supporting each other to do the best work of our careers. We offer flexibility (define your own schedule and work from wherever you want), autonomy, and an environment that fosters growth, learning, and development. We're relentlessly user-focused and believe in building long-term value, not short-term hacks. And we raised a $30M Series B to take our approach to the next level for years to come.

jobs.excerpt: About the Role:WEX is transforming how businesses manage spend and fleets—with a vision beyond traditional fueling through a growing set of payment, discounting, and platform capabilities built on shared platform investments.
jobs.description:
About the Role:

WEX is transforming how businesses manage spend and fleets—with a vision beyond traditional fueling through a growing set of payment, discounting, and platform capabilities built on shared platform investments.

We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and execution-driven Senior Product Manager (Level 4) to own and scale our next generation of Merchant Product solutions. Sitting within the North American Mobility (NAM) Product Team, you will act as an emerging strategic leader and trusted influencer owning a significant set of initiatives aligned to our core merchant systems—including discount networks (such as the EDGE Savings Network), pricing programs, and merchant-to-fleet communication channels.

In this role, you will drive the full product lifecycle from ideation to market delivery, connecting deep customer insights to broader company strategy, and owning customer adoption, usage, and financial value. You will work closely with senior product leaders, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to create capabilities that communicate dynamic pricing and discount programs to fleets, driving mutual value across our merchant and fleet ecosystems.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop Bold Vision and Product Strategy: Act as an emerging strategic leader to develop a bold vision and clear priorities for WEX’s merchant product ecosystem. Shape product strategy across our portfolio of discounting solutions, identify market gaps, and serve as a strategic partner to senior leadership.
  • Own Product and Financial Outcomes: Drive the execution of complex merchant initiatives, owning customer and business outcomes. Proactively define input and output metrics, utilizing rigorous business modeling and OKRs to tell the performance story of your product and drive customer and financial outcomes.
  • Lead Deep Customer and Partner Discovery: Dive deep into user behaviors and establish ongoing relationships with key merchants and fleets. Integrate qualitative and quantitative insights to pinpoint top partner problems and guide core product trade-offs.
  • Drive Multi-Channel Experiences & Portal Enhancements: Own and optimize customer journeys as they utilize our discounting programs across digital portals and platforms. Streamline onboarding workflows, automate administrative operations, and represent merchant product priorities within broader platform initiatives to reduce friction.
  • Design & Execute Iterative Experiments: Formulate hypotheses and design test-and-learn experiments to improve system administration, portal usability, and customer workflows, driving measurable adoption and delivering on key OKRs.
  • Partner & Influence Cross-Functionally: Build trust and facilitate alignment across Digital, Technology, Commercial, Risk, and Operations teams to ensure technical, operational, and financial systems are fully aligned and revenue is secure.
  • Manage Full Business & System Lifecycle: Oversee the evolution of merchant capabilities from initial ideation to a scalable, repeatable model. Detail how data flows through core systems and merchant-specific platforms, ensuring operational readiness at every stage.

Merchant Product Specifics:

  • Collaborate Across Customer-Facing Product Teams: Partner closely with adjacent WEX product owners who manage mobile apps, web portals, and communication channels to ensure they understand, align on, and prioritize the necessary features and configurations required to support seamless driver and fleet manager discounting and incentive use cases.
  • Align Go-to-Market & Value Communications: Coordinate across marketing, product marketing, customer service, and commercial teams to ensure consistent external communications that clearly articulate the value of WEX discounting programs to fleets.
  • Expand Platform & Merchant Communication Capabilities: Drive enhancements to our core pricing, discounting, and merchant platforms to enable partners to configure, manage, and effectively communicate dynamic, self-set discounts directly to participating fleets.
  • Design & Execute Fuel-Saving Behavioral Experiments: Formulate hypotheses and run test-and-learn experiments to understand when, where, and how drivers and fleet managers utilize pricing and discount information, optimizing their decision-making for maximum fuel savings.

What You Bring:

  • Minimum of 5+ years: of professional Product Management experience (or 8+ years of professional experience with significant tenure in product leadership), ideally within payment platforms, fintech, merchant services, or B2B platforms.
  • Strategic Leadership: Proven experience owning and strategically leading a significant set of initiatives aligned to a major product area or platform capability.
  • Technical Domain Expertise: Strong expertise in systems thinking and platform strategy, with a background in payment platform products, merchant ecosystems, APIs, and partner integrations.
  • Metrics & Outcomes Focus: Proven track record of defining and leveraging metrics/OKRs to tell a product's performance story, justify strategic priorities, and deliver customer and financial outcomes.
  • Roadmapping & Scaling: Strong strategic planning and roadmapping capabilities, with the ability to define repeatable patterns from one-off integrations and establish clear development phases.
  • Collaborative Influence: Excellent collaborative influence and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to build trust, facilitate difficult conversations, and align stakeholders.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Insights-proficient and highly comfortable utilizing qualitative and quantitative data and interactive tools to drill down and make informed product decisions.
  • Mentorship: Proven leadership and mentorship skills, with the ability to guide and role-model discovery methods and strategic thinking for junior PMs.

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience with core pricing, discounting, or ledger systems.
  • Fluency running GTM experiments, channel testing, or behavioral A/B tests.
  • Master’s Degree in business, technology, or a related field.

Why This Role Matters:

WEX is expanding its merchant systems and platform capabilities, unlocking critical growth opportunities through our discounting and pricing ecosystems. This role will help shape how we:

  • Deepen Relationships: Deepen connections between merchants and fleets by facilitating seamless, dynamic value exchange and direct communications.
  • Simplify Savings: Simplify and optimize how fleets discover, utilize, and maximize savings programs.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Drive cross-functional alignment across digital interfaces, core processing layers, commercial, and risk teams to scale unified solutions.
  • Empower Partners: Ensure that merchants have comprehensive, flexible tools to configure discounts and attract fleet volumes, establishing repeatable platform patterns.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Strategic Roadmapping: You define and drive the strategic roadmap for a portion of WEX Merchant Products, translating a bold vision into market-ready features and platform capabilities.
  • Cross-Functional Trusted Partnership: You foster close, collaborative relationships with cross-functional partners, ensuring operational, technical, and risk readiness for new discounting schemes and merchant configurations.
  • Behavioral Experiments: You leverage qualitative and quantitative insights to design experiments that increase merchant-to-fleet communication effectiveness and optimize driver savings.
  • Mentorship and Alignment: You act as a trusted leader and influencer, mentoring junior product managers and driving alignment across tech, commercial, and customer-facing product teams.

The Enterprise Resilience Role helps strengthen the organization’s ability to anticipate, withstand, respond to, recover from, and adapt to cyber, technology, operational, and third-party disruptions. Als zugelassener Bildungsträger nach der Akkreditierungs- und Zulassungsverordnung Arbeitsförderung (AZAV) schulen wir zudem alle Stakeholder, Mitarbeiter und KI-Enthusiasten, sodass das Wissen zu 100 % Inhouse in Unternehmen gesichert ist.

Deine Chance als Senior Softwareentwickler:

Bei Everlast AI bist Du als Senior Softwareentwickler genau an der richtigen Stelle. Wir glauben fest daran, dass Vielfalt und frische Perspektiven unser Team bereichern. Dank unserer digitalen Schulungsplattform helfen wir Dir, in Deinen neuen Job hineinzufinden und das Beste aus Dir herauszuholen.

deine benefits

  • Zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Ziel jeder Einstellung ist die unbefristete Übernahme, unsere Quote liegt bei über 95 %. Deine Vergütung steigt leistungsbasiert und jederzeit, nicht erst zum Stichtag oder nach Ablauf der Probezeit.

  • Echte Ownership für das Tech-Team: Du triffst die großen Architekturentscheidungen, prägst den technischen Standard und entwickelst die Junior-Entwickler fachlich. Wir erwarten dafür keinen Dienst nach Vorschrift, sondern dass Du mitdenkst, Vorschläge machst und Verantwortung übernimmst. Wer an die Spitze des Tech-Teams will, hat bei uns freie Bahn und wird auch daran gemessen.

  • Best-Hardware-Garantie: Du bekommst kompromisslos das Gerät, mit dem Du am besten arbeitest. MacBook Pro 16" mit M5 Pro, 24 GB und 1 TB als Minimum, dazu Studio Display und externes Setup nach Deiner Wahl. Wir diskutieren nicht über Ausstattung, wir stellen sie hin.

  • Unbegrenzter KI-Zugang, ohne Limit und ohne Wartezeit: Du hast vollen Zugriff auf alle gängigen KI-Tools, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor und was sonst gerade führend ist. Ohne Token-Limits, ohne Kontingente, ohne die Frage, ob sich der nächste Prompt lohnt. Wenn eine neue Software Deine Arbeit voranbringt, hast Du sie innerhalb von 24 Stunden auf dem Rechner, ohne IT-Ticket und ohne Budgetrunde.

  • Weiterbildung, die Du selbst bestimmst: 2.000 € Hardware- und Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr, über das Du frei entscheidest. Fachbücher, Kurse, Zertifikate, Konferenzen oder eigene Experimentier-Hardware. Wir schreiben Dir nicht vor, worin Du tiefer wirst, denn bei einer Technologie, die sich in Monaten neu erfindet, weißt Du das besser als jeder Weiterbildungskatalog.

  • Lernkurve, die Du sonst nirgends bekommst: Eigene SaaS-Produkte, KI-gestützte Entwicklung im Terminal als Standard, ein Team mit verschiedenen Schwerpunkten und kurze Wege zu den Gründern. Unsere Entwickler sagen uns, dass sie hier mehr gelernt haben als in jedem Unternehmen davor.

  • Maximale Reichweite für Deine Arbeit: Was Du baust, geht direkt an tausende Nutzer unserer Produkte und an über 3.500 Kunden, und der größte deutsche YouTube-Kanal für Künstliche Intelligenz zeigt, was das Team entwickelt. Statt in einer internen Präsentation zu verschwinden, wird Deine Arbeit gesehen.

  • Zugang zu einem Netzwerk, das Dich weiterbringt: Über Everlast bist Du an eines der größten Netzwerke von Zukunftsforschern, Professoren und Doktoren im Bereich KI und Robotik angebunden. Du diskutierst mit Menschen, die diese Technologie mitentwickeln, statt sie nur zu lesen.

  • Starke Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist kollegial und direkt, die Wege zu den Gründern kurz. Wir ziehen an einem Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig zu Bestleistungen.

deine aufgaben

  • Produkte bis zu echten Nutzern tragen: Du verantwortest Features an RelationFlow, Voicely und unseren internen Systemen von der Architektur bis zum Live-Betrieb. Tausende Nutzer merken sofort, was Du gebaut hast.

  • Anspruchsvolle Entwicklung end-to-end: Die technisch kniffligen Features und Systeme baust Du selbst, mit Next.js, TypeScript, React und Tailwind im Frontend, Node.js oder Nest.js im Backend.

  • Datenbank und Backend in der Tiefe: Supabase und PostgreSQL sind Dein Fundament: RLS-Policies, Partitionierung, Migrationen, Storage, Realtime, Drizzle ORM. Du entwirfst Datenmodelle, die unter Last und mit wachsenden Anforderungen tragen.

  • Architektur und Skalierung: Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen, kannst sie begründen und sorgst dafür, dass Systeme unter echter Last zuverlässig laufen, inklusive Integrationen (Stripe, Mail, Kalender, Telefonie), Cloud (Vercel, Cloudflare, AWS), CI/CD und Monitoring.

  • KI-gestützte Entwicklung als Standard: Claude Code und Codex im Terminal sind Dein tägliches Werkzeug, Cursor ergänzend. Du zeigst den Juniors, wie das richtig geht, und verifizierst jeden generierten Code, bevor er in Production geht.

  • Qualität, Tests und Standards: Unit Tests mit Vitest, Code-Reviews und ein sauberer Ansatz prägen den technischen Standard im Team, ohne dass Du dafür eine formale Führungsrolle brauchst.

  • Juniors anleiten und den Lead entlasten: Du koordinierst Dich mit den Entwicklern, beantwortest technische Fragen und nimmst dem Lead das operative Abstimmen ab, als Sparringspartner, nicht als Vorgesetzter. Wenn Du Rust mitbringst, ist unsere Systemebene Dein Spielfeld.

deine qualifikationen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit echter Tiefe: 5 bis 10 Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung, sofort einsatzbereit. Ein Studium ist nicht nötig, Deine Tiefe zählt.

  • Produktverantwortung nachgewiesen: Du hast ein SaaS-Produkt oder eine Software aufgebaut oder maßgeblich verantwortet, mit mehreren hundert bis tausend aktiven Nutzern. Wir wollen sehen, worauf Du stolz bist.

  • Genau unser Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, React (Hooks, State-Management mit TanStack oder Redux) und Tailwind, dazu Node.js oder Nest.js und PostgreSQL. Kein breiter Generalist, sondern exakt unser Stack.

  • Supabase und PostgreSQL in der Tiefe: RLS, Partitionen, Buckets, Realtime, Drizzle, Legacy Keys gegenüber neuen API-Keys, Compute. Wir prüfen das gründlich, weil daran die meisten scheitern.

  • Sauberer Workflow und Testing: Claude Code und Codex im Terminal, paralleles Arbeiten über Git Worktrees, effiziente IDE-Nutzung, Unit Tests mit Vitest. Du kannst sagen, ob Du eher test-driven oder spec-driven arbeitest, und verifizierst generierten Code, statt ihm blind zu vertrauen.

  • Cloud, Docker und CI/CD als Plus: AWS, Azure oder GCP, Cloudflare, Compose-Files, GitHub Actions. Rust, Tauri und Go sind ein echter Vorteil.

  • Anleiten ohne Chef-Allüren, Deutsch C1/C2: Du bist kommunikativ genug, um Juniors anzuleiten und Dich abzustimmen, ruhig und teamorientiert, kein Platzhirsch. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch, für die enge Abstimmung mit Team und Lead.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both executive and technical audiences and influence strategic technology investments.

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are looking for an Generative AI Engineer to design, execute, and operationalize fine-tuning workflows for large language models across supervised, preference-based, and reinforcement learning approaches. The role requires deep practical experience with modern training stacks, careful dataset construction, rigorous evaluation methodology, and the engineering discipline to operate complex training pipelines reliably. The ideal candidate combines strong ML intuition with production-grade engineering practices, and is comfortable navigating the trade-offs between data quality, compute budget, evaluation rigor, and shipping velocity. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
  • Six or more years of combined ML research and engineering experience, with significant LLM exposure.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks, especially PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience fine-tuning transformer-based language models at non-trivial scale.
  • Familiarity with distributed training strategies including FSDP, ZeRO, and pipeline parallelism.
  • Experience with RLHF, DPO, or other preference optimization techniques.
  • Strong understanding of evaluation methodology, benchmarks, and human evaluation design.
  • Experience operating training jobs on GPU clusters and recovering from failures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Track record of shipping or publishing impactful LLM work.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Publications at top-tier ML venues.
  • Experience with multimodal model fine-tuning.
  • Familiarity with synthetic data generation and dataset distillation.
  • Open-source contributions to LLM training libraries.
  • Exposure to responsible AI evaluation and red-teaming practices.
